door_too_late.zh: 已经太晚了，现在哪里都去不了了……
door_too_late.en: It's too late to go anywhere now...

door_day_not_over.zh: 营业结束前你不能离开店铺！
door_day_not_over.en: You can't leave the Store until the day is over!

door_crackdown.zh: 戒严查抄期间你不能离开店铺！
door_crackdown.en: You can't leave the Store during a crackdown!

door_wounded.zh: 受重伤时你无法离开店铺！
door_wounded.en: You can't leave the Store while you have major wounds!

door_agoraphobia_rest.zh: 广场恐惧症让你不敢离开店铺！还需在这里休息{0}晚，才能再次外出。
door_agoraphobia_rest.en: Your agoraphobia keeps you in the Store! Rest here {0} more nights before going out again.

door_agoraphobia_rest_last.zh: 广场恐惧症让你不敢离开店铺！明天就能再次外出了。
door_agoraphobia_rest_last.en: Your agoraphobia keeps you in the Store! You can go out again tomorrow.

door_agoraphobia.en: You can't leave the store due to your agoraphobia!

telephone_hover.zh: 使用电话呼叫你的联系人
telephone_hover.en: Call your contacts using the phone

display_case_hover.zh: 将物品放置于此以吸引感兴趣的顾客
display_case_hover.en: Place items here to attract interested customers

customer_counter_hover.zh: 显示今天队伍中剩余的顾客数量
customer_counter_hover.en: Shows the number of customers left in the line for the day

negotiation_counter_hover.zh: 将你想要买卖的物品放置于此，并打开谈判界面
negotiation_counter_hover.en: Place the item you want to buy or sell here and open the Negotiation Interface

o_key.en: Press O Letter Key to Hide/Show Hint Overlay

start_day_hover.zh: 如果队伍中仍有重要人物，你将无法结束这一天
start_day_hover.en: You will not be able to end a day if there are important people still in line

call_customer_hover.zh: 呼叫下一位顾客上前，或遣散当前顾客
call_customer_hover.en: Call next customer forward or dismiss the current customer

negociation_interface_hover.zh: 放置在谈判柜台上的物品可以通过谈判界面进行买卖
negociation_interface_hover.en: Items placed on the Negotiation Counter can be sold/bought via the Negotiation Interface

autosave.zh: 游戏将在睡觉后自动保存。
autosave.en: The Game will AUTOSAVE after sleeping.

reputation_interface_hover.zh: 查看你在各派系中的声望
reputation_interface_hover.en: Check your reputation with the factions

item_ancient_alien_relics_flavor.zh: 怎么看都只是一堆废旧金属……“远古外星”废旧金属？
item_ancient_alien_relics_flavor.en: Looks like scrap metal... "Ancient Alien" scrap metal?

item_box_tampon_flavor.zh: 此类卫生用品主打安全与私密，是下层区鲜有人能消费得起的奢侈品。
item_box_tampon_flavor.en: Promising protection and discretion, sanitary products like these are a luxury that few in the Lower Levels can afford.

item_packet_red_cigarette_flavor.zh: 极致奢华的吸烟体验，它的口感和它的价格一样，绝对让你终生难忘。
item_packet_red_cigarette_flavor.en: The most luxurious smoking experience one can have, with a flavor, and a price tag, that makes sure you remember it.

item_pack_condom_flavor.zh: 得益于一项补贴分发计划，这东西在下层区极为常见。毕竟，控制人口可比镇压暴乱便宜多了。
item_pack_condom_flavor.en: Surprisingly common in the Lower Levels thanks to a subsidised distribution program. Population control, after all, is cheaper than riot control.

item_shampoo_flavor.zh: 集洗发水、护发素、沐浴露和牙膏于一瓶的便捷洗护产品，更添加了提神醒脑的营养果萃取物。
item_shampoo_flavor.en: Shampoo, conditioner, body wash and toothpaste, all in one convenient bottle, with rejuvenating Nutrifruit extract.

item_toothpaste_flavor.zh: 能带来清新口气的薄荷凝胶。
item_toothpaste_flavor.en: A minty gel that promises fresh breath.

item_toilet_paper_flavor.zh: 价格亲民的厕纸，结实耐用。在下层区，双层纸也已然是一种奢侈。
item_toilet_paper_flavor.en: Affordable toilet paper that offers strength and reliability. Two-ply is a luxury in the Lower Levels.

item_water_test_container_desc.zh: 包含水质检测试纸的小瓶。
item_water_test_container_desc.en: A small bottle of color strips used to test water quality.

item_water_test_strip_desc.zh: 用于准确测定水样质量的检测试纸。
item_water_test_strip_desc.en: A testing strip used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample.

item_uv_filter_desc.en: Can be used on a water container.

item_uv_filter_flavor.zh: 一种发射紫外线以杀灭细菌和其他微生物的灯具。
item_uv_filter_flavor.en: A lamp that emits ultraviolet light to kill bacteria and other microorganisms.

item_aquascan_desc.zh: 一种用于准确测定水样质量的设备。可显示检测到的杂质。
item_aquascan_desc.en: A device used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample. Displays detected impurities.

item_metal_scanner_desc.zh: 一种能提高你在拾荒时发现贵重物品几率的设备。（你同时只能获得一台拾荒扫描仪的增益效果。）
item_metal_scanner_desc.en: A device that improves your chance of finding valuables when scavenging. (You can only benefit from one Scav Scanner at a time.)

item_metal_scanner_flavor.zh: 曾经幻想过拥有第三只眼吗？或者是第二只鼻子？用拾荒扫描仪穿透杂物，寻找宝藏吧！
item_metal_scanner_flavor.en: Ever wanted a third eye? Or a second nose? Cut through the clutter with a Scav Scanner!

item_water_tablet_container_desc.zh: 一小瓶用于净化水质的药片。
item_water_tablet_container_desc.en: A small bottle of tablets used to purify water.

item_water_tablet_desc.zh: 可消除大量微生物污染物，并部分减少化学污染物。对其他类型的污染物无效。
item_water_tablet_desc.en: Eliminate large amount of microbial contaminants and partially reduce chemical contaminants. No effect against other types of contaminants.

item_kotton_fabric_desc.zh: 用于化学实验，可滤除液体中的大颗粒物。织孔太粗，完全无法用于净水。
item_kotton_fabric_desc.en: Used in chemistry to strain large particles from liquids. Far too coarse for water purification.

item_kotton_fabric_flavor.zh: 用途广泛的有机纤维布料。常用于制作加固工作服和减震内衬。
item_kotton_fabric_flavor.en: A versatile fabric made of organic fibers. Commonly used for reinforced workwear and shock-insulating wraps.

item_water_filter_desc.zh: 安装在过滤系统内使用时，可略微提高水质纯度。水质纯度超过一定阈值后将不再生效。
item_water_filter_desc.en: Slightly improves water purity when used inside a filter system. Ineffective above a certain threshold.

item_water_filter_flavor.zh: 轻量化的民用级过滤器。

item_neuroactive_perfume_desc.zh: 使用后，与当前顾客的交易收益将提升15%。你同时只能获得一种香水效果的增益。
item_neuroactive_perfume_desc.en: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.

item_neuroactive_perfume_flavor.zh: 脱胎于心理创伤治疗研究，采用自适应气味映射技术来唤起个人的美好回忆。常见于高端服务场所，那里的员工发现，喷这款香水能换来的小费远超它的售价。
item_neuroactive_perfume_flavor.en: Developed from grief therapy research, this perfume use adaptive scent-mapping tech to evoke positive personal memories. Common in high-end hospitality venues, where workers found that the tips earned by wearing the perfume more than make up for the price tag.

item_pheromone_perfume_desc.zh: 使用后，与当前顾客的交易收益将提升25%。你同时只能获得一种香水效果的增益。
item_pheromone_perfume_desc.en: Use to boost trading bonus by 25% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.

item_pheromone_perfume_flavor.zh: 以人工改造的人类信息素调制出的违禁香水，能增强吸引力与情感接受度。尽管属于违禁品，但它依然受到上层区那些攀附权贵者的极力追捧。
item_pheromone_perfume_flavor.en: An illegal fragrance formulated from engineered human pheromones. It pushes attraction and emotional receptivity. Despite being illegal, it is highly sought after by social climbers in the Upper Levels.

item_screwdriver_flavor.zh: 朴实无华的螺丝刀，不管是上层区还是下层区的公民都会在杂物抽屉里放上一件。
item_screwdriver_flavor.en: The humble screwdriver, a common fixture of the spare drawers of citizens in the Upper and Lower Levels alike.

item_screwdriver_desc.zh: 携带此物品时，在垃圾场拾荒将获得10%的额外螺丝产量。
item_screwdriver_desc.en: While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Screws.

item_welder_flavor.zh: 高频点火等离子切割机。经过精密制造以保证稳定性，切割速度快、威力大且切口平整。
item_welder_flavor.en: High frequency ignition plasma cutter. Manufactured for guaranteed stability, and a fast, strong and smooth cut.

item_welder_desc.zh: 能够用来拆解损坏的机器以回收废金属。携带此物品时，在垃圾场拾荒将获得10%的额外废金属产量。
item_welder_desc.en: Can be used to salvage Scrap Metal by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Scrap Metal.

item_wire_cutter_flavor.zh: 弹簧装置确保了良好的杠杆作用，减轻使用者的手部负担，而柔软的橡胶手柄则提供了出色的抓握力与舒适度。
item_wire_cutter_flavor.en: Spring action ensures good leverage and reduces strain on the user, while the soft rubber handles give good grip and comfort.

item_wire_cutter_desc.zh: 能够用来拆解损坏的机器以回收线缆。携带此物品时，在垃圾场拾荒将获得10%的额外线缆产量。
item_wire_cutter_desc.en: Can be used to salvage Wire by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Wire.

item_labeler_desc.en: Used to edit the label of an item.

item_magnifier_desc.zh: 用于更仔细地检查某些物品。
item_magnifier_desc.en: Used to inspect certain items more closely.

item_sign_water_desc.zh: 一块霓虹灯牌。将其放置在展示柜中，可吸引有意出售水的顾客。
item_sign_water_desc.en: A neon sign that, when placed in the Display Case, will attract customers willing to sell Water.

item_turbo_booster_desc.zh: 能够立刻为需要耗时运作的机器提供动力的工具。使用前请确保目标机器已具备所有必要的输入材料。使用后即被消耗。
item_turbo_booster_desc.en: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Consumed upon use.

item_turbo_booster_adv_desc.zh: 能够立刻为需要耗时运作的机器提供动力的工具。使用前请确保目标机器已具备所有必要的输入材料。随时间推移可自动充能。这一高级版本在使用后不会被消耗。
item_turbo_booster_adv_desc.en: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Recharges over time. This advanced version will not be consumed upon use.

item_backpack_small_desc.zh: 款式紧凑、饱经磨砺的背包，配有加固缝线。重量虽轻，但足以装下各种基本物资。
item_backpack_small_desc.en: A compact, well-worn backpack with reinforced stitching. Lightweight but roomy enough for essential supplies.

item_backpack_medium_military_desc.zh: 专为军事用途设计的重型背包。布料极为耐用，以至于有些士兵在战斗中会把它背在胸前当作额外护甲使用。
item_backpack_medium_military_desc.en: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

item_sec_box_desc.zh: 一个上锁的板条箱，标签上写着归空间站治安部军械库所有。里面装满了物资。需要识别卡才能打开。
item_sec_box_desc.en: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Armory. Full of supplies. Access card required.

item_eng_box_desc.zh: 一个上锁的板条箱，标签上写着归空间站工程铸造厂所有。里面装满了物资。需要识别卡才能打开。
item_eng_box_desc.en: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Engineering Foundry. Full of supplies. Access card required.

item_eng_box_flavor.zh: 那些戴安全帽的家伙一定会为弄丢了工具而追悔莫及……
item_eng_box_flavor.en: Those hard hats will regret losing their tools...

item_med_box_desc.zh: 一个上锁的板条箱，标签上写着归空间站医疗舱所有。里面装满了物资。需要识别卡才能打开。
item_med_box_desc.en: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Medical Bay. Full of supplies. Access card required.

item_med_box_flavor.zh: 弄丢了这批物资应该不至于闹出人命吧……对吧？
item_med_box_flavor.en: Surely these missing supplies won't cost anyone their lives... right?

item_evidence_box_flavor.zh: 这里面的东西足够把整个下层区的人都送进大牢了。
item_evidence_box_flavor.en: There's enough here to put the entire Lower Levels behind bars.

item_evidence_box_desc.zh: 一个上锁的板条箱，标签上写着归空间站治安部证物库所有。内含贵重物品。需要识别卡才能打开。
item_evidence_box_desc.en: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Evidence Locker. Valuable. Access card required.

item_service_box_desc.zh: 一个坚固的板条箱，标签上写着归空间站后勤服务部所有。里面装满了物资。需要识别卡才能打开。
item_service_box_desc.en: A secure crate. Labeled for the Station Service Department. Full of supplies. Access card required.

item_service_box_flavor.zh: 空间站后勤服务部负责将公共设施物资分发给那些有需要……或者说，付得起钱的人。
item_service_box_flavor.en: The Station Service Department distributes utility supplies to those who need, or pay, for them.

item_common_chemical_desc.zh: 拆开后可获得一批用于基础化学合成的实用物品。
item_common_chemical_desc.en: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for basic chemical crafting.

item_common_chemical_flavor.zh: 一批你极有可能在空间站五金库里找到的常见化学用品。
item_common_chemical_flavor.en: A collection of common chemical supplies you could likely find in the Station Hardware Depot.

item_restricted_chemical_desc.zh: 拆开后可获得一批用于高级化学合成的实用物品。
item_restricted_chemical_desc.en: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for advanced chemical crafting.

item_restricted_chemical_flavor.zh: 一批用于制造麻醉品或炸药的管制化学用品。
item_restricted_chemical_flavor.en: A collection of restricted chemical supplies needed for crafting narcotics, or explosives.

item_common_medical_flavor.zh: 一批常见的医疗用品，主要是药房里的非处方类物品。
item_common_medical_flavor.en: A collection of common medical supplies, mostly over-the-counter pharmacy items.

item_restricted_medical_flavor.zh: 一批受管制的医疗物品——用来救治空间站病患的必需品。
item_restricted_medical_flavor.en: A collection of restricted medical supplies, necessary for the care of the Station's infirm.

item_scrap_metal_desc.zh: 可冶炼成金属矿石。由于空间站上的资源极其有限，打捞和回收利用成为了尤为重要的生存习惯。
item_scrap_metal_desc.en: Can be smelted into Metal Ore. With limited resources available on the Station, salvage and recycling are important habits.

item_junk_flavor.zh: 损坏的废料和毫无用处的垃圾。几乎无法回收，完全一文不值。
item_junk_flavor.en: Broken scraps and useless rubbish. Barely recyclable, worth next to nothing.

item_common_electronic_flavor.zh: 各种虽说常见却很实用的的电子元件组合：连接器、开关、电容器、处理器以及处理单元……
item_common_electronic_flavor.en: 'An assortment of all kinds of useful, if common, electronics: connectors, switches, capacitors, processors and processing units...'

item_rare_electronic_flavor.zh: 一批不常见的高端电子元件组合。某位发明家肯定会对此非常感兴趣……
item_rare_electronic_flavor.en: An assortment of uncommon, high-end electronic parts. A certain inventor would be very interested in this...

item_wire_desc.zh: 一捆电线。看这模样，显然是从某个地方强行拆下来的……
item_wire_desc.en: A bundle of electrical wires. From the looks of it, it was harvested from somewhere...

item_printer_plastic_desc.zh: '用于3D打印机的优质耗材，尽可能地利用回收废旧塑料加工而成。 '
item_printer_plastic_desc.en: 'A spool of premium filament for use in a 3D printer. Made from recycled plastics where possible. '

item_nuclear_waste_desc.zh: 放射性废料。请小心处理。
item_nuclear_waste_desc.en: Radioactive waste material. Handle with care.

item_nuclear_waste_flavor.zh: 一批危险的核废料。没人愿意碰这玩意儿。
item_nuclear_waste_flavor.en: A collection of hazardous nuclear waste. No one wants to deal with this stuff.

item_flux_agent_desc.zh: 实用的添加剂，在冶炼时使用可提高金属矿石的纯度。会在过程中被消耗。
item_flux_agent_desc.en: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. It is consumed in the process.

item_advanced_flux_agent_desc.zh: '实用的添加剂，在冶炼时使用可提高金属矿石的纯度。可重复使用。 '
item_advanced_flux_agent_desc.en: 'A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. Reusable. '

item_tazer_flavor.zh: 用于自卫和执法的小型电击武器。能释放令人痛苦的电击。
item_tazer_flavor.en: A compact stun weapon used for self-defense and enforcement. Delivers a painful jolt.

item_birth_control_pill_flavor.zh: 用于防止怀孕的避孕药。它是雌激素和孕激素的结合体。
item_birth_control_pill_flavor.en: A contraceptive pill that prevents pregnancy. It's a combination of estrogen and progestin hormones.

item_zerochew_desc.zh: 一板“零嚼”，一种廉价的食欲抑制剂。
item_zerochew_desc.en: A tab of ZeroChew, an affordable appetite suppressant.

item_zerochew_flavor.zh: 会被一些下层区居民用来少吃几顿正餐，好省下信用点。而在上层区，这东西则被包装成“纤体-X”减肥药进行营销。
item_zerochew_flavor.en: Used by some Lower Levels inhabitants looking to stretch their credits by skipping meals. Marketed as Regime-X, a weight loss drug in the Upper Levels.

item_smelling_salt_desc.zh: 包含酒精和氨水的细玻璃管，有助于在昏厥后恢复意识。
item_smelling_salt_desc.en: A thin glass tube containing alcohol and ammonia that helps restore consciousness after fainting.

item_blood_bag_desc.zh: 一袋500毫升的输血袋，采集自一位万能血型捐献者——尽管其本人未必出于自愿。
item_blood_bag_desc.en: A 500ml blood transfusion bag drawn from a universal, though not necessarily willing, donor.

item_blue_blood_bag_desc.zh: 可注射的生物凝胶，经专门设计，可随时间溶解动脉斑块和微小血栓。它能有效预防冠心病、缺血性中风以及高血压相关的并发症。
item_blue_blood_bag_desc.en: An injectable biogel engineered to dissolve arterial plaque and microclots over time. It effectively prevents coronary artery disease, ischemic stroke and hypertension-related complications.

item_blue_blood_bag_flavor.zh: 实际上并非血液。即便是放在上层区也属于稀罕物。
item_blue_blood_bag_flavor.en: It's not actually blood. Not so common even in the Upper Levels.

item_dream_dust_flavor.zh: 下层区自制的一种廉价兴奋粉。被用来暂时忘却生活在空间站里的残酷现实。
item_dream_dust_flavor.en: A cheap, euphoria inducing powder, created in the Lower Levels. Used as a brief escape from the harsh realities of Station life.

item_nightmare_dust_flavor.zh: 兼具毒药和致幻剂双重作用的细粉末。吞食或吸入会导致严重的恶心、虚弱和意识混乱，随后产生可怕的幻觉。大剂量可致命。
item_nightmare_dust_flavor.en: A fine powder that acts as both a poison and a hallucinogen. Ingestion or inhalation causes severe nausea, weakness, and disorientation, followed terrifying hallucinations. High doses can be lethal.

item_caffeine_pill_flavor.zh: 用上层区高档咖啡厅的残渣提炼而成，这些药片是下层区需长时间轮班的工人们的必需品。
item_caffeine_pill_flavor.en: Synthesized from the waste of Upper Levels espresso bars, these pills are essential for the long shift workers of the Lower Levels.

item_salve_flavor.zh: 由基因改良芦荟和医用级蜂蜜制成。该软膏具有抗菌特性，并能促进细胞的再生与生长。
item_salve_flavor.en: Made from modified aloe and medical grade honey. This salve has antibacterial properties and promotes cell regeneration and growth.

item_rubbing_alcohol_flavor.zh: 一种强效消毒剂，用于清洁伤口和物体表面。吞食具有剧毒，但这并不能阻止它在下层区被当作努特加的替代品饮用。
item_rubbing_alcohol_flavor.en: A potent disinfectant used for cleaning wounds and surfaces. Highly toxic if ingested, but that doesn't stop it being used as an alternative to Nudka in the Lower Levels.

item_bandage_desc.zh: 一条简单、干净的绷带，用于包扎伤口。
item_bandage_desc.en: A simple, clean bandage for dressing wounds.

item_hemostatic_bandage_desc.zh: 涂有强效止血剂的绷带，轻重度出血都能止住。
item_hemostatic_bandage_desc.en: A bandage coated with a potent hemostatic agent capable of stopping heavy and light bleeding.

item_topical_bandage_desc.zh: 涂有温和局部医疗凝胶的绷带，有助于伤口愈合。
item_topical_bandage_desc.en: A bandage coated with a mild topical medical gel that aids in the healing process.

item_large_purple_injector_desc.zh: 一种高精度免疫调节剂，用于暂时抑制“哨兵崩溃综合征”引发的过度免疫反应。
item_large_purple_injector_desc.en: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the hyper-reactive immune response associated with Sentinel Collapse.

item_black_injector_desc.zh: 治疗药物成瘾的次世代疗法，旨在抑制大脑的奖励机制，减轻药瘾，辅助长期康复。
item_black_injector_desc.en: Next-generation treatment for drug addiction, designed to suppress the brain's reward system, reduce cravings, and support long-term recovery

item_black_injector_flavor.zh: 与心理治疗和社会支持结合使用效果最佳。
item_black_injector_flavor.en: Works best with concurrent psychological therapy and social support.

item_pink_injector_desc.zh: 奥克西莫是一种合法但危险的药物，用于缓解剧痛并产生快感。由于过度开具处方，奥克西莫成瘾和过量使用的情况极为普遍。
item_pink_injector_desc.en: Oxymore is a legal, but dangerous medication used to relieve severe pain and produce feelings of euphoria. Oxymore addiction and overdose are widespread due to over-prescription.

item_pink_alt_injector_desc.zh: 奥克西莫的非成瘾性止痛替代品。提供有效的镇痛作用，且没有依赖或用药过量的风险。这是一支装在二次利用的注射器里的原型药。
item_pink_alt_injector_desc.en: A non-addictive alternative to Oxymore for pain relief. Provides effective analgesia without the risk of dependence or overdose. This one is a prototype packaged in a repurposed injector.

item_pure_white_injector_desc.zh: 纳洛通是一种用于对抗奥克西莫用药过量的急救药物。
item_pure_white_injector_desc.en: Naloxgone is a emergency medication used to counter Oxymore overdose.

item_glass_shard_shiv_flavor.zh: 一块边缘锋利的碎玻璃，用布包裹着，可作为武器使用。
item_glass_shard_shiv_flavor.en: A sharp-edged piece of broken glass wrapped in cloth that can be used as a weapon.

item_combat_knife_flavor.zh: 一把专为军事用途设计的格斗短刀，主要用于肉搏或近战，但作为工具也很方便。
item_combat_knife_flavor.en: A fighting knife designed for military use and primarily intended for hand-to-hand or close combat fighting, but also useful for utility.

item_box_cutter_flavor.zh: 结实且带有可伸缩刀片的多用途刀具，常用于建筑、手工和仓库作业。
item_box_cutter_flavor.en: A sturdy utility knife with a retractable blade commonly used in construction, crafting and warehouse work.

item_kitchen_knife_flavor.zh: 一把不锈钢刀具。请置于儿童以及心怀鬼胎之人接触不到的地方。
item_kitchen_knife_flavor.en: A stainless steel knife. Keep out of reach of children and the ill-intentioned.

item_combat_machete_flavor.zh: 专为战斗与求生打造的重型砍刀。
item_combat_machete_flavor.en: A heavy-duty machete built for combat and survival.

item_crowbar_flavor.zh: 空间站上每一位经验丰富的拾荒者和理论物理学家最可靠的工具。在紧要关头也可作为武器。
item_crowbar_flavor.en: The trusty tool of every experienced scavenger and theoretical physicist on the Station. Useful as a weapon in a pinch.

item_hatchet_desc.zh: 小巧坚固。可在水培农场中移除当前种植的作物。
item_hatchet_desc.en: Small but sturdy. Can be used on a Hydroponic Farm to clear whatever is currently growing.

item_pipe_weapon_desc.zh: 一根沉重的铅管。在空间站大修供水管线后，数吨剩余的废旧铅管流入了拾荒者和小偷的手中。
item_pipe_weapon_desc.en: A heavy lead pipe. After the Station overhauled the water line, tonnes of leftover lead piping found its way into the hands of scavs and thieves.

item_stun_baton_desc.zh: 配有晕眩和致命两种模式的标准制式电击棍。负责维持空间站秩序的治安部警官的日常防身武器。
item_stun_baton_desc.en: Standard-issue stun baton with STUN and HARM modes. An everyday carry for Security Officers maintaining order in the station.

item_energy_credit_flavor.zh: 为了减少浪费，一次性电池已被共和国认定为非法。
item_energy_credit_flavor.en: In an effort to reduce waste, single-use batteries were made illegal by the Republic.

item_energy_credit_desc.zh: 兼容多数机器的基础电源。可充电。
item_energy_credit_desc.en: A basic power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.

item_energy_credit_ext_flavor.zh: 作为标准型号的改良版，2型电池体积更大、效能更好，误吞窒息的风险也更高。
item_energy_credit_ext_flavor.en: Improving on the standard model, the Mk. II cell is bigger, better and even more of a choking hazard.

item_energy_credit_ext_desc.zh: 兼容多数机器的进阶电源。可充电。
item_energy_credit_ext_desc.en: An improved power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.

item_energy_credit_breeder_desc.zh: 能够自行充电的高级稀有能量电池。
item_energy_credit_breeder_desc.en: An advanced and rare energy cell capable of self charging

item_flashlight_desc.zh: 重型手电筒。携带此物品时，在垃圾场拾荒受伤的几率会降低。
item_flashlight_desc.en: A heavy duty flashlight. While carrying this, you are less likely to be injured while scavenging in the Dumping Grounds.

item_tutorial_book_desc.zh: 专门收集整理导师给你的所有便签的册子。非常方便！
item_tutorial_book_desc.en: A book for keeping track of all notes givien to you by The Mentor. Handy!

item_cigarette_guide_desc.zh: 帮助识别假冒海明威香烟的指南。
item_cigarette_guide_desc.en: A guide that helps identify counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes.

item_cigarette_color_desc.zh: 官方发行的海明威标准色卡。

item_fuel_guide_name.zh: 等离子燃料匣鉴定指南

item_fuel_guide_desc.zh: 用来给等离子燃料匣精准估价的指南。
item_fuel_guide_desc.en: A guide for determining the appropriate value of Plasma Cartridges.

item_stamp_guide_desc.zh: 实用的指南，用于从赝品中辨别出真正的食品券。
item_stamp_guide_desc.en: A handy guide to identifying a genuine Food Stamp from a counterfeit.

item_injector_guide_desc.zh: 包含评估免疫宁注射器状况所需的所有信息。
item_injector_guide_desc.en: Contains all the information you need to reliably assess the condition of Immunivax Injectors.

item_water_guide_desc.zh: 实用的手册，包含了关于水资源买卖的所有信息。
item_water_guide_desc.en: A handy manual that contains all the information on buying and selling Water.

item_mentor_contract_desc.zh: 你的租约。由你和你的房东共同签署。
item_mentor_contract_desc.en: Your lease. Signed by you, and your Landlord.

item_business_permit_desc.zh: 共和国颁发的许可证，在下层区合法经营商铺的必需品。
item_business_permit_desc.en: A permit issued by the Republic. Required to legally operate a business in the Lower Levels.

item_handnote_desc.en: A simple note, written by hand.

item_scav_token_desc.zh: 拾荒者群体赠予的信物。每向展示柜中放置一枚，都会提升拾荒者前来光顾的几率。
item_scav_token_desc.en: A token given by the Scavenger community. Each token placed in the display case will increase the chance of a Scavenger visit.

item_dossier_desc.zh: 可容纳各种文件、便签、书籍和放大镜。
item_dossier_desc.en: Can hold documents, notes, books and magnifying glasses.

item_trashcan_desc.zh: 里面的物品将在夜间被永久移除——只要你支付了清洁服务费。
item_trashcan_desc.en: Items inside will be permanently removed at night if Janitorial Service is paid.

item_drain_desc.zh: 不想要的水可以倒入此处。
item_drain_desc.en: Unwanted water can be dump here

item_faucet_desc.zh: 没有水……也许有人能帮忙把供水接通？
item_faucet_desc.en: No water... Maybe someone can help connect it to a water line?

item_cmd_keycard_flavor.zh: 万能钥匙卡，仅限空间站指挥人员携带。
item_cmd_keycard_flavor.en: A master keycard, to be carried only by Station Command.

item_cmd_keycard_desc.zh: 供空间站指挥层使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启大多数需要钥匙卡权限的锁。
item_cmd_keycard_desc.en: A single-use keycard for Station Command. Can open most locks that require keycard access.

item_sec_keycard_flavor.zh: 如果落入歹人之手可能会很危险……
item_sec_keycard_flavor.en: Could be dangerous if this falls into the wrong hands...

item_sec_keycard_desc.zh: 供空间站治安部使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要治安部权限的锁。
item_sec_keycard_desc.en: A single-use keycard for Station Security. Can open locks that require Security Department access.

item_sci_keycard_flavor.zh: 空间站研发部官员携带的钥匙卡。非常有价值。
item_sci_keycard_flavor.en: Keycard carried by the Station's Research Officers. Valuable.

item_sci_keycard_desc.zh: 供研发部使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要科研部权限的锁。
item_sci_keycard_desc.en: A single-use keycard for Research and Development. Can open locks that require Science Department access.

item_med_keycard_flavor.zh: 供空间站医疗部使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要医疗权限的锁。
item_med_keycard_flavor.en: A single-use keycard for the Station's Medical Department. Can open locks that require Medical access.

item_eng_keycard_flavor.zh: 供空间站工程部使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要工程权限的锁。
item_eng_keycard_flavor.en: A single-use keycard for the Station's Engineering Department. Can open locks that require Engineer access.

item_sup_keycard_flavor.zh: 供空间站补给部门使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要补给权限的锁。
item_sup_keycard_flavor.en: A single-use keycard for the Station's Supply Department. Can open locks that require Supply access.

item_ser_keycard_flavor.zh: 供空间站服务部门使用的一次性钥匙卡。可开启需要服务权限的锁。
item_ser_keycard_flavor.en: A single-use keycard for the Station's Service Department. Can open locks that require Service access.

item_blank_keycard_flavor.zh: 空间站内最接近万能钥匙的钥匙卡。
item_blank_keycard_flavor.en: As close to a skeleton key as you'll find on the Station.

item_blank_keycard_desc.zh: 未写入数据的钥匙卡。只要有合适的设备，就能为其写入不同的访问权限。
item_blank_keycard_desc.en: An unwritten keycard. With the right machine, this can be reprogrammed with all kinds of access.

item_card_mining_flavor.zh: 已经没人知道GP到底代表什么了。
item_card_mining_flavor.en: No one really know what GP stands for anymore.

item_card_pharma_flavor.zh: 非常简陋的名片，上面只有一个名字和一个电话号码。
item_card_pharma_flavor.en: A very plain card with only a name and a phone number.

item_card_chem_flavor.zh: 真就是张纸条，只不过写了电话号码。
item_card_chem_flavor.en: It really is just a piece a paper with a phone number on it.

item_card_rev_flavor.zh: 简单的绿色名片，上面写着一个电话号码。
item_card_rev_flavor.en: A simple green business card with a phone number on it.

item_sec_slip_desc.zh: 治安部在处理事件后开具的单据。
item_sec_slip_desc.en: A slip given by the Security Department after responding to an incident.

item_food_stamp_desc.zh: 前往配给站兑换以购买食物。
item_food_stamp_desc.en: Redeem it at the Commissary to buy Food.

item_food_stamp_flavor.zh: 仅能用来购买食物的预付卡。是援助下层区弱势群体的福利计划的一部分。
item_food_stamp_flavor.en: A prepaid card valid only to buy groceries. Part of a benefit program to assist the less fortunate in the Lower Levels.

item_scratcher_desc.zh: 刮出至少2个相同的符号即可赢取奖品！
item_scratcher_desc.en: Scratch off at least 2 matching symbols to win a prize!

item_scratcher_flavor.zh: 下层区一种广受欢迎的赌博方式。在上层区则被明文禁止。
item_scratcher_flavor.en: A popular form of gambling in the Lower Levels. It is banned in the Upper Levels.

item_scratcher_stack_desc.zh: 拆包前请确保物品栏有足够的空间。
item_scratcher_stack_desc.en: Make sure to have enough space before unpacking it.

item_scratcher_stack_flavor.zh: 一叠共五张的刮刮乐彩票。
item_scratcher_stack_flavor.en: A stack of five lottery scratch cards.

item_plasma_fuel_desc.zh: 一种紧凑型固态燃料匣，专供星际航行的脉冲等离子引擎使用。其价值因燃料匣的质量不同而差异巨大。
item_plasma_fuel_desc.en: A compact, solid-state fuel cartridge used in Pulse Plasma Drives for space travel. Value varies wildly depending on the quality of the cartridge.

item_storage_bay_desc.zh: 用于存放物品的标准区域。
item_storage_bay_desc.en: A standard bay for storing items.

item_storage_bay_large_desc.zh: 扩建后的物品存放区域。
item_storage_bay_large_desc.en: An expanded bay for storing items.

item_machine_bay_desc.zh: 用于放置机器的标准区域。
item_machine_bay_desc.en: A standard bay for storing machines.

item_machine_bay_ext_desc.zh: 扩建后的机器放置区域。
item_machine_bay_ext_desc.en: A expanded bay for storing machines.

item_smuggler_bay_desc.zh: 经过伪装的小型储藏区，用于在盘查时藏匿物品。
item_smuggler_bay_desc.en: A small disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection.

item_smuggler_bay_mod_desc.zh: 经过伪装的储藏区，用于在盘查时藏匿物品。此暗格经过了改装，可容纳更多物品。
item_smuggler_bay_mod_desc.en: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one has been modified to allow for more storage.

item_powerblock_flavor.zh: 可以为相邻能量电池充电的紧凑型电源。
item_powerblock_flavor.en: A compact power source that can charge adjacent Energy Cells.

item_powerblock_desc.zh: 只要支付了电力服务费，每晚即可为相邻的能量电池，或相邻机器内的能量电池（不包括充能器）恢复+2电量。此效果可叠加。
item_powerblock_desc.en: Restores +2 power each night to adjacent Energy Cells, or Energy Cells inside adjacent Machines (excluding Recharger) as long as the Power Service is paid. This effect can be stacked.

item_blank_module_desc.zh: 一个空白模组。配上合适的机器，即可将其重写为有用的模组。
item_blank_module_desc.en: A blank module. With the right machine, this could rewrite this into something useful.

item_system_module_ruined_desc.zh: 一个完全报废的模组。作为回收物仍有一定价值。可用螺丝刀进行拆解。
item_system_module_ruined_desc.en: A completely ruined module. Still holds some value as salvage. Can be broken down with a Screwdriver.

item_system_module_corrupt_desc.zh: 一个损坏的模组。可以使用电子元件……外加一点技术来修复。
item_system_module_corrupt_desc.en: A corrupted module. Can be restored with Electronic parts... and a little know-how.

item_system_uncapped_neural_core_desc.zh: 性能极高，但不稳定且属于违禁品。这是一个封装在系统模组内的AI核心。这类AI核心有失控暴走的倾向。
item_system_uncapped_neural_core_desc.en: High-performance, but unstable, and illegal. An AI core housed inside a system module. These type of AI core have a tendency to go rogue.

item_system_capped_neural_core_desc.zh: AI核心在空间站上属于违禁品。该装置内置了安全防护机制，在限制其失控行为的同时，也限制了它的性能。
item_system_capped_neural_core_desc.en: AI Cores are illegal onboard the Station. This unit features integrated safeguards that curb rogue behavior, while throttling its performance.

item_crypto_module_cmd_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将指挥权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_cmd_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Command permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_crypto_module_sec_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将治安权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_sec_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Security permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_crypto_module_med_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将医疗权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_med_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Medical permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_crypto_module_eng_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将工程权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_eng_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Engineering permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_crypto_module_sup_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将补给权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_sup_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Supply permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_crypto_module_ser_desc.zh: 一个能让密码解序器将服务权限写入空白钥匙卡的模组。
item_crypto_module_ser_desc.en: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Service permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_farm_module_hydroreed_filter_desc.zh: 一个允许收割成熟的水培芦苇的茎秆以将其用作滤水器的模组。对其他植物无效。
item_farm_module_hydroreed_filter_desc.en: A Module that allows the stem of a grown Hydroreed to be harvested and used as a water filter. Does not affect other plants.

item_alarm_module_transmitter_desc.zh: 当前正在传输至：{0}\n向同一派系重复传输不会产生额外效果。
item_alarm_module_transmitter_desc.en: Currently Transmitting To: {0} \n Transmitting twice to the same faction has no additional effect.

item_alarm_module_transmitter_flavor.zh: 该模组会将你的摄像头拍到的监控录像传输给指定的派系。
item_alarm_module_transmitter_flavor.en: This module will transmit security camera footage captured by your cameras to the set faction.

item_furnace_module_blast_desc.zh: 一种改造熔炉的特殊模组，允许以{0}材料制作{1}金属锭（纯度略低）。不可叠加。
item_furnace_module_blast_desc.en: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing {0} Materials to create {1} Metal Ingots (at slightly lower purity). Does not stack.

item_furnace_module_junk_desc.zh: 一种改造熔炉的特殊模组，允许将垃圾处理成废金属。
item_furnace_module_junk_desc.en: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing Junk to be processed into Scrap Metal.

item_module_extractor_desc.zh: 允许你将卡住的模组从机器中取出而避免造成损坏。可使用{0}次。可以使用电子元件进行部分翻修。
item_module_extractor_desc.en: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. Has {0} uses. Can be partially refurbished with Electronic Parts.

item_module_extractor_advanced_desc.zh: 允许你将卡住的模组从机器中取出而避免造成损坏。这款高级型号在使用时不会产生损耗。
item_module_extractor_advanced_desc.en: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. This advanced model will not degrade with use.

item_module_bay_expansion_kit_desc.zh: 允许你扩展机器模组容量的一次性套件。此套件与化学或其他特殊机器不兼容。
item_module_bay_expansion_kit_desc.en: A one time use kit that will allow you to expand Machine's Module capacity. This kit is not compatible with Chemical or other special Machines.

item_node_desc.zh: 一种专用电路，安装在特定机器中时，可提供或接收相邻模组的加成效果。
item_node_desc.en: A specialized circuit that can provide or receive bonuses from adjacent Modules when installed in certain Machines.

item_processed_milk_flavor.zh: 一盒加工奶，或者说，一种甜味的碳酸“乳基”饮料。味道意外地还不错。
item_processed_milk_flavor.en: A carton of processed milk, or rather, a sweet, carbonated 'milk-based' beverage. Tastes better than you'd expect.

item_processed_juice_desc.zh: 一盒加工果汁。所有的天然糖分都已被提取出来，换成了精制糖。含有0.1%的真果汁！
item_processed_juice_desc.en: A carton of processed juice. All the natural sugars have been extracted and replaced with refined sugars. Contains 0.1% real fruit juice!

item_processed_meat_desc.zh: 一罐达夫雷公司生产的咸味合成肉。它便宜、容易买到而且管饱。只要你不在乎它是用什么肉做的。
item_processed_meat_desc.en: A can of salty processed meat made by Davre. It is cheap, available and filling. As long as one does not care about what type of meat it is made of.

item_bottled_water_premium_desc.zh: 一瓶密封的水，据说取自一个遥远且未受任何工业活动污染的星球上的天然活泉。
item_bottled_water_premium_desc.en: A sealed bottle of water supposedly drawn from a natural spring on a distant planet untouched by any industrial activity.

item_bottled_water_premium_flavor.zh: 哪怕渴到奄奄一息，下层区的人也绝对不会喝这种水，毕竟它的价格摆在那里。
item_bottled_water_premium_flavor.en: No one in the Lower Levels would drink this, even if they were dying of thirst, such is its value.

item_red_beer_flavor.zh: 下层区酿造的畅销啤酒。虽说每批的口味都不太一样，但这绝对是最便宜的酒了。酒精度3.5%。
item_red_beer_flavor.en: A popular beer brewed in the Lower Levels. Every batch tastes a bit different, but there is nothing cheaper. 3.5% ABV.

item_empty_beer_bottle_desc.zh: 一滴都不剩了。为防止浪费，酿酒厂一般都有针对空瓶的“回购”业务。
item_empty_beer_bottle_desc.en: Not a drop left. To prevent waste, brewers typically offer some kind of "buyback" program for their bottles.

item_soda_red_desc.zh: 甜味碳酸饮料。在空间站的某些区域，它甚至比干净的水还要便宜。
item_soda_red_desc.en: A sweet carbonated beverage. On some parts of the Station, it's cheaper than clean water.

item_nudka_desc.zh: 由营养果酿制而成的烈性酒。最初是作为重型脱漆剂而研发的。
item_nudka_desc.en: A strong spirit made from Nutrifruit. Originally developed to be a heavy-duty paint stripper.

item_galaxy_blend_flavor.zh: 由帕斯泰尔公司的营养果制成，并额外添加了维生素和矿物质的营养糊。下层区能买到的最健康、但也最不受欢迎的食物之一。
item_galaxy_blend_flavor.en: A nutritious puree made from pastel Inc.'s Nutrifruit and fortified with additional vitamins and minerals. One of the healthiest, and least popular foods available in the Lower Levels.

item_cat_bar_flavor.zh: 裹着巧克力的威化棒。虽然设计初衷是为了分享，但大多都是被一个人孤独地吃掉。
item_cat_bar_flavor.en: A chocolate-covered wafer bar. Made to share, mostly eaten alone.

item_li_eat_snackbar_desc.zh: 高蛋白巧克力味糖果棒。
item_li_eat_snackbar_desc.en: A high protein chocolate flavored candy bar.

item_small_raw_meat_desc.en: A small piece of raw meat.

item_small_raw_meat_flavor.zh: 新鲜肉类在下层区难得一见，至于它是从哪里来的，不太会有人在乎。
item_small_raw_meat_flavor.en: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

item_raw_meat_flavor.zh: 新鲜肉类在下层区难得一见，至于它是从哪里来的，不太会有人在乎。
item_raw_meat_flavor.en: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

item_fat_meat_desc.zh: 一磅板油。价格低廉，通常用于熬制成动物油或给肉汤增添风味。
item_fat_meat_desc.en: A pound of suet. Cheap, and commonly used for rendering into tallow, or adding flavor to broths.

item_meat_scrap_desc.zh: 器官、肠子、软骨和边角料。虽然可食用且有营养，但一向不招大多数菜系待见。
item_meat_scrap_desc.en: Organs, entrails, cartilage and trimming. While comestible and nutritious, is considered undesirable by most cuisines.

item_cup_noodle_desc.zh: 内含一次性无明火加热器。只需加水即可加热烹饪。
item_cup_noodle_desc.en: Contains a single use, flameless heater. Just add water for cooking.

item_cup_noodle_flavor.zh: 人工红烧牛肉风味，公认的下层区经典美食。味精、白胡椒和四川花椒赋予了这款方便面辛辣的刺激。
item_cup_noodle_flavor.en: Artificial Braised Beef Flavored. A certified Lower Levels classic. MSG, white pepper and Sichuan peppercorns give this instant noodle a spicy kick.

item_water_ration_desc.zh: 可倒入液体容器中，转化为750毫升的基础水。
item_water_ration_desc.en: Can be poured into a liquid container for 750ml of Basewater.

item_water_ration_small_desc.zh: 可倒入液体容器中，转化为375毫升的基础水。
item_water_ration_small_desc.en: Can be poured into a liquid container for 375ml of Basewater.

item_security_alarm_flavor.zh: 一套智能安全警报系统，配备了一整套传感器，并且能连接到前任店主安装的摄像头上。
item_security_alarm_flavor.en: A smart security alarm system, equipped with a suite of sensors and connects to cameras installed by the previous owner.

item_security_alarm_desc.zh: 极大降低夜间发生盗窃的几率。需要专门的电源才能运作。
item_security_alarm_desc.en: Greatly reduces the chance of theft during the night. Requires a dedicated power source to function.

item_alarm_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响防盗率加成
质量无影响
item_alarm_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Prevention Rate Bonus
  Quality: No Effect

item_desequencer_flavor.zh: 可用于将各种权限写入空白钥匙卡中。
item_desequencer_flavor.en: Can be used to write various permissions to Blank Keycards.

item_desequencer_desc.zh: 需要一块解序器芯片和一张识别卡。需要能量。彻夜工作。
item_desequencer_desc.en: Requires a Desequencer Chip and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.

item_desequencer_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响速度
质量无影响
插入解序器和识别卡。需要能量。耗时一夜。
item_desequencer_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Speed
  Quality: No Effect
Insert a Desequencer Chip, and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.

item_furnace_desc.zh: 将2块废金属或金属矿石提炼成金属锭。需要能量。夜间运行。
item_furnace_desc.en: Refines 2 pieces of either metal scrap or ores into a metal ingot. Requires Energy. Overnight.

item_furnace_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能无影响
质量影响纯度上限
item_furnace_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: No Effect
  Quality: Maximum Purity

item_furnace_instruction_short.zh: 放入（2）块金属矿石或废金属，生产（1）块金属锭。金属锭的质量取决于所用材料的纯度。使用矿石冶炼出的纯度会高于使用废金属。夜间运行。
item_furnace_instruction_short.en: Insert (2) Metal Ore or Scrap Metal to produce (1) Metal Ingot. The quality of the ingot is determined by the purity of the materials used. Using ore results in a higher purity than scrap. Overnight.

item_bottle_printer_flavor.zh: 预设了程序的3D打印机，能够制造小型水瓶。
item_bottle_printer_flavor.en: A pre-programmed 3D printer that is capable of creating small Water Bottles.

item_recharger_desc.zh: 能量电池的充电设备。只要支付了电力服务费，就会缓慢地为能量电池充电。夜间运行。
item_recharger_desc.en: A device for recharging Energy Cell. Will slowly recharge an Energy Cell as long as the power service has been paid. Overnight.

item_mirage_projector_flavor.zh: 一种精密的设备，能投射出迷人的全息投影，使你的店铺对顾客更具吸引力。
item_mirage_projector_flavor.en: A sophisticated device that emits captivating holographic projections, making your Store more attractive to customers.

item_mirage_projector_desc.zh: 需要充电一晚，但会在第二天提高你店铺的临街吸引力。
item_mirage_projector_desc.en: Requires a night to charge, but improves the street attractiveness of your Store on the next day.

item_projector_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响吸引力（系数：0.25）
质量影响吸引力（系数：0.5）
item_projector_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance (0.25 Ratio): Attractiveness
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Attractiveness

item_moisture_farm_flavor.zh: 一种用于从空间站潮湿环境空气中提取水分的机器。
item_moisture_farm_flavor.en: A machine designed to extract Water from the humid ambient air of the Station.

item_moisture_farm_desc.zh: 放入容器后即可产出水。需要能量。夜间运行。
item_moisture_farm_desc.en: Produces Water when provided with a container. Requires Energy. Overnight.

item_moisture_farm_instruction_short.zh: 此机器通过从大气中收集水分来生产水，并将其储存在所提供的容器中。需要能量充足的电源。此过程耗时一整夜。此机器可通过模组进行升级。
item_moisture_farm_instruction_short.en: This machine produces Water by harvesting it from the atmosphere, and deposits it into a provided container. Requires a power source with enough energy. This is an overnight process. This machine can be improved with Modules.

item_moisture_farm_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响产量
质量影响纯度
item_moisture_farm_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Volume Produced
  Quality: Purity

item_water_purifier_flavor.zh: 利用反渗透技术净化水的机器。
item_water_purifier_flavor.en: A machine that uses reverse osmosis to purify Water.

item_water_purifier_desc.zh: 净化置入储水容器中的内容物。需要能量。用于为能量电池充电的设备。夜间运行。
item_water_purifier_desc.en: Purifies the contents of an inserted Water container. Requires Energy. Overnight.

item_water_purifier_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响每晚去除量
质量影响纯度上限（系数：0.5）
item_water_purifier_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Amount Removed Per Night
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Maximum Purity

item_water_purifier_instruction_short.zh: 这台机器可以净化放入容器中的水，对污染严重的水尤其有效。运行时需要有充足的电源，净化过程在夜间进行。安装模组可以提升机器性能。
item_water_purifier_instruction_short.en: This machine purifies Water inside a provided container. Significantly more effective for highly contaminated Water. Requires a power source with enough energy. This is an overnight process. This machine can be improved with Modules.

item_used_water_testing_strip_desc.zh: 一张已使用过的水质检测试纸。
item_used_water_testing_strip_desc.en: A used water quality testing strip.

item_nutrifruit_desc.zh: 营养果由帕斯泰尔公司研发，是一种经过大幅改造的块茎作物，抗病抗虫、成本低、产量高，又容易种植。它营养丰富，却被刻意改造成了无籽品种。
item_nutrifruit_desc.en: Created by pastel Inc., the Nutrifruit is a highly modified tuber that is resistant to pests and diseases. It is cheap, has a high yield and is easy to grow, extremely nutritious, but purposefully seedless.

item_nutrifruit_seed_desc.zh: 一种经过基因改造的块茎作物，生命力顽强、生长迅速。生长过程中需要营养和水。
item_nutrifruit_seed_desc.en: A tuber, genetically modified to be hardy and fast growing. Requires nutrients and water to grow.

item_kotton_seed_desc.zh: 一种难以种植的种子，播种后可产出更多韧棉纤维。这是一种经过改造的棉花，可编织成耐用的布料。
item_kotton_seed_desc.en: A hard to grow seed that can be planted to grow more Kotton Fiber. It is a modified Cotton that can be woven into a durable fabric.

item_processed_cheese_flavor.zh: 奶酪上钻了孔以模仿经典的造型，顺便还能降低生产成本。
item_processed_cheese_flavor.en: Holes are drilled into the cheese for the classic look, whilst also cutting production costs.

husbandry_vacuum_robot_desc.zh: 每晚自动收集周围的动物粪便，也可手动启动，立即进行一次清理。
husbandry_vacuum_robot_desc.en: Automatically collects Animal Feces from its surroundings during the night. Can also be activated manually for an immediate cleanup.

husbandry_serum_red_desc.zh: 这种血清会略微提高动物的生长速度，代价是饥饿感增加且免疫力降低。
husbandry_serum_red_desc.en: This serum will slightly boost an animal's growth rate, but at the cost of increased hunger and reduced immunity.

husbandry_serum_green_desc.zh: 这种血清会略微提高动物的免疫力，但代价是使其饥饿感增加。
husbandry_serum_green_desc.en: This serum will slightly boost an animal's immunity but at the cost of increased hunger

livestock_feed_dispenser_desc.zh: 能够将食物加工成牲畜卡路里储备的设备。
livestock_feed_dispenser_desc.en: A machine that blends food into stored calories for livestock.

item_nutrient_tablet_container_desc.zh: 装有水培营养片的瓶子。
item_nutrient_tablet_container_desc.en: A bottle containing hydroponic nutrient tablets

item_nutrient_tablet_container_flavor.zh: 严禁吞食。仅限水培农业使用。
item_nutrient_tablet_container_flavor.en: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

item_glock_receiver_desc.zh: 性能可靠的10毫米口径手枪，主要由治安部人员携带。
item_glock_receiver_desc.en: A reliable handgun, chambered in 10mm. Mostly carried by Security

item_heavy_pistol_ammo_p_flavor.zh: 少量10毫米口径的高速脱壳穿甲弹（APDS）。能够击穿防弹衣。
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_p_flavor.en: A handful of high velocity 10mm Armor-Piercing Discarding Sabot (APDS) ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

item_fanta_pill_desc.zh: 一种极易成瘾、极度危险且廉价的合成阿片类药物，常用于治疗剧烈疼痛。
item_fanta_pill_desc.en: An extremely addictive, dangerous and cheap synthetic opioid drug used for treatment of severe pain.

item_fanta_pill_flavor.zh: 药效比奥克西莫强50倍以上。
item_fanta_pill_flavor.en: More than 50 times stronger than Oxymore.

item_intel_sec_flavor.zh: 治安部针对你个人的档案副本。
item_intel_sec_flavor.en: A copy of your security record file from the Security Department

item_intel_sec_desc.zh: 你的联系人会随时更新此份档案。
item_intel_sec_desc.en: Your contact will keep this up to date

item_logo_checker_desc.zh: 用于参考比对共和国的官方标志。
item_logo_checker_desc.en: A reference for the Official Republic Logo.

item_fillerweed_seed_desc.zh: 一种适合新手的速生种子，其生长不受营养物质或水质的影响。
item_fillerweed_seed_desc.en: A beginner-friendly, fast-growing seed that is not affected by nutrient or water quality.

item_aug_scanner_flavor.zh: 一种极度耗电的电磁场探测器，经过微调以捕捉改造芯片的独特特征信号。
item_aug_scanner_flavor.en: An energy hungry electromagnetic field detector fine tuned to pick up on the unique signatures of the Augmentation chip.

item_aug_scanner_desc.zh: 用于以100%的准确率确认疑似改造体的身份。
item_aug_scanner_desc.en: Used to confirm the presence of a suspected Aug with 100% accuracy.

item_surgery_tool_flavor.zh: 一套高质量的外科手术工具。
item_surgery_tool_flavor.en: A set of high quality surgery tools.

item_genetic_scanner_desc.zh: 开启后可查看动物的完整基因信息。
item_genetic_scanner_desc.en: Can be toggled on to reveal the full genetic makeup of an animal.

item_water_ration_flavor.zh: 已通过认证并密封的一份配给基础水。
item_water_ration_flavor.en: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

item_water_ration_small_flavor.zh: 已通过认证并密封的一份配给基础水。
item_water_ration_small_flavor.en: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

item_sign_generic_desc.zh: 将其放置在展示柜中，可吸引出售{0}的顾客
item_sign_generic_desc.en: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell {0}

husbandry_mouse_trap_flavor.zh: 在里面放些奶酪应该会更好用。
husbandry_mouse_trap_flavor.en: Putting some cheese inside will probably help.

item_hand_guide_desc.zh: 用来给仿生机械手精准估价的指南。
item_hand_guide_desc.en: A guide for determining the appropriate value of cybernetic hands.

item_hand_flavor.zh: 生物机械工程的奇迹，旨在完美再现它所取代的人手的外形与功能。
item_hand_flavor.en: A marvel of biomechanical engineering, designed to mirror the form and function of the hand it replaces.

item_wine_yeast_flavor.zh: 一种用途广泛的酵母菌种，从发酵面包到酿酒无所不能。用于酿酒时，它能加速发酵过程并提升酒的品质。
item_wine_yeast_flavor.en: A versatile yeast culture with countless uses, from leavening bread to brewing. For winemaking, it speeds up fermentation and improves the quality of the brew.

item_wine_superyeast_flavor.zh: 一种效力极强、用途广泛的酵母菌种，在无数工艺中备受推崇。用于酿酒时，它能大幅加速发酵过程。
item_wine_superyeast_flavor.en: A highly potent, all-purpose yeast culture prized across countless crafts. For winemaking, it dramatically speeds up the fermentation process.

item_wine_yeast_infinite_desc.zh: 酵母的无限来源。发酵开始时将返回物品栏，而不会被消耗。
item_wine_yeast_infinite_desc.en: An infinite source of yeast. Will be returned to inventory when fermentation starts instead of being consumed.

item_wine_yeast_infinite_flavor.zh: 一个能够自我维持并不断重新生长出酵母的培养缸。
item_wine_yeast_infinite_flavor.en: A self-sustaining culture vat that continuously regrows its own yeast.

item_wine_bottle_desc.zh: 用于发酵葡萄酒的精致玻璃瓶。此酒瓶带有内置的气塞。
item_wine_bottle_desc.en: A fancy glass bottle used for fermenting wine. This one has a integrated airlock.

item_wine_berry_flavor.zh: 一种经改良以适应水培生长的甜浆果。虽然不太能填饱肚子，但它是下层区少数能弄到的水果之一。很适合用来酿酒。
item_wine_berry_flavor.en: A sweet berry modified for hydroponic growth. While not particularly filling, it's one of few fruits that is accessible in the Lower Levels. Good for making wine.

item_age_well_desc.zh: 加速置于其中的特定物品的陈化过程。每个周期可使葡萄酒、奶酪等物品额外陈化一天。
item_age_well_desc.en: Accelerates the aging process of certain items inside. Ages items such as Wine and Cheese by an extra day each cycle.

item_age_well_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响功耗
质量：每125质量额外陈化1天
在提供电力和一瓶已发酵完成的葡萄酒时会彻夜工作。
item_age_well_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Power Consumption
  Quality: +1 Day age per 125 Quality
Works overnight when power and a finished bottle of wine are provided.

item_wine_bloomberry_desc.zh: 在上层区和下层区都很受欢迎的含酒精饮料。将不起眼的荧光莓酿成极品佳酿被认为是一门艺术。
item_wine_bloomberry_desc.en: A popular alcoholic beverage in both the Upper and Lower Levels. Coaxing a fine vintage out of humble BloomBerries is considered an art.

item_wine_gloomberry_desc.zh: 看起来像自酿的荧光莓果酿，但这玩意儿很便宜，而且带有轻微的致癌性。
item_wine_gloomberry_desc.en: Looks like a Homebrew BloomBerry wine but this one is cheap and mildly carcinogenic.

item_wine_yeast_red_desc.zh: 一种非法物质，可以用来代替酵母，以极其廉价的方式生产带有轻微致癌性的酒。只需加水即可。
item_wine_yeast_red_desc.en: An illegal substance that can be used instead of yeast to cheaply produce mildly carcinogenic wine. Requires only water.

item_water_filter_adv_desc.zh: 在每天开始时将恢复50点耐久度。
item_water_filter_adv_desc.en: Will recover 50 durability at the start of each day.

item_water_filter_adv_flavor.zh: 上层区水壶使用的优质滤水器。能够缓慢地进行自我清洁。
item_water_filter_adv_flavor.en: A premium water filter for pitchers used in the Upper Levels. Slowly self-cleans.

item_portable_water_purifier_name.zh: 海德拉科技微型净水器

item_portable_water_purifier_desc.zh: 对水容器使用，无论内容物是什么，都能将其纯度提升至基础水级别。每净化100毫升将消耗1点耐久度。
item_portable_water_purifier_desc.en: Use on a water container to bring its contents up to Basewater purity, whatever's in it. It will use 1 durability per 100ml.

item_portable_water_purifier_flavor.zh: 在上层区很常见的抛弃式高级净水器。被丢弃后，会被冲刷到垃圾场里，还能勉强再过滤几次。
item_portable_water_purifier_flavor.en: A disposable advanced water purifier, common in the Upper Levels. The discarded ones wash up in the Dumping Grounds, still good for a few more pours.

item_black_lamp_desc.zh: 将其放置在展示柜中时，它会向小偷发出信号，表明这家店可以销赃。你的黑市声望将影响他们予以响应的可能性。
item_black_lamp_desc.en: When placed in the display case, it signals thieves that this shop fences stolen goods. Your Black Market reputation affects how likely they are to respond.

item_ribwich_guide_desc.zh: 一本实用指南，可帮助准确鉴定肋明治的价值。
item_ribwich_guide_desc.en: A handy guide that helps with determining the correct value of a Ribwich.

item_ribwich_desc.zh: 一款可常温保存的限量版三明治，夹着一块由重组无骨猪肉制成、形似迷你肋排的肉饼，深受一小群忠实拥趸追捧。
item_ribwich_desc.en: A shelf stable limited edition sandwich consists of a restructured boneless pork patty shaped like a miniature rack of ribs. It has a cult following.

item_scav_journal_flavor.zh: '   我已经深入废弃区。空间站的其他地方早被搜刮得一干二净，可这里……不一样。那些传闻我都听过，不过到目前为止，找到的东西确实不错。只是空气中始终笼罩着一种诡异的压迫感，仿佛有什么看不见的东西正潜伏在视线之外。'
item_scav_journal_flavor.en: '   Here I am, deep in the Abandoned Sections. Everywhere else on the station has been picked clean, but this place... it''s different. I''ve heard the stories, but so far, the loot''s been good. Still, there''s an eerie weight in the air, like something unseen is lurking just out of sight.'

item_skincare_cream_flavor.zh: 一只流线型玻璃罐，内盛微光闪烁的精华液。
item_skincare_cream_flavor.en: A sleek glass jar containing a shimmering serum.

item_skincare_cream_desc.zh: 备受追捧的奢华精华液，所用干细胞均来自符合伦理规范的渠道，可焕活并修复肌肤。
item_skincare_cream_desc.en: A sought-after luxurious serum designed to rejuvenate and restore skin using ethically sourced stem cells.

item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_desc.zh: 含有植物生长所必需的矿物质，可加入水容器中。
item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_desc.en: Contains minerals that are essential for plant growth. Can be added to a water container.

item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_flavor.zh: 严禁食用。仅限水培使用。
item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_flavor.en: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

item_hydroreed_filter_desc.zh: 装入过滤系统后，可去除特定类型的污染物。
item_hydroreed_filter_desc.en: Remove certain type of contaminants when used inside a filter system

item_hydroreed_filter_flavor.zh: 由水培芦苇培育而成的生物滤芯。
item_hydroreed_filter_flavor.en: A biological filter grown from Hydroreed.

item_lottery_ticket_desc.zh: 每周六上午公布中奖号码。
item_lottery_ticket_desc.en: The winning numbers are revealed each Saturday morning.

item_lottery_ticket_flavor.zh: 如果中了头奖，足以让你在安全舒适的上层区度过余生。
item_lottery_ticket_flavor.en: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

item_lottery_ticket_old_desc.zh: 一张毫无价值的下层区旧彩票。没有中奖号码，只有褪色的希望。
item_lottery_ticket_old_desc.en: A worthless ticket from the Lower Levels Lottery. No winning numbers, just faded hope.

item_lottery_ticket_old_flavor.zh: 一张中了头奖的彩票，足以让你在安全舒适的上层区度过余生。
item_lottery_ticket_old_flavor.en: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

item_xray_scanner_desc.zh: 可用于查看密封容器内的物品。
item_xray_scanner_desc.en: Can be use to see what's inside sealed containers.

item_sign_expedition_desc.zh: 将其放入展示柜，可吸引待招募的新雇工前来，并召集已准备好出发探险的现有雇工。
item_sign_expedition_desc.en: Place it in the display case to attract new hirelings for hire and current hirelings ready for expedition.

item_backpack_large_military_desc.zh: 专为军事用途设计的重型背包。面料极其耐用，有些士兵会在战斗中将其背在胸前，充当额外护甲。
item_backpack_large_military_desc.en: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

item_internal_springs_desc.zh: 一套先进的内部弹簧，可改善枪机循环，并提高枪械在高负荷状态下的可靠性。
item_internal_springs_desc.en: A set of advanced internal springs that improve the cycling and resistance to failure under stress.

item_trigger_group_desc.zh: 一套可改善扳机手感的扳机组件，能够减轻扣压重量并缩短空行程。
item_trigger_group_desc.en: A trigger group that improves the trigger pull. Reduces trigger pull weight and creep.

item_match_barrel_desc.zh: 可提高射击精度的高精度枪管。
item_match_barrel_desc.en: A high precision barrel that improves accuracy.

item_pistol_switch_desc.zh: 一种特殊的手枪改装件。安装后会改变枪械内部机构，使其在持续扣住扳机时连续射击。
item_pistol_switch_desc.en: A special handgun mod. When installed, it alters the internal mechanics so that the gun fires continuously as long as the trigger is held down.

item_ammo_display_desc.zh: 可显示当前弹药数量和类型的智能显示器。
item_ammo_display_desc.en: A smart display that shows the current ammo count and ammo type.

item_grip_gel_desc.zh: 位于握把表面下方的生物反应凝胶，能细致贴合使用者的手形。
item_grip_gel_desc.en: Bio-reactive gel under grip surface conforms subtly to user's hand.

item_rds_desc.zh: 一款老式紧凑型红点瞄准镜，便于快速瞄准目标。
item_rds_desc.en: A legacy compact red dot sight for quick target acquisition.

item_rds_makeshift_desc.zh: 一款3D打印的红点瞄准镜，配有红色LED和塑料镜片。可靠性不高，但效果出奇地不错。
item_rds_makeshift_desc.en: A 3D printed RDS with a red LED and plastic lens. It is not very reliable, but it works surprising well.

item_silencer_desc.zh: 一款简易的多口径消音器，可降低枪声，使开火更难被察觉。
item_silencer_desc.en: A simple multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

item_silencer2_desc.zh: 一款精密的多口径消音器，可降低枪声，使开火更难被察觉。
item_silencer2_desc.en: A sophisticated multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

item_silencer_makeshift_desc.zh: 用塑料瓶和废金属拼成的简易消音器。
item_silencer_makeshift_desc.en: A makeshift suppressor made from a plastic bottle and scrap metal.

item_barrel_desc.zh: 一款多口径加长枪管，可提高弹丸初速和射击精度。
item_barrel_desc.en: A multi-caliber extended barrel that improve bullet velocity and accuracy.

item_compensator_desc.zh: 一种枪口装置，通过改变火药燃气的逸出方向来降低射击时的枪口上跳。
item_compensator_desc.en: A muzzle device that reduce muzzle rise when firing by redirecting escaping gases

item_laser_desc.zh: 一款简易激光瞄准器，可向目标投射光束，改善枪械操控性。
item_laser_desc.en: A simple laser sight that projects a beam onto the target, improving ergonomic.

item_laser2_desc.zh: 一种智能战术装置，可根据多种条件向目标投射光束。
item_laser2_desc.en: A smart tactical device that projects a beam onto the target based on various conditions.

item_laser_toy_desc.zh: 一支低功率玩具激光笔。
item_laser_toy_desc.en: A low powered toy laser pointer.

item_bipod_desc.zh: 可安装在枪械上以增强稳定性的两脚架。
item_bipod_desc.en: A bipod that can be attached to firearms, providing stability.

item_gl_desc.zh: 一款紧凑型25毫米下挂式榴弹发射器。

item_mag_10mm_desc.zh: 可容纳9发10毫米弹药的紧凑型弹匣。

item_mag_10mm_high_desc.zh: 可容纳14发10毫米弹药的大容量弹匣。

item_mag_10mm_ext_desc.zh: 可容纳19发10毫米弹药的加长弹匣。

item_mag_10mm_smg_desc.zh: 专为“和平使者”重型冲锋枪制造的20发装10毫米弹匣。
item_mag_10mm_smg_desc.en: A 20 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

item_mag_10mm_smg_high_name.zh: 大容量10毫米冲锋枪弹匣

item_mag_10mm_smg_high_desc.zh: 专为“和平使者”重型冲锋枪制造的35发装10毫米弹匣。
item_mag_10mm_smg_high_desc.en: A 35 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

item_mag_10mm_smg_box_desc.zh: 专为“和平使者”重型冲锋枪制造的150发装10毫米箱式弹匣。
item_mag_10mm_smg_box_desc.en: A 150 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

item_mag_22_desc.zh: 廉价的3D打印紧凑型.22弹匣，容量12发。
item_mag_22_desc.en: A cheap 3D printed 12 round compact .22 magazine.

item_mag_22_high_desc.zh: 廉价的3D打印紧凑型.22弹匣，容量24发。

item_mag_22_ext_desc.zh: 廉价的3D打印紧凑型.22弹匣，容量48发。

item_stock_desc.zh: 适配子午线兵工枪械的坚固枪托，旨在改善后坐力控制。
item_stock_desc.en: A sturdy stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil handling.

item_short_stock_desc.zh: 适配子午线兵工枪械的短枪托，可在不牺牲操控性的前提下改善后坐力控制。
item_short_stock_desc.en: A short stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil control without sacrificing ergonomic.

item_gun_part_desc.zh: 用螺丝刀拆解枪械获得。可用于翻新二手枪械，反复尝试会提高翻新成功率。
item_gun_part_desc.en: Obtained from disassembling firearm with a screwdriver. Can be used to refurbish used firearms. Repeated attempts will increase refurbish chance.

item_gun_part_flavor.zh: 一批枪械内部零件，包括螺丝、弹簧及其他小型部件。
item_gun_part_flavor.en: A collection of internal gun parts, including screws, springs, and other small components.

item_printed_gun_desc.zh: 一把低成本的塑料制3D打印手枪。
item_printed_gun_desc.en: A low cost plastic 3D printed pistol.

item_printed_gun_flavor.zh: 找不到比这更便宜的了。开上几枪还是没问题的。
item_printed_gun_flavor.en: Doesn't get cheaper than this. It's good for a few shots.

item_handmade_pistol_desc.zh: 一把采用.22 SR弹药的小型开源手枪。
item_handmade_pistol_desc.en: A small open-sourced pistol chambered in .22 SR

item_handmade_pistol_flavor.zh: 在下层区广泛用于居家防卫，治安部通常对此睁一只眼闭一只眼。大概出自某位下层区枪械师之手。
item_handmade_pistol_flavor.en: Widely used for home defence in the Lower Level. Mostly tolerated by Security. Probably handmade by a Lower Level gunsmith.

item_heavy_handmade_pistol_desc.zh: 一把采用10毫米弹药的重型开源手枪。
item_heavy_handmade_pistol_desc.en: A heavy open-sourced pistol chambered in 10mm

item_heavy_handmade_pistol_flavor.zh: 能够击穿防弹衣，是下层区革命者青睐的武器。
item_heavy_handmade_pistol_flavor.en: Capable of piercing body armor. A popular weapon for Lower Level Revolutionary.

item_smg_desc.zh: 一把采用10毫米弹药的重型冲锋枪。治安部只在高风险行动中偶尔使用。
item_smg_desc.en: A heavy SMG, chambered in 10mm. Used sparingly by Security during high stakes operations.

item_shotgun_desc.zh: 一款专为执法机构打造、可靠且适应性强的霰弹枪。其双动式机构能确保使用多种弹药时均可靠运作。
item_shotgun_desc.en: A dependable and adaptable shotgun built for law enforcement, featuring a dual-action mechanism that ensures reliable performance with a wide range of ammunition types.

item_stun_gun_flavor.zh: 做工精良、经治安部正式认可的自卫武器。由于价格高昂，主要由上层区居民使用。
item_stun_gun_flavor.en: A well made self-defence option officially endorsed by Security. Mostly used by Upper Level due to high cost.

item_revolver_desc.zh: 一把枪管长5英寸、采用.45 AFP弹药的兰斯维尔通用左轮手枪。
item_revolver_desc.en: A 5" general purpose Lancewell revolver chambered in .45 AFP.

item_revolver_flavor.zh: 结构简单且极其可靠，设计上可承受极端环境，同时只需极少维护。
item_revolver_flavor.en: A simple and highly reliable weapon. Designed to endure extreme conditions, while requiring minimum maintenance.

item_small_pistol_ammo_flavor.zh: 少量.22 SR弹药。弹丸虽小，近距离仍可致命。最重要的是，它非常便宜。
item_small_pistol_ammo_flavor.en: A handful of .22 SR ammo. While small, it still can be lethal at close range. Most importantly, it is very cheap.

item_small_pistol_ammo_p_flavor.zh: 少量.22 SR穿甲弹，能够击穿防弹衣。
item_small_pistol_ammo_p_flavor.en: A handful of .22 SR Armor-Piercing ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

item_small_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor.zh: 少量.22 SR非致命弹。采用橡胶弹头，旨在使目标失去行动能力。
item_small_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor.en: A handful of .22 SR Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

item_heavy_pistol_ammo_flavor.zh: 少量10毫米弹药。威力强大且性能可靠，是重型手枪的标准弹药。
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_flavor.en: A handful of 10mm ammo. Powerful and reliable, it is the standard round for heavy pistols.

item_heavy_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor.zh: 少量10毫米非致命弹。采用橡胶弹头，旨在使目标失去行动能力。
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor.en: A handful of 10mm Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

item_phagimycin_pill_flavor.zh: 一种用噬菌体和真菌制成的强效抗生素，用于应对抗生素耐药性。
item_phagimycin_pill_flavor.en: A powerful antibiotic made with bacteriophages and fungi to counter antibiotic resistance.

item_unlicensed_phagimycin_pill_flavor.zh: 一种强效抗生素。这批药由地下实验室非法生产，未经卡迈克尔专利许可。
item_unlicensed_phagimycin_pill_flavor.en: A powerful antibiotic. This one is made illegaly without license to the carmicheal's patent in an underground lab.

item_zyanide_pill_desc.zh: 一种起效迅速且致命的化合物。请谨慎处理。
item_zyanide_pill_desc.en: A fast-acting and deadly chemical compound. Handle with caution.

item_chem_scanner_desc.zh: 用于分析物质化学成分的设备。
item_chem_scanner_desc.en: A device used to analyze the chemical composition of substances.

item_hydroponic_guide_desc.zh: 一本实用手册，收录了水培农业的全部相关知识。
item_hydroponic_guide_desc.en: A handy manual that contains all the information on hydroponic farming.

item_chemistry_guide_desc.zh: 一本实用手册，收录了化学基础知识。
item_chemistry_guide_desc.en: A handy manual that contains the basics of chemistry.

item_permit_gun_1_desc.zh: 放入展示柜后，可提高枪械买家到访的概率。若治安部声望低于0，此许可证将被吊销。
item_permit_gun_1_desc.en: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 0.

item_permit_gun_1_flavor.zh: 由治安总监签发的许可证，允许持证人合法持有并交易低级违禁枪械与弹药。
item_permit_gun_1_flavor.en: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition.

item_permit_gun_2_desc.zh: 放入展示柜后，可提高枪械买家到访的概率。若治安部声望低于30，此许可证将被吊销。
item_permit_gun_2_desc.en: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 30.

item_permit_gun_2_flavor.zh: 由治安总监签发的许可证，允许持证人合法持有并交易中级违禁武器。
item_permit_gun_2_flavor.en: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade mid level contraband weapons.

item_permit_gun_3_desc.zh: 放入展示柜后，可提高枪械买家到访的概率。若治安部声望低于60，此许可证将被吊销。
item_permit_gun_3_desc.en: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 60.

item_permit_gun_3_flavor.zh: 由治安总监签发的许可证，允许持证人合法持有并交易高级违禁武器。
item_permit_gun_3_flavor.en: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade high level contraband weapons.

item_canister_mbs_desc.zh: 一种旨在破坏神经系统的剧毒化学武器。症状包括：呼吸衰竭、抽搐、身体机能失控、昏迷和死亡。
item_canister_mbs_desc.en: 'A highly toxic chemical weapon designed to disrupt the nervous system. Symptoms include: Respiratory failure, Convulsions, Loss of bodily functions, Unconsciousness and Death.'

item_cert1_flavor.zh: 证明你具备初级鉴定师资格。
item_cert1_flavor.en: Certifies you as a junior appraiser.

item_cert1_desc.zh: 将其放入展示柜，可吸引需要鉴定服务的顾客到访。
item_cert1_desc.en: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.

item_makeshift_storage_bay_desc.zh: 临时拼凑的物品储藏区。无法存放其他容器或机器。
item_makeshift_storage_bay_desc.en: A improvised storage bay for storing items. Can't store other containers or machines.

item_storage_bay_gun_desc.zh: 专门存放枪械和改装件的储藏区。无法存放其他容器或机器。
item_storage_bay_gun_desc.en: A specialized storage bay for storing firearms and modifications. Can't store other containers or machines.

item_storage_bay_chem_desc.zh: 专门存放化学设备和用品的储藏区。无法存放其他容器或机器。
item_storage_bay_chem_desc.en: A specialized storage bay for storing chemistry equipments and supplies. Can't store other containers or machines.

item_smuggler_bay_mini_desc.zh: 经过伪装、可在盘查时藏匿物品的储藏区。这一款尺寸较小。
item_smuggler_bay_mini_desc.en: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one is mini.

item_printer_chip_desc.zh: 一枚存有3D打印蓝图的芯片。
item_printer_chip_desc.en: A chip that contains the 3D printer blueprint.

item_printer_chip_makeshift_rds_name.zh: 3D打印机芯片（简易红点瞄准镜）

item_printer_chip_10_mag_high_name.zh: 3D打印机芯片（大容量10毫米弹匣）

item_farm_module_smuggler_desc.zh: 一种模组，可以解除所有生长中种子的违禁品状态。
item_farm_module_smuggler_desc.en: A module that remove the contrabands status of any growing seeds.

item_farm_module_fillerweed_production_d.zh: 一种以不再产出种子为代价提高填料草产量的模组。其独特效果不影响其他植物，且不可叠加。
item_farm_module_fillerweed_production_d.en: A module will improve yield of Fillerweed at the cost of losing seeds. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants. This effect is not stackable

item_farm_module_nightmare_cap_name.zh: 梦帽菇梦魇化水培模组

item_farm_module_nightmare_cap_desc.zh: 一种在种植梦帽菇时浓缩其精神活性成分、将其转化为有毒变种“梦魇帽菇”的模组。其独特效果不影响其他植物。
item_farm_module_nightmare_cap_desc.en: A module that concentrate psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Nightmare Cap, a toxic variant. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

item_farm_module_dream_cap_desc.zh: 一种在种植梦帽菇时中和其全部精神活性成分、将其转化为“食用帽菇”的模组。其独特效果可以叠加，但不影响其他植物。
item_farm_module_dream_cap_desc.en: A module that neutralize all psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Meal Cap. This module's unique effect can be stacked but doesn't affect other plants.

item_farm_module_nutrifruit_desc.zh: 帕斯泰尔公司生产的模组，可使水培系统在种植营养果时提高产量。其独特效果不影响其他植物。
item_farm_module_nutrifruit_desc.en: A module by pastel that allow Hydroponic System to yield more Nutrifruit when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

item_farm_module_kotton_loom_name.zh: 韧棉自动织造水培模组

item_farm_module_kotton_loom_desc.zh: 一种在种植韧棉时直接将韧棉纤维织成布料的模组。其独特效果不影响其他植物。
item_farm_module_kotton_loom_desc.en: A module that wove the Kotton Fiber into a fabric when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

item_printer_module_metal_desc.zh: 一种让打印机能够使用金属打印芯片的模组。
item_printer_module_metal_desc.en: A module that allows the printer to use metal printer chips.

item_chem_module_desc.zh: 一种可改进搅拌机、加热板和化学制剂成型机的特殊模组。安装后需要使用模组提取器才能拆除。
item_chem_module_desc.en: Require a module extractor to remove once installed. A special module that can improve the Blender, the Heating Plate and the Chem Finisher

item_expedition_box_desc.zh: 将补给品和装备放入此箱，供雇工在探险期间使用。未使用的装备会退还给你。
item_expedition_box_desc.en: Put supplies and equipments in this box for your hireling to use during expeditions. Unused gear will be returned to you.

item_armor_lining_desc.zh: 由韧棉织物制成的衬垫，可为穿戴者提供一定防护。叠加多层后能够抵御轻武器射击。
item_armor_lining_desc.en: Kotton fabric made into padding. Provide modest protection to its wearer. Can protect against small arms if multiple layers are stacked.

item_armor_lining_flavor.zh: 专为危险环境中的工人设计，也是拾荒者必不可少的装备。
item_armor_lining_flavor.en: Designed for workers in hazardous environment. Also an essential piece of equipment for scavs.

module_effect_remove_contraband.zh: 移除生长中种子的违禁品状态
module_effect_remove_contraband.en: Remove Contraband Status of Growing Seeds

module_effect_blast_furnace.zh: 投入消耗增加\n-每晚产量增加\n-纯度降低
module_effect_blast_furnace.en: Increased Input Used \n -Increased Output Per Night\n -Decreased Purity

module_effect_junk_convert.zh: 将{0}份垃圾转化为{1}份废金属

module_effect_fillerweed_yield.zh: 填料草不再产出种子\n-填料草产量+{0}
module_effect_fillerweed_yield.en: Fillerweed will no longer yield seeds \n -Fillerweed yield +{0}

module_effect_nightmare_cap.zh: 种出的梦帽菇将变为梦魇帽菇
module_effect_nightmare_cap.en: Farmed Dream Cap will be Nightmare Cap

module_effect_dream_cap_neutralizer.zh: 移除梦帽菇的违禁品状态\n-将类型设为食物\n-梦帽菇产量+{0}
module_effect_dream_cap_neutralizer.en: Remove Dream Cap Contraband Status \n -Set type to Food \n -Dream Cap Yield +{0}

module_effect_kotton_fabric.zh: 产出韧棉织物，而非韧棉纤维
module_effect_kotton_fabric.en: Produce Kotton Fabric instead of Kotton Fiber

item_med_bottle_red_flavor.zh: 警告：具有腐蚀性。请小心处理。

item_med_bottle_red_desc.zh: 可使蛋白质和稳定剂凝聚成团，以便过滤。还可中和碱性物质。
item_med_bottle_red_desc.en: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts bases.

item_med_bottle_blue_flavor.zh: 警告：具有强腐蚀性。请小心处理。

item_med_bottle_blue_desc.zh: 可使蛋白质和稳定剂凝聚成团，以便过滤。还可中和酸性物质。
item_med_bottle_blue_desc.en: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts acid.

item_med_bottle_violet_desc.zh: 一种用途广泛的碱性化合物，常用于合法化工生产，也是常见的芬太前体。
item_med_bottle_violet_desc.en: A versatile chemical base used in many legitimate chemical manufacturing but also a common precursor for Phanta.

item_med_bottle_orange_flavor.zh: 向另一种物质提供电子，从而改变该物质的化学状态。
item_med_bottle_orange_flavor.en: Donates electrons to another substance, changing the other substance's chemical state.

item_med_bottle_orange_desc.zh: 某些化学反应不可或缺的试剂。

item_med_bottle_small_pink_desc.zh: 使油脂凝聚成团，以便轻松过滤。随后可通过蒸发去除这种试剂。
item_med_bottle_small_pink_desc.en: Clump Oils and Fat together allowing them to be filtered off easily. This agent can then be evaporate off.

item_1ml_dropper_flavor.zh: 用于精确分配少量液体的高精度滴管。
item_1ml_dropper_flavor.en: A high-precision dropper for dispensing small amount of liquid.

item_blender_desc.zh: 一台看起来很不结实的搅拌机。

item_chem_finisher_desc.zh: 将化学品加工成药片，或灌装进药剂瓶等容器。
item_chem_finisher_desc.en: Package chemicals into pills, vials and other containers.

item_evaporator_desc.zh: 一台运作缓慢的机器，每晚会利用低温和干燥空气，使溶液中的液体蒸发。
item_evaporator_desc.en: A slow machine that works overnight to evaporate liquids out of a solution using low heat and dry air.

item_evaporator_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响每晚蒸发量
质量影响蒸气捕获量
提供电力和水容器后，机器会在夜间运作。
item_evaporator_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Volume Evaporate Per Night
  Quality: Volume of Vapor Captured
Works overnight when power and a water container are provided.

item_heating_plate_desc.zh: 一台看起来破旧、功率不足且控温不准的加热板。
item_heating_plate_desc.en: A shabby looking underpowered and inaccurate heating plate.

item_3d_printer_desc.zh: 一台可使用塑料打印多种物品的机器。夜间运作。
item_3d_printer_desc.en: A machine that can print various items using plastic. Works overnight.

item_3d_printer_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
 效率影响功耗
 性能影响打印速度
 质量影响适用物品的打印质量（系数：0.5）
item_3d_printer_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Printer Speed Rate
  Quality (0.25 Ratio): Print Quality On Eligible Items

item_3d_printer_instruction_short.zh: 放入电源、打印机芯片和材料。满足要求后，打印机会在夜间自动运作。
item_3d_printer_instruction_short.en: Insert power source, printer chip and materials. Printer will work automatically overnight if requirements are met.

item_hydroponic_desc.zh: 一套紧凑型水培系统，需要专用电源才能运行。在夜间运作。
item_hydroponic_desc.en: A compact hydroponic system. Requires a dedicated power source to function. Works overnight.

item_hydroponic_instruction_flavor.zh:
[模组影响]：
 效率影响功耗
 性能影响生长速度（系数：0.5）
 质量影响产量上限（系数：0.5）
item_hydroponic_instruction_flavor.en:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance  (0.5 Ratio): Growth Rate
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Max Yield %

item_hydroponic_instruction_short.zh: 放入一个水容器（水越干净越好）、一枚种子，以及一个电量充足的电源。水培系统会在夜间运作。此机器可安装可选模组来增强性能。
item_hydroponic_instruction_short.en: Insert a water container with the cleanest water you can get, a seed, and a power source with enough energy. The hydroponic works overnight. This machine can accept optional modules to improve its capabilities.

item_vending_machine_flavor.zh: 一台每晚自动出售物品的自动售货机。
item_vending_machine_flavor.en: A vending machine that sells items automatically overnight.

item_vending_machine_desc.zh: 物品售价将额外提高10%，并在适用时计入零售加价，但不受事件修正影响。
item_vending_machine_desc.en: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.

item_vending_fountain_flavor.zh: 一台每晚自动售水的机器。只能出售基础水、优质水和纯水。
item_vending_fountain_flavor.en: A vending water fountain machine that sells water automatically overnight. Only Basewater, High Quality Water and Pure Water can be sold.

item_vending_fountain_desc.zh: 物品售价将额外提高10%，并在适用时计入零售加价，但不受事件修正影响。
item_vending_fountain_desc.en: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.

item_kotton_fiber_desc.zh: 传统棉花的改良变种，可织成坚韧耐用、用途广泛的织物。
item_kotton_fiber_desc.en: A modified variant of traditional Cotton. Can be woven into highly durable and versatile fabric

item_dream_cap_desc.zh: 食用后会引起轻微欣快感和胃痛，是制作梦尘的关键原料。
item_dream_cap_desc.en: Cause a slight euphoria and stomach pain when consumed. A key ingredient in Dream Dust

item_nightmare_cap_desc.zh: 常见梦帽菇的剧毒变种，可加工成致命毒药。幸存者称，摄入后会产生可怕的幻觉。
item_nightmare_cap_desc.en: Highly poisonous variant of the common Dream Cap. Can be processed into a deadly poison. Survivors report having horrible hallucinations after ingesting it.

item_plant_analyser_desc.zh: 一种用于分析植物生长状况的专用工具，可借此确定植物的最佳生长条件。
item_plant_analyser_desc.en: A specialized tool that can be used to analyse the growth of plants. It can be used to determine the optimal growing conditions for a plant.

item_fillerweed_desc.zh: 一种主要种植于下层区、呈淡黄色的速生叶菜。几乎没有营养价值，通常作为填充料掺进食物，以增加口粮分量。
item_fillerweed_desc.en: A fast-growing, yellowish leafy crop cultivated primarily in the Lower Levels. Offers almost no nutritional value, it is used as a filler in meals to stretch rations

item_fillerweed_flavor.en: Has a mushy texture with a slightly bitter aftertaste.

item_hydroreed_seed_desc.zh: 一种不产出食物的功能性作物。水培芦苇在生长过程中会净化其所在水体。
item_hydroreed_seed_desc.en: A utility crops that produce no food. The Hydroreed will purify the water it is in while growing

item_bloomberry_seed_desc.zh: 一种多年生灌木，结果后不会枯死。保持水质清洁，可以收获品质更好的荧光莓。对种植槽使用短柄斧即可清除植株。
item_bloomberry_seed_desc.en: A perennial bush. It doesn't die after fruiting. Keep its water clean for better bloomberries. Use a hatchet on the planter to clear it.

item_meal_cap_desc.zh: 经过中和、不再具有精神活性的梦帽菇。合法且可安全食用，无法加工成梦尘。
item_meal_cap_desc.en: A neutralized Dream Cap with no psychoactive properties. Legal and safe to eat. Cannot be processed into Dream Dust.

item_skinning_knife_flavor.zh: 资深养殖户的趁手利器。
item_skinning_knife_flavor.en: The perfect knife for a veteran rancher.

item_toolbox_desc.zh: 可存放工具。按键盘上的数字键1至9，即可装备相应槽位内的物品。
item_toolbox_desc.en: Holds tools. Press 1-9 on the keyboard to equip the stored item.

item_fridge_desc.zh: 可在夜间冰镇饮品。冰镇后的商品可以卖出更高的价格。葡萄酒和未密封的水不受影响。
item_fridge_desc.en: Chills stored drinks overnight. Chilled goods sell for more. Wine and unsealed water are unaffected.

item_beis_icecream_flavor.zh: 一种美味零食，按法律分类属于“人工香料调味冷冻乳制品”。不知为何，即使不冷藏也不会融化。
item_beis_icecream_flavor.en: A delicious treat that is legally categorized as Artificially Flavored Frozen Dairy Product. Somehow it doesn't melt when unrefrigerated.

item_beis_icecream_desc.zh: 放入冰箱冷冻后，可以更高的价格出售。冷冻过程耗时一夜。
item_beis_icecream_desc.en: Can be sold at a higher value when frozen overnight in the fridge.

item_water_pitcher_desc.zh: 可装入滤水器，对倒入的水进行过滤，去除部分污染物。
item_water_pitcher_desc.en: Holds a water filter to strip some contaminants from the water poured through it.

item_tilapia_flavor.zh: 常见的养殖鱼。长得快，不怎么挑食，繁殖也省心。
item_tilapia_flavor.en: Common farm fish. Grows fast, eats most things and breeds without much help.

item_gutter_tilapia_flavor.zh: 来自下水道的罗非鱼品系。生长较慢，相同饲料下的产肉量也较低，但不怕脏水，饲养期间还能清除水箱中的重金属和化学污染物。
item_gutter_tilapia_flavor.en: A sewer strain of tilapia. Grows slower and makes less meat for its feed, but dirty water does not bother it, and it takes heavy metal and chemical contaminants out of the tank while it lives there.

item_graft_tilapia_flavor.zh: 经过改造的罗非鱼。相同饲料下的产肉量较低，且需要干净的水。不过，鱼皮经消毒后可用作绷带，未受精的鱼卵则可直接用于敷伤口。
item_graft_tilapia_flavor.en: A modified tilapia. Makes less meat for its feed and needs clean water, but its skin can be sterilized and used as a bandage, and its unfertilized roe dresses a wound as it is.

item_graft_tilapia_roe_flavor.zh: 植皮罗非鱼的卵。富含促进皮肤愈合的修复蛋白，所以医护人员都是整窝整窝地买。
item_graft_tilapia_roe_flavor.en: Graft tilapia eggs. Thick with the repair protein that makes the skin heal, which is why medics buy them by the clutch.

item_tilapia_skin_graft_desc.zh: 经过消毒的植皮罗非鱼皮。可止血并使伤口闭合。
item_tilapia_skin_graft_desc.en: Sterilized skin of a graft tilapia. Stops the bleeding and closes a wound.

item_ras_desc.zh: 采用封闭式水循环的养鱼设备。需要水箱、电力和用于净水的滤水器。
item_ras_desc.en: A closed water loop for raising fish. Needs a water tank, power, and filters to keep the water clean.

item_ras_water_tank_desc.zh: 循环水养殖系统的储水箱。
item_ras_water_tank_desc.en: The water reservoir of a recirculating aquaculture system.

item_gutterflow_pellet_desc.zh: 用阴沟里的污泥压制而成。能为杂食鱼提供廉价的热量，人可吃不得。
item_gutterflow_pellet_desc.en: Pressed gutter sludge. Cheap calories for omnivore fish, not for people.

item_eel_desc.zh: 可养殖获取高档鱼肉片，价值远高于其他鱼类。人工饲养时不会繁殖。
item_eel_desc.en: Raised for its luxury fillets, worth far more than any other fish. Does not breed in captivity.

item_electric_eel_desc.zh: 一台活体发电机。从亚成年期起，每晚都会为养殖缸的电池和缸旁的每块电池充电，体型越大，发电量越多。人工饲养时不会繁殖。
item_electric_eel_desc.en: A living generator. From adolescent on, it charges its tank's battery and every battery beside the tank each night, more as it grows. Does not breed in captivity.

item_sturgeon_desc.zh: 可养殖获取鱼子酱。鱼还活着时，可用外科手术工具采集鱼卵，也可在宰杀时一次取出全部鱼卵。人工饲养时不会繁殖。
item_sturgeon_desc.en: Farmed for caviar. Its eggs can be harvested using surgery tools while the fish is alive, or collected in full at slaughter. Does not breed in captivity.

item_industrial_fish_feed_desc.zh: 工厂大批量生产的鱼饲料，适合杂食性和草食性鱼类。
item_industrial_fish_feed_desc.en: Mass produced factory-made feed for omnivore and herbivore fish.

item_dna_disk_desc.zh: 一张空白数据盘。DNA编辑器可将提取出的特性写入其中。
item_dna_disk_desc.en: A blank data disk. A DNA Manipulator can extract a trait onto it.

item_dna_manipulator_desc.zh: 可将DNA数据提取到DNA数据盘中，也可将盘中的特性应用于目标。目标的基因复杂度越高，成功率越低。
item_dna_manipulator_desc.en: Extracts DNA data onto DNA Data Disks and installs a disk's trait on a target. The higher the target's genetic complexity, the lower the chance of success.

item_dna_manipulator_instruction_short.en: How to use the DNA Manipulator.

item_dna_manipulator_instruction_flavor.zh:
应用：将已写入特性的DNA数据盘放入输入槽，将目标放入目标槽。目标会获得盘中的特性。若目标已具有该特性，则使其提升1级。每次成功应用后，数据盘的可用次数都会减少1次。
提取：将空白DNA数据盘放入输出槽，将目标放入目标槽。系统会随机将目标的一项特性复制到数据盘上，并销毁目标，除非机器装有基因稳定模组。也可使用已写有目标所具备特性的数据盘代替空白盘，这次提取会增加该盘的使用次数。
每次编辑都会增加目标的基因热度。热度和复杂度越高，下一次编辑就越慢，风险也越高，这种影响会持续到目标成熟。开启基因扫描仪可查看目标的基因信息。
模组：基因稳定模组可让目标在提取后保留下来。特性筛选模组可将随机提取范围限定为正面或负面特性。精准提取模组在已写入特性的数据盘上使用后，可定向提取该特性。
输出：每次操作后，数据盘都会弹出至输出托盘。切换机器开关可改为让数据盘留在原槽位。
[模组影响]：
效率影响功耗
性能影响操作速度（系数0.5）
质量影响成功率（系数0.5）
item_dna_manipulator_instruction_flavor.en:
INSTALL: put a written DNA Data Disk in the input slot and the target in the target slot. The target gains the trait. Installing a trait the target already has stacks a rank. Every successful install uses one charge of the disk.
EXTRACT: put a blank DNA Data Disk in the output slot and the target in the target slot. One random trait is copied onto the disk and the target is lost, unless a genetic stabilizer module is installed. A disk already holding a trait the target carries can be used instead of a blank one: the extraction adds uses to it.
Every edit heats the target's genetics. Heat and complexity make the next edit slower and riskier until the target matures. Switch a gene scanner on to read a target's genetics.
MODULES: a genetic stabilizer keeps the target through extraction; the trait filters restrict a random extraction to positive or negative traits; the precision module, once used on a written disk, extracts that trait specifically.
OUTPUT: after each operation the disk is ejected to the output tray. Toggle the machine to keep disks in their slots instead.
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance (0.5 Ratio): Operation Speed
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Success Chance

item_dna_module_stabilizer_desc.zh: 使目标在DNA提取后仍能保留下来，可在不销毁目标的情况下移除特性。
item_dna_module_stabilizer_desc.en: 'Lets the target survive DNA extraction: a trait can be removed without destroying the target.'

item_dna_module_positive_filter_desc.zh: 仅提取正面特性。目标没有正面特性时，不会提取任何特性。
item_dna_module_positive_filter_desc.en: Restricts DNA extraction to positive traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.
