item_dna_module_negative_filter_desc.zh: 仅提取负面特性。目标没有负面特性时，不会提取任何特性。
item_dna_module_negative_filter_desc.en: Restricts DNA extraction to negative traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.

item_dna_module_precision_desc.zh: 对已写入特性的DNA数据盘使用此模组，即可扫描盘中的特性。将模组安装到DNA编辑器后，机器将只提取扫描到的特性。
item_dna_module_precision_desc.en: Use this module on a DNA Data Disk containing a trait to scan it. When installed in a DNA Manipulator, it will only extract the scanned trait.

item_moisture_farm_desc_shared_air.zh: 同时运行多台水分收集器时，每台的产量都会下降。
item_moisture_farm_desc_shared_air.en: Running multiple Moisture Farms decreases the output of each.

item_printer_chip_handmade_pistol_frame_.zh: 3D打印机芯片（“巢火”紧凑型手枪框架）

item_debris_pile_rest_desc.zh: 只要你留在店内睡觉、不外出，就会花些时间清理杂物。
item_debris_pile_rest_desc.en: You will spend some time clearing the debris whenever you sleep without going out of the Store.

item_debris_pile_tool_desc.zh: 这堆杂物需要工具才能清理。每件用来清理的工具都会损坏报废。
item_debris_pile_tool_desc.en: You will need tools to clear this one. Each tool used on it will be destroyed.

item_debris_pile_service_desc.zh: 这堆东西太重，你一个人搬不动。需要选择“杂物清运”夜间服务来清理。
item_debris_pile_service_desc.en: Far too heavy to move yourself. The Debris Removal nightly service will be needed to clear it.

item_makeshift_reactor_desc.zh: 完好度高于{0}时，可为店铺供电。每晚都会损失完好度，降至0时会爆炸。废金属可恢复{1}点完好度。垃圾可恢复{2}点完好度，但会使完好度上限降低{3}点。每个普通电子元件都能使每晚损失的完好度减少1点。
item_makeshift_reactor_desc.en: Powers the Store while its integrity is above {0}. Loses integrity every night and explodes at 0. Scrap metal restores {1} integrity. Junk restores {2} integrity but lowers maximum integrity by {3}. Each common electronic part reduces the nightly loss by 1.

item_appraisal_cert_flavor.zh: 证明你在鉴定委员会的职级。
item_appraisal_cert_flavor.en: Certifies your rank on the Appraiser Board.

item_cert3_name.zh: 鉴定委员会高级认证证书

item_cert4_name.zh: 鉴定委员会大师认证证书

item_printer_module_melee_batch_name.zh: 近战武器批量打印模组

item_printer_module_melee_batch_desc.zh: 一种打印机模组，可在每次打印近战武器时额外产出一把武器。打印速度较慢，耗电量较大。
item_printer_module_melee_batch_desc.en: A printer module that adds one more weapon to every melee weapon print. Slow and power hungry.

item_gun_frame_desc.zh: 一副尚未完成的枪械框架，装上枪械零件即可组装完成。
item_gun_frame_desc.en: An incomplete gun frame, add a gun part on it to finish it.

item_printer_module_cnc_desc.zh: 与金属打印模组配合使用后，可让打印机使用枪械框架和枪械零件芯片。
item_printer_module_cnc_desc.en: A module that allows the printer to use gun frame and gun part chips, together with the Metal Printing Module.

item_current_converter_desc.zh: 直接从下层区的电网取电，代替电池给任意机器供电。要通电，得支付每晚的“电流转换器”服务费。
item_current_converter_desc.en: Draw power directly from the Lower Levels' grid to power any machine instead of a battery. The Current Converter nightly service must be paid in order to receive power.

item_li_formula_name.zh: 李北文的奥克莫吸配方

item_lou_bomb_armed_desc.zh: 这是卢藏起来的东西。计时器显示，它会在午夜爆炸。你最好赶紧把它拆了。
item_lou_bomb_armed_desc.en: This is what Lou planted. According to the timer, it will explode at midnight. You'd better disarm it.

item_lou_bomb_fake_desc.zh: 这是卢藏起来的炸弹，不过里面好像根本没装炸药。
item_lou_bomb_fake_desc.en: This is the bomb Lou planted, but it looks like there's no actual payload inside.

item_lou_old_orders_desc.zh: 一张发黄发脆的纸，看起来被反复折起又展开过很多次。这是一份多年前写给卢的书面命令，顶部仍能看出一枚褪色的共和国印章。
item_lou_old_orders_desc.en: A yellowed, brittle sheet. It looks like it has been folded and unfolded many times. It's a written order addressed to Lou, dated years ago. A faded Republic seal is still visible at the top.

item_lou_old_orders_flavor.zh:
共和国联合特种作战司令部，优先命令
致：应急响应小队队长 卢

别再拖延时间，立即执行此命令。带领你的小队启动研究船伊卡洛斯号的自毁程序。破坏所有逃生舱，不准任何伊卡洛斯号的幸存者随你的小队一同逃离。照做，否则我就送你上军事法庭。

（签名已褪色，无法辨认。）
item_lou_old_orders_flavor.en:
REPUBLIC JOINT SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND, PRIORITY ORDER
TO: Emergency Response Team Leader Lou

Stop stalling for time and carry out this order immediately. Take your team and start the self-destruct sequence of the research ship Icarus. Disable all the escape pods and do not allow any survivor from the Icarus to escape with your team. Do it, or I will have you court-martialed.

(The signature has faded beyond reading.)

item_lou_toy_box_flavor.zh: 看起来是用治安部的物证柜改装的。里面的东西最好一样都别碰。
item_lou_toy_box_flavor.en: Looks like a repurposed evidence locker from the Security Department. Better not touch anything inside.

item_liquid_luck_flavor.zh: 三天内运气百分百暴涨！乔治奥亲口担保！喝起来一股铁锈水味。
item_liquid_luck_flavor.en: Will 100% increase your luck for 3 days! Georgio's guarantee! It tastes like Rustwater.

item_internal_springs_improved_desc.zh: 一套更坚固的内部弹簧，让枪机循环更加可靠。
item_internal_springs_improved_desc.en: A set of sturdier internal springs that help the action cycle reliably.

item_printer_chip_internal_springs_impro.zh: 3D打印机芯片（改良内部弹簧组）

item_gamblers_coin_flavor.zh: 一枚早已没人记得的货币。据说能带来好运。不过大多数时候，它只是让你刮彩票更快。
item_gamblers_coin_flavor.en: A coin from a currency nobody remembers. They say it brings luck. Mostly, it scratches tickets faster.

item_luxury_supply_crate_desc.zh: 一只密封的箱子，装满了来自上层区的高档货。打包的人可真舍得花钱。奇怪的是，你的治安部通报里把它列为失窃物品。
item_luxury_supply_crate_desc.en: 'A sealed crate of fine goods from the Upper Levels. Whoever packed it spared no expense. Strange, though: your Security feed lists it as reported stolen.'

item_self_refilling_perfume_name.zh: “同步”自动补充神经活性香水

item_self_refilling_perfume_desc.zh: 使用后，与当前顾客的交易收益将提升15%。你同时只能获得一种香水效果的增益。会自动补充。
item_self_refilling_perfume_desc.en: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time. Refills on its own.

item_self_refilling_perfume_flavor.zh: “同步”香水的高端版本。瓶盖里的密封储液仓会慢慢合成新的一剂，所以瓶子永远不会真正见底。
item_self_refilling_perfume_flavor.en: The premium edition of the SYNC perfume. A sealed reservoir in the cap slowly synthesizes a new dose, so the bottle never quite runs dry.

item_storage_bay_expansion_kit_desc.zh: 对储藏区使用可增加两个储物标签页，对储藏区（扩建）使用则增加一个。
item_storage_bay_expansion_kit_desc.en: Use it on a Storage Bay to add two storage tabs, or on an Extended Storage Bay to add one.

item_storage_coordinator_desc.zh: 把容器和机器分配到预设里，再给每个预设设一个快捷键，就能一键打开。
item_storage_coordinator_desc.en: Assign containers and machines to presets. Give each preset a hotkey to open them quickly.

item_hypertech_electronic_flavor.zh: 电子技术的最前沿。整个空间站没人造得出来。
item_hypertech_electronic_flavor.en: The bleeding edge of electronics. Nobody on the station can make these.

item_hypertech_electronic_desc.zh: 用于升级某些超科技物品或为其充能。
item_hypertech_electronic_desc.en: Used to upgrade or charge certain Hypertech items.

item_hypertech_power_cell_desc.zh: 一种实验性的能源单元，本身不储存电量。只要机器的耗电不超过它的额定输出，就能无限期为其供电。耗电超过额定值的机器则完全得不到电力。
item_hypertech_power_cell_desc.en: An experimental cell with no stored charge. It powers any machine whose draw stays within the cell's output rating, indefinitely. Machines that draw more than the rating get nothing.

item_turbo_booster_hypertech_desc.zh: 一种由能量电池供能的涡轮增压器。它每个周期都会充能，并储存多余的电量。充满后，可立即完成机器当前的周期。
item_turbo_booster_hypertech_desc.en: A turbo booster powered by an Energy Cell. It charges every cycle and banks spare charge. Once charged, it instantly completes a machine's current cycle.

item_mind_reprogrammer_desc.zh: 可以移除或添加某些特性。消耗电子元件（超科技）为它充能。每次使用后都需要一段时间来重置。
item_mind_reprogrammer_desc.en: Can remove and add certain perks. Consume Electronic Parts (Hypertech) to charge it. The device needs time to reset after each use.

item_auto_butcher_desc.zh: 可配置的自动屠宰机。需要安装在动物笼或循环水养殖系统中。每晚将符合设置的动物屠宰后放入托盘。始终忽略用标记笔标记过的动物。
item_auto_butcher_desc.en: A configurable auto butcher. It needs to be installed inside an Animal Cage or a RAS. Every night it harvests the animals that match its settings into its tray. It always ignores animals marked with the Marking Pen.

item_auto_butcher_flavor.zh: 威武的绞肉机。请勿爬入。也不要让任何人帮你爬入。
item_auto_butcher_flavor.en: The mighty Gibber. Do not climb inside. Do not let anyone help you climb inside.

item_marking_pen_desc.zh: 用颜色标记一只动物或鱼。自动屠宰机绝不会碰已标记的动物。
item_marking_pen_desc.en: Marks an animal or a fish with a colour. The Auto Butcher never touches a marked animal.

item_intake_hopper_desc.zh: 可与出料斗连接，并设置为每晚把所在库存中的物品送进出料斗所在的库存。对出料斗使用即可连接，双击进行设置。
item_intake_hopper_desc.en: Can be linked to an Outlet Hopper and configured to send the items of its inventory into the Outlet Hopper's inventory every night. Use it on an Outlet Hopper to link them, double-click to set it up.

item_outlet_hopper_desc.zh: 每晚接收已连接的进料斗送来的物品，放入所在库存。对进料斗使用即可连接，双击立即运行。
item_outlet_hopper_desc.en: Receives the items sent by its linked Intake Hoppers into its inventory every night. Use it on an Intake Hopper to link them, double-click to run them now.

item_energy_credit_dis_desc.zh: 一种高容量的一次性能量电池。无法充电。
item_energy_credit_dis_desc.en: A high capacity single-use energy cell. Cannot be recharged.

item_energy_credit_dis_flavor.zh: 因其便利，深受上层区青睐。
item_energy_credit_dis_flavor.en: Favored in the Upper Levels for its convenience.

item_water_tank_desc.zh: 大型液体容器。对其使用废金属或金属锭可以扩大容量。
item_water_tank_desc.en: A large liquid container. Use scrap metal or a metal ingot on it to enlarge it.

item_glass_shard_desc.zh: 用绷带缠上它，就能做成玻璃刀。绷带不会被消耗。
item_glass_shard_desc.en: Use a bandage on it to wrap a Glass Shiv. The bandage is not used up.

credit_community_note.zh: 衷心感谢所有社区成员的支持！
credit_community_note.en: Thanks to all our community members for their support!

mech_rent_landlord.en: The Landlord will come to collect {0} Credit in Rent {1}

mech_inspectable_tooltip.zh: 可使用放大镜进行检查
mech_inspectable_tooltip.en: Can be inspected with a Magnifying Glass

mech_module_effect_premium_desc.zh: 此模组的基础属性提升{0}%，但价格昂贵得多。
mech_module_effect_premium_desc.en: This Module has {0}% higher base stats, but costs significantly more.

mech_module_effect_inferior_desc.zh: 此模组的基础属性降低{0}%，但价格便宜得多。
mech_module_effect_inferior_desc.en: This Module has {0}% lower base stats, but costs significantly less.

mech_module_effect_receiver_desc.zh: 此模组每相邻一个[节点]，即可获得{0}%的临时属性加成。
mech_module_effect_receiver_desc.en: This Module receives a {0}% temporary bonus to its stats for each adjacent [Node].

mech_module_effect_top_mount_desc.zh: 如果此模组至少有一侧接触到模组舱的顶部边缘，它将获得{0}%的临时属性加成。
mech_module_effect_top_mount_desc.en: This Module receives a {0}% temporary bonus to its stats if at least one side of it is touching the TOP edge of the module bay.

mech_module_effect_side_mount_desc.zh: 如果此模组至少有一侧接触到模组舱的左侧边缘，它将获得{0}%的临时属性加成。
mech_module_effect_side_mount_desc.en: This Module receives a {0}% temporary bonus to its stats if at least one side of it is touching the LEFT edge of the module bay.

mech_module_effect_overvolted_desc.zh: 此模组的基础属性提升{0}%，但在使用时有{1}%的几率永久损坏。
mech_module_effect_overvolted_desc.en: This Module has {0}% higher base stats, but there's {1}% chance of being permanently ruined on use.

mech_module_effect_degrading_desc.zh: 此模组具有双倍的初始基础属性，但每次使用都会使其正面加成下降{0}%。
mech_module_effect_degrading_desc.en: This Module starts with double the base stats but lose {0} positive percentage points each time it is used.

mech_module_effect_learning_algorithm_de.zh: 此模组初始没有任何正向属性，但每次使用都会在某项属性上获得{0}点基础加成（直至达到上限）。
mech_module_effect_learning_algorithm_de.en: This Module starts with no positive stats but gains {0} base positive to a stat each time it's used (up to a maximum).

mech_module_effect_negative_feedback_des.zh: 此模组的正向基础属性提升{0}%，但会吸收相邻模组{1}%的负面基础属性。
mech_module_effect_negative_feedback_des.en: This Module has {0}% higher positive base stats, but receives {1}% of the negative base stats from adjacent modules.

mech_module_effect_support_node_desc.zh: 此模组会吸收每个相邻[模组]{0}%的基础属性作为临时加成。
mech_module_effect_support_node_desc.en: This Module receives {0}% of the base stats from each adjacent [Module] as temporary bonuses.

health_wound_mobility_regained.zh: 你的伤势正在愈合，且已恢复了行动能力。

health_wound_major_worsened.en: Your untreated major wounds have worsened.

health_wound_minor_worsened.zh: 你未受治疗的轻伤恶化了。
health_wound_minor_worsened.en: Your untreated minor wounds have worsened.

health_wound_major_received.en: You received a major wound while scavenging!

health_addiction_overcome_nicotine.en: You have overcome your nicotine addiction!

health_addiction_overcome_alcohol.en: You have overcome your alcohol addiction!

health_addiction_overcome_narcotic.zh: 你已克服了麻醉品成瘾！
health_addiction_overcome_narcotic.en: You have overcome your narcotic addiction!

health_addiction_withdrawal_nicotine.zh: 你正遭受尼古丁戒断反应的折磨，致使你谈判时受到惩罚！
health_addiction_withdrawal_nicotine.en: You are suffering from nicotine addiction withdrawal, resulting in a negotiation penalty!

health_addiction_withdrawal_alcohol.zh: 你正遭受酒精戒断反应的折磨，致使你谈判时受到惩罚！
health_addiction_withdrawal_alcohol.en: You are suffering from alcohol addiction withdrawal, resulting in a negotiation penalty!

health_addiction_withdrawal_narcotic.zh: 你正遭受麻醉品戒断反应的折磨，致使你谈判时受到惩罚！
health_addiction_withdrawal_narcotic.en: You are suffering from narcotic addiction withdrawal, resulting in a negotiation penalty!

health_addiction_suppressed.zh: 成瘾引发的戒断反应已经消退。至少暂时如此。
health_addiction_suppressed.en: Any effects of addiction withdrawal have abated. For now.

health_sentinel_critical.zh: 你感觉整个身体都在与你作对。你的状况正在急剧恶化。
health_sentinel_critical.en: Your whole body feels like it's turning against you. Your condition is deteriorating very quickly.

health_sentinel_severe.zh: 你呼吸困难，肌肉痉挛。你的状况正在迅速恶化。
health_sentinel_severe.en: You struggle to breathe. Your muscles spasm. Your condition is deteriorating quickly.

health_sentinel_moderate.zh: 你感到浑身发烫、四肢乏力。你的状况正在恶化。
health_sentinel_moderate.en: You feel feverish and weak. Your condition is deteriorating.

health_sentinel_mild.zh: 你开始感觉有些不适。你需要尽快注射免疫宁。
health_sentinel_mild.en: You are starting to feel a bit off. You will need to get an Immunivax injection soon.

health_sentinel_collapse_final.zh: 你的哨兵崩溃综合征已接近终末期，绝不能漏掉任何一次药物注射。
health_sentinel_collapse_final.en: Your Sentinel Collapse is almost the final stage, do not miss any injection.

health_sentinel_collapse_advanced.zh: 你的哨兵崩溃综合征已处于晚期，必须尽可能避免漏掉药物注射！
health_sentinel_collapse_advanced.en: Your Sentinel Collapse is in an advanced stage, you must avoid skipping injections!

health_immunivax_feel_none.zh: ' 你感觉没什么明显效果'

health_immunivax_mostly_smooth.zh: 这次注射大体还算顺利。

sec_data_investigation_fast.zh: 由于你日益猖獗的犯罪活动，治安部对你店铺的调查进度正在加快推进。
sec_data_investigation_fast.en: Security's investigation into your business is progressing at a faster rate due to your increased criminal activity.

sec_data_investigation_very_fast.zh: 由于你极其猖獗的犯罪活动，治安部对你店铺的调查进度正以极快的速度推进。
sec_data_investigation_very_fast.en: Security's investigation into your business is progressing at a much faster due to your significantly increased criminal activity.

mech_scav_scanner_upgrade.zh: 可使用电子元件进行升级。
mech_scav_scanner_upgrade.en: Can be upgraded with Electronic Parts.

mech_nightlog_promo_offer.zh: 地下交易所推出了新的交易收购清单
mech_nightlog_promo_offer.en: New promotional offers are available from the Underground Exchange

mech_nightlog_buyer_referral.zh: 王尔德为你引荐了一名买家，对方将于明日光顾店铺。
mech_nightlog_buyer_referral.en: Wild has referred a buying customer to the Store for tomorrow.

mech_nightlog_seller_referral.zh: 王尔德为你引荐了一名卖家，对方将于明日光顾店铺。
mech_nightlog_seller_referral.en: Wild has referred a selling customer to the Store for tomorrow.

mech_nightlog_criminal_network.zh: 王尔德为你引荐了一名预算充足的违禁品买家，对方将于明日光顾店铺。
mech_nightlog_criminal_network.en: Wild has referred a high-budget contraband buyer to the Store for tomorrow.

mech_nightlog_inspection_2days.zh: 你的治安部线人传来消息，你的店铺将在2天后接受盘查。
mech_nightlog_inspection_2days.en: Your Security informant has sent word that your Store will be inspected in 2 days

mech_nightlog_inspection_tomorrow.zh: 你的治安部线人传来消息，盘查已安排在明天进行。
mech_nightlog_inspection_tomorrow.en: Your Security informant has sent word that an inspection is scheduled for tomorrow.

mech_nightlog_inspection_imminent.zh: 你的治安部线人传来消息，盘查即将开始。
mech_nightlog_inspection_imminent.en: Your Security informant has sent word that an inspection is imminent

mech_nightlog_wanted_visited.zh: 你的一位联系人通知你，通缉犯：{0}昨天曾光顾过你的店铺。
mech_nightlog_wanted_visited.en: 'One of your contacts has informed you that a wanted criminal: {0}, visited the Store yesterday.'

mech_nightlog_upgrade_tip.zh: 你的现金流很充裕，不妨考虑将资金投资于升级设施或拓展人脉。
mech_nightlog_upgrade_tip.en: You are doing well on cash and should consider investing your money into upgrades or expanding your contacts.

mech_nightlog_sting_warning.zh: 由于进行了大量的违禁品交易，治安部可能正在准备针对你进行钓鱼执法。
mech_nightlog_sting_warning.en: Due to high levels of contraband trading, Security is running possible sting operations against you.

mech_nightlog_investigation_near.zh: 治安部对你采取的调查已临近完成。
mech_nightlog_investigation_near.en: An active Security investigation against you is almost complete.

mech_nightlog_afterhour_debuff.zh: 由于昨晚的夜间活动，你今天开店迟到了。你因此错过了一名顾客。
mech_nightlog_afterhour_debuff.en: You open up the store late due to last night's activities and missed out on one customer.

mech_nightlog_fixer_used.zh: 王尔德的善后人今晚出动，去让目击者闭嘴并清理了证据。你的犯罪嫌疑度已降低。
mech_nightlog_fixer_used.en: Wild's Fixer went out to silence witnesses and remove evidence tonight. Your suspected crime level has decreased.

mech_nightlog_storefront_not_cleaned.en: The storefront was not cleaned last night, {0}

mech_nightlog_storefront_clean.zh: 店面已被打扫干净，垃圾也已清理。
mech_nightlog_storefront_clean.en: The storefront has been cleaned and garbage has been collected.

mech_nightlog_vandalism_cleaned.zh: 清洁服务已清理了最近遭到恶意破坏后留下的烂摊子。顾客现在应该能再次安心光顾店铺了。
mech_nightlog_vandalism_cleaned.en: The Janitorial Service has cleaned up the mess caused by recent vandalism. Customers should feel safe again to visit the Store now.

mech_nightlog_garbage_clean.zh: 但反正也没什么需要打扫的。
mech_nightlog_garbage_clean.en: but there was nothing to clean anyway.

mech_nightlog_garbage_some.zh: 店门前堆着垃圾袋，可能会使少数顾客望而却步。
mech_nightlog_garbage_some.en: there are garbage bags in front of the store, a few customers may be deterred from visiting.

mech_nightlog_garbage_lot.zh: 店门前遍地都是垃圾和破烂，潜在的顾客都不愿光顾店铺了！
mech_nightlog_garbage_lot.en: there's so much garbage and junk left in front of the store, that it is deterring potential customers from visiting the Store!

mech_nightlog_garbage_extreme.zh: 店门前简直是一塌糊涂！垃圾和废料堆积成山，即便是有心光顾的人都很难靠近店铺。
mech_nightlog_garbage_extreme.en: it's a complete mess! There's so much garbage and rubble that it's hard to even approach the store, even for those who want to.

mech_nightlog_power_off.zh: 由于未缴纳电费，店铺的电力已被切断。昏暗的应急灯亮起。
mech_nightlog_power_off.en: The power has been cut off due to an unpaid power bill. Your dim emergency light flicks on.

mech_nightlog_power_on.en: The power bill has been paid.

mech_nightlog_cartel_protection.zh: 店铺正处于卡特尔的保护之下，小偷们绝对不敢试图抢劫你。
mech_nightlog_cartel_protection.en: The Cartel is protecting the Store. Thieves wouldn't dare try to rob you.

mech_nightlog_insurance_unpaid.zh: 你目前尚未投保。你的保险已中断{0}天。
mech_nightlog_insurance_unpaid.en: You aren't currently covered by the insurance service. It has been {0} days since you were last covered.

mech_nightlog_insurance_paid.zh: 保险服务已支付，你已获得保障！
mech_nightlog_insurance_paid.en: The insurance service has been paid, you are covered!

mech_nightlog_burglary_alarm_stopped.zh: 店铺遭到了闯入！所幸安全警报被触发了，小偷空手而归。
mech_nightlog_burglary_alarm_stopped.en: There's been a break in! Luckily, the security alarm was triggered and the thief left empty handed.

mech_nightlog_burglary_alarm_failed.zh: 昨晚发生了一起入室盗窃！搞什么鬼？！安全警报竟然失效了！{0}被偷走了！
mech_nightlog_burglary_alarm_failed.en: There was a burglary last night! What the hell?! The security alarm failed! {0} was stolen!

mech_nightlog_burglary_insured.zh: 发生了一起入室盗窃。{0}被偷走了，但乔·王尔德的手下找到了小偷，并在早上把被盗物品带了回来。
mech_nightlog_burglary_insured.en: There was a burglary. {0} was stolen, but Joe Wild's men found the thief and brought back the stolen item in the morning.

mech_nightlog_vandalized_lower.zh: 你的店铺被愤怒的下层区顾客破坏了！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_lower.en: Your store has been vandalized by angry Lower Level customers!

mech_nightlog_vandalized_security.zh: 你的店铺被治安部拥趸破坏了！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_security.en: Your store has been vandalized by Security sympathizers!

mech_nightlog_vandalized_upper.zh: 你的店铺被上层区顾客雇佣的暴徒破坏了！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_upper.en: Your Store has been vandalized by thugs hired by Upper Level customers!

mech_nightlog_vandalized_revolution.zh: 你的店铺被革命军同情者破坏了！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_revolution.en: Your Store has been vandalized by Revolution sympathizers!

mech_nightlog_vandalized_cartel.zh: 你的店铺被卡特尔破坏了，这是一种威胁！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_cartel.en: Your Store has been vandalized by the Cartel as a threat!

mech_nightlog_vandalized_generic.zh: 你的店铺被愤怒的顾客破坏了！
mech_nightlog_vandalized_generic.en: Your Store has been vandalized by angry customers!

mech_nightlog_store_vandalized.zh: 你的店铺遭到了破坏！顾客光顾的可能性降低，且善后清理需要花费更多的钱。
mech_nightlog_store_vandalized.en: Your Store has been vandalized! Customers are less likely to visit, and it will cost significantly more to clean up the mess.

mech_nightlog_faction_op_date.zh: 基于你的声望，某个派系与你透露了一项即将开始的行动的日期。
mech_nightlog_faction_op_date.en: Due to your Reputation, a faction has shared the date of an upcoming operation with you.

mech_nightlog_contact_ready.zh: 你的联系人{0}现在已准备好接受新订单了。
mech_nightlog_contact_ready.en: Your contact, {0}, is now ready to take on a new order.

mech_nightlog_blackout_bypassed.zh: 虽然发生了停电，但多亏了你偷接私电，店里依然有电！
mech_nightlog_blackout_bypassed.en: There's a blackout, but thanks to the Power Hijack, you still have power!

mech_nightlog_blackout_active.zh: 发生了停电。电力供应中断了！昏暗的应急灯亮起。
mech_nightlog_blackout_active.en: There's a blackout. The power is out! Your dim emergency light flicks on.

mech_report_rep_slightly_improved.zh: '你在治安部的声望略有提高。'
mech_report_rep_slightly_improved.en: 'Your Reputation with Security has slightly improved.'

mech_market_price_change.zh: 受{1}影响，{0}的市场价格发生了变动

event_op_household_relief_desc.zh: 上层区一家慈善机构向下层区居民慷慨捐赠了一批生活必需品。尽管一些人对其动机持有怀疑态度，但这批援助应该有助于改善生活条件，并安抚日益增长的不安情绪。
event_op_household_relief_desc.en: A charity in the Upper Levels has made a generous donation of essential Household Goods to Lower Levels residents. While some remain skeptical of the motives, the aid should helps improve living conditions and settle any growing unrest.

event_evidence_locker_desc.zh: 空间站中央证物库发生了一起骇人听闻的入侵事件，令治安部焦头烂额。据报道，一箱被没收的违禁品现已失踪，其中包含某项正在调查的案件的关键证据。治安部已警告下层区居民，严密留意流入市面的可疑物品。
event_evidence_locker_desc.en: A daring break-in at the Station's Central Evidence Locker has left Security scrambling. Reports indicate that a crate of confiscated contraband, including key evidence in an active investigation, has gone missing. Security have warned the citizens of the Lower Levels to keep an eye out for suspicious goods entering circulation.

event_cosmetic_all_quiet_news.en: All Quiet In The Lower Levels

event_cosmetic_all_quiet_desc.zh: 下层区今日出奇地安静，未接到重大事件报告。市场维持稳定，居民生活一如往常。
event_cosmetic_all_quiet_desc.en: The Lower Levels have been unusually quiet today, with no major incidents to report. Markets are stable and residents are going about their daily lives.

event_cosmetic_electrical_desc.zh: 因例行电力检修作业开始实施，上层区将会临时停电。
event_cosmetic_electrical_desc.en: The Upper Levels will experience a temporary blackout as planned electrical maintenance work gets underway.

event_cosmetic_nutrifruit_desc.zh: 下层区的一群维护技术员联合开发了一套低成本水培系统，能够小批量、稳定地生产营养果。
event_cosmetic_nutrifruit_desc.en: A collective of Lower Levels maintenance technicians have developed a low-cost hydroponic system capable of producing small but consistent batches of Nutrifruit.

event_cosmetic_peat_news.zh: “泥炭”肉罐头里到底有多少肉？
event_cosmetic_peat_news.en: How Much Meat Is Actually In PEAT?

event_cosmetic_peat_desc.zh: 作为下层区家家户户厨房必备的加工肉罐头食品，“泥炭”正面临着严密调查。独立研究人员正对该产品中实际的含肉量提出质疑。
event_cosmetic_peat_desc.en: PEAT, the canned processed meat found in nearly every kitchen in the Lower Levels, is under scrutiny. Independent researchers are questioning how much of the product is actually meat.

event_cosmetic_recycling_desc.zh: 中层区发起了一场小规模的垃圾回收宣传活动，以鼓励妥善处理废弃物。预计该活动不会产生任何实际效果。
event_cosmetic_recycling_desc.en: A small recycling awareness campaign has been launched on the mid-levels to encourage proper waste disposal. The campaign is expected to have minimal practical impact.

event_cosmetic_artist_showcase_desc.zh: 下层区正在举办一场本地艺术家作品展，居民们可以在这里观赏并购买由空间站回收材料制成的艺术品。
event_cosmetic_artist_showcase_desc.en: A local artist showcase is being hosted in the Lower Levels, where residents can view and purchase artwork made from recycled station materials.

event_cosmetic_maintenance_strike_desc.zh: 维护人员的短暂罢工已得到解决，未接到严重延误或损失的报告。目前各项工作已恢复正常。
event_cosmetic_maintenance_strike_desc.en: A brief strike by maintenance crews has been resolved with no significant delays or damages reported. Normal operations have resumed.

event_cosmetic_tech_demo_desc.zh: 上层区组织了一场科技展，展示了初创公司和科技企业的最新创新成果。展出的大多数产品均面向高端买家。
event_cosmetic_tech_demo_desc.en: A technology exhibition has been organized on the Upper Levels, showcasing the latest innovations from startups and tech companies. Most products on display are aimed at high-end buyers.

event_cosmetic_transit_news.en: New Transit Line Opens on Mid-Level

event_cosmetic_transit_desc.zh: 中层区开通了一条新的交通线，将多个住宅区与一个商业中心连接起来。交通条件的改善预计将略微缓解中层区居民的通勤压力。
event_cosmetic_transit_desc.en: A new transit line has opened on the mid-levels, connecting several residential districts to a commercial hub. The improved connectivity is expected to slightly ease commutes for mid-level residents.

event_cosmetic_fountain_desc.zh: 作为空间站美化工程的一部分，上层区落成了一座新喷泉。治安部已发出提醒，任何被发现饮用喷泉水的公民都将被逮捕并处以罚款。
event_cosmetic_fountain_desc.en: A new water fountain has been unveiled on the Upper Levels as part of an ongoing beautification project. Security has advised that any citizen caught drinking from the fountain will be arrested and fined.

event_cosmetic_garden_desc.zh: 下层区居民扩建了他们的公共园圃，增加了几块用于种植基础蔬菜的新区域。此举不太可能影响食物价格。
event_cosmetic_garden_desc.en: Lower Level residents have expanded their community garden with a few new plots for growing basic vegetables. The development is unlikely to affect Food prices.

event_cosmetic_art_contest_desc.zh: 中层区某社区中心举办了一场艺术比赛，邀请居民们投稿自己的创作，优秀作品将在公共场所展示一周。
event_cosmetic_art_contest_desc.en: An art contest held in a mid-level community center invited residents to submit their creations, with the best entries to be displayed in public spaces for a week.

event_cosmetic_cultural_desc.zh: 某上层区文化组织正举办一场小型庆祝活动，内容包括传统表演、音乐和美食。该活动主要由上层区居民参加，对市场影响甚微。
event_cosmetic_cultural_desc.en: An Upper Level cultural group is holding a small celebration featuring traditional performances, music, and food. The event will be mostly attended by Upper Level residents and have little impact on the market.

event_cosmetic_spacewalk_news.zh: 例行舱外活动训练演习

event_cosmetic_spacewalk_desc.zh: 针对空间站技术人员的例行舱外活动训练演习已顺利完成，未对空间站的日常活动造成干扰。据报道，下层区的一名男子错把进行舱外活动的人员当成了外星人而当场休克，目前正在接受治疗。
event_cosmetic_spacewalk_desc.en: A routine spacewalk training exercise for station technicians has been successfully completed with no disruptions to station activities. One man from the Lower Levels is reportedly being treated for shock, after mistaking a spacewalker for an alien.

event_normal_nutrifruit_harvest_news.zh: 营养果农场喜迎大丰收！

event_normal_nutrifruit_harvest_desc.zh: 中层区一家大型农场正在收割其种植的营养果。预计短期内市场将出现新鲜营养果，食物价格也会随之下降。
event_normal_nutrifruit_harvest_desc.en: A large Mid-Level farm is harvesting its Nutrifruit crop. Expect fresh Nutrifruit and lower Food prices for a while.

event_normal_bad_harvest_desc.zh: 下层区的一家营养果农场本季度歉收，作物因缺乏适当的资源和维护而枯萎。预计短期内食物价格将上涨，新鲜产品也将出现短缺。
event_normal_bad_harvest_desc.en: A Lower Level Nutrifruit farm has had a terrible season, with crops failing due to lack of proper resources and maintenance. Expect higher Food prices and a shortage of fresh produce for a while.

event_normal_seed_heist_desc.zh: 水培农场仓库中的营养果种子在一夜之间被人洗劫一空。预计整个空间站的食物和种子的价格都将大幅上涨。
event_normal_seed_heist_desc.en: Nutrifruit seeds from hydroponic farm storage have vanished overnight in a daring theft. Both Food and Seed costs are expected to rise sharply across the station.

event_normal_counterfeit_med_desc.zh: 多个诊所和医院中发现了大量假冒医疗用品。预计对正品医疗物资的需求将激增。
event_normal_counterfeit_med_desc.en: A large quantity of counterfeit medical goods have been discovered across various clinics and hospitals. Demand for genuine medical supplies is expected to surge.

event_normal_water_breakdown_news.zh: 水处理厂故障，供水面临告急
event_normal_water_breakdown_news.en: Breakdown At Treatment Plant Threatens Water Supply

event_normal_water_breakdown_desc.zh: 中央水处理厂的水泵故障正对供水造成严重影响。治安部已呼吁民众保持冷静，市场专家预测未来几天水和净水物资的价格将飙升。
event_normal_water_breakdown_desc.en: A pump failure at the central Water Treatment Plant is causing major disruption to the water supply. Security has appealed for calm, as market experts anticipate prices for Water and Water Purification Supplies to soar over the next few days.

event_normal_water_maintenance_news.zh: 水处理厂将按期进行例行维护
event_normal_water_maintenance_news.en: Scheduled Maintenance To Proceed At Water Treatment Plant

event_normal_water_maintenance_desc.zh: 治安部宣布，中央水处理厂的例行维护将按计划进行。管道受到的影响预计会很有限。
event_normal_water_maintenance_desc.en: Routine maintenance at the central Water Treatment Plant will proceed on schedule, Security has announced. Disruptions to the pipeline are expected to be limited.

event_normal_ice_asteroid_desc.zh: 我们一支勇敢的采矿队已顺利完成富冰小行星“贝拉41-A”的勘探任务并返回。预计优质水的供应量将随之增加，水价也会下降。
event_normal_ice_asteroid_desc.en: One of our brave mining crews have returned from a successful expedition to the ice-rich asteroid known as "Beira 41-A". Their return is expected to result in an influx of High Quality Water, and lower prices as a result.

event_normal_mob_justice_news.en: Mob Justice in the Lower Levels!

event_normal_mob_justice_desc.zh: 下层区居民因再也无法忍受一名奸商，决定动用私刑。空间站治安部已呼吁民众保持冷静。
event_normal_mob_justice_desc.en: Fed up with a dishonest shopkeeper, citizens in the Lower Levels are taking justice into their own hands. Station Security have appealed for calm.

event_normal_storeroom_desc.zh: 下层区一群拾荒者偶然发现了一个堆满日用品的密室。大量商品涌入市场，很可能导致今日价格下跌。
event_normal_storeroom_desc.en: A group of scavengers in the Lower Levels have stumbled upon a hidden room packed with household items. A high volume of goods making their way to market will likely lower prices today.

event_normal_mining_return_desc.zh: 一批采矿队成功从富含矿产的小行星返航。预计材料价格将在短期内下跌。
event_normal_mining_return_desc.en: A cohort of miners have returned from an expedition to a mineral-rich asteroid. Material prices are expected to fall for a while.

event_normal_construction_desc.zh: 各类新建设项目正在整个下层区如雨后春笋般涌现。建筑材料和熟练劳工可能会面临短缺。
event_normal_construction_desc.en: Various new construction projects are springing up across the Lower Levels. Construction materials and skilled labourers are likely to be in shorter supply.

event_normal_meteor_shower_desc.zh: 昨夜一场流星雨袭击了空间站，导致多个区域出现损坏和破裂。缺乏加固舱体的下层区受灾最为严重——预计材料价格将上涨。
event_normal_meteor_shower_desc.en: A meteor shower struck the station last night, causing damage and breaches across multiple sectors. The Lower Levels, lacking a reinforced hull, suffered the most — expect material prices to rise.

event_normal_power_shortage_news.en: Low Power In The Lower Levels

event_normal_power_shortage_desc.zh: 发电机故障导致下层区停电。预计在维修期间，能量电池将出现短缺。
event_normal_power_shortage_desc.en: A faulty power generator has caused a power outage in the Lower Levels. Expect a shortage of energy cells while repairs are underway.

event_normal_power_maintenance_desc.zh: 下层区的一座主要发电厂已开始例行检修。居民们被告知在此检修期间内做好供电受到轻微干扰的准备。
event_normal_power_maintenance_desc.en: Routine maintenance has begun on one of the main power plants in the Lower Levels. Citizens have been told to expect minor disruptions to the power supply throughout the scheduled period.

event_normal_blackout_desc.zh: 中央电网的灾难性故障使整个空间站陷入了黑暗。预计对能量电池和电力相关产品的需求将会激增。
event_normal_blackout_desc.en: A catastrophic failure in the central power grid has plunged the entire Station into darkness. Expect a surge in demand for energy cells and power-related products.

event_normal_cruise_ship_desc.zh: 一艘游轮已在上层区靠泊，带来了一波游客。据推测，部分充满好奇心的游客甚至可能会逛到下层区。空间站治安部已呼吁公民在游览期间保持尊重。
event_normal_cruise_ship_desc.en: A cruise ship has docked in the Upper Levels, unloading a wave of tourists. It is expected that some curious visitors may even wander down to the Lower Levels. Station Security has appealed for citizens to be respectful during the visit.

event_normal_oxymore_news.zh: 奥克西莫成瘾情况日益严重

event_normal_oxymore_desc.zh: 据报道，整个空间站的奥克西莫使用量急剧增加，各诊所的成瘾和过量病例也随之激增。预计对医疗用品和治疗服务的需求将会上涨。
event_normal_oxymore_desc.en: A sharp increase in Oxymore use has been reported across the Station, with clinics seeing a surge in addiction and overdose cases. Expect rising demand for medical supplies and treatment services.

ins_cig_issues_with.en: There's an issue with the {0}. You see?

ins_cig_confront_correct.zh: 哎呀，你这么一说我就看出来了。
ins_cig_confront_correct.en: Ah yes, I see it now.

ins_cig_confront_wrong.zh: 你再仔细看看呢，这绝对没问题。
ins_cig_confront_wrong.en: Check again, there is nothing wrong with it.

ins_cig_georgio_didnt_know.zh: 啊，乔治奥之前不知道呢。
ins_cig_georgio_didnt_know.en: Ah, Georgio didn't know about this.

ins_cig_georgio_everything_wrong.zh: 这些香烟到处都是问题。
ins_cig_georgio_everything_wrong.en: Everything is wrong with these cigarettes.

ins_cig_talk_genuine_deny.en: No, it is not. I checked it myself.

ins_stamp_confront_correct.zh: 真的吗？我之前都没发现。
ins_stamp_confront_correct.en: Is there? I had no idea.

mech_end_rent_desc.zh: 由于未能支付租金，你被驱逐了。被你的顾客、联系人甚至导师所抛弃，你被迫回到了拾荒者的生活。没过多久，这家店就租给了某个新人，而你发现自己站在了柜台的另一边，为了几个信用点讨价还价。
mech_end_rent_desc.en: As a result of failing to pay your rent, you were evicted. Abandoned by your customers, your contact, and even The Mentor, you are forced to go back to the life of a scavenger. It isn't long before the Store is rented out to somebody new, and you find yourself standing on the other side of the counter, haggling for just a few credits more.

afterhour_items_lost_warning.zh: 丢在地上的物品将被遗弃并永久丢失。确定要离开吗？
afterhour_items_lost_warning.en: Items left on the ground will be left behind, and lost. Are you sure you want to leave?

afterhour_jackson_warning.zh: 杰克逊博士会派助手来回收你丢在地上的所有物品。确定要离开吗？
afterhour_jackson_warning.en: Dr. Jackson will send his assistant to retrieve any items you left on the ground. Are you sure you want to leave?

afterhour_attempts_wounded.zh: 剩余尝试次数：受伤时无法拾荒！

mech_gutterflow_tap.zh: 水管目前已连接至下水道。
mech_gutterflow_tap.en: The water line is currently connected to the sewer.

mech_rustwater_tap.zh: 水管目前已连接至工业排放管。
mech_rustwater_tap.en: The water line is currently connected to the industrial discharge pipe.

water_higher_player.zh: 呵……这水的纯度比你说的还要高！
water_higher_player.en: Huh... The water purity is actually higher!

water_higher_client.en: Wow, thanks for letting me know.

water_rust_player.zh: 这是铁锈水。我都能看到水里的颗粒了。
water_rust_player.en: This is Rustwater. I can see the particles in the water.

water_rust_client.zh: 那咋啦？行吧，我降价就是了。
water_rust_client.en: So? Fine, I'll lower the price.

water_gutter_player.zh: 这分明是沟渠水。它是棕色的，看见没？
water_gutter_player.en: This is clearly Gutterflow. It's brown, see?

water_ghost_player.zh: 这是幽灵水。肉眼确实很难看出来，我可不会掉以轻心。
water_ghost_player.en: This is Ghostwater. It's hard to tell, can't be too careful.

water_ghost_client.zh: 真的吗？那我给你便宜点。
water_ghost_client.en: Really? I'll lower the price, then.

water_base_player.zh: 这是基础水。你当我是好糊弄的？
water_base_player.en: This is Basewater. Are you trying to pull a fast one or what?

water_incorrect_client.zh: 好吧，我重新给你报个价。

water_wrong_pure.zh: 我没有足够的信用点买纯水。
water_wrong_pure.en: I don't have the Credits for Pure Water.

water_wrong_rust.zh: 你疯了吗？我才不喝铁锈水！
water_wrong_rust.en: Are you crazy? I'm not drinking Rustwater!

water_wrong_gutter.zh: 不会吧，你指望我喝那玩意儿？
water_wrong_gutter.en: Wow, you expect me to drink that?

water_wrong_default.zh: 得了吧……我绝不会喝那东西。

husbandry_cage_desc.zh: 用于饲养动物的小笼子。看起来不怎么舒服，但可能比下层区某些人的住处要好。
husbandry_cage_desc.en: A small cage for housing animals. Doesn't look particularly comfortable, but probably nicer than what some people have in the Lower Levels.

husbandry_cage_expand_hint.zh: '[使用金属锭扩建（剩余{0}次升级）]'
husbandry_cage_expand_hint.en: '[Use Metal Ingot to Expand ({0} upgrade(s) remaining)]'

note_ghostwater_threat_1.zh: 别再卖那种假水了，你这是在把我们害死！
note_ghostwater_threat_1.en: Stop selling that bogus water, you are killing us!

note_ghostwater_threat_2.zh: 我们知道你干的好事。马上停止卖假水！
note_ghostwater_threat_2.en: We know what you did. Stop the water scam, NOW!

note_ghostwater_threat_3.zh: 再敢继续卖受污染的水的话，你会后悔的。
note_ghostwater_threat_3.en: Keep on selling tainted water, and you'll regret it.

note_ghostwater_threat_4.zh: 把幽灵水当成饮用水卖，你晚上睡得着觉吗？
note_ghostwater_threat_4.en: How do you sleep when you are selling Ghostwater as drinking water?

note_ghostwater_threat_5.zh: 别再卖幽灵水了，否则我们会亲自动手阻止你。
note_ghostwater_threat_5.en: Stop the Ghostwater scam, or we'll stop you ourselves.

note_ghostwater_threat_6.zh: 你的假水要害死人了。下一个死的就是你。
note_ghostwater_threat_6.en: Your fake water is killing us. You're next.

note_ammo_threat_1.zh: 你的子弹差点把我害死。
note_ammo_threat_1.en: Your ammo almost got me killed.

note_admirer_1.zh: 我每天都会经过你的店铺……总有一天我能鼓起勇气对你打声招呼的。
note_admirer_1.en: Every day I pass by your shop... one day I'll have the courage to say hello.

note_admirer_2.zh: 你不认识我，但我对你的一切了如指掌。继续做你自己就好。
note_admirer_2.en: You don't know me, but I know everything about you. Keep being you.

note_admirer_3.zh: 我给你留了点东西。只是……聊表谢意。
note_admirer_3.en: I left something for you. Just a small token of... appreciation.

note_admirer_4.zh: '不知道你有没有发现，我一直在暗中注视着你…… '
note_admirer_4.en: 'I wonder if you ever notice me watching from the shadows... '

note_admirer_5.zh: 你让下层区有了一丝光明。
note_admirer_5.en: You make the Lower Levels feel a little brighter.

note_admirer_6.zh: 你是我还会来这里的唯一理由。注意安全。
note_admirer_6.en: You're the only reason I come here anymore. Stay safe.

note_admirer_7.zh: 致我最喜欢的店主，今天也别忘了微笑哦。
note_admirer_7.en: To my favorite shopkeeper, don't forget to smile today.

mech_item_broken_machine_desc.zh: 一台完全损坏的机器。已经无法修复。
mech_item_broken_machine_desc.en: A completely broken machine. It's beyond repair.

mech_report_wanted_body.zh: '{0}信用点已入账。多亏了你的协助，治安部成功抓捕了{1}。'
mech_report_wanted_body.en: '{0} Credits has been added to your account. Security has captured {1} thanks to your assistance.'

mech_report_contraband_body.zh: '{0}信用点已入账。多亏了你的协助，治安部成功抓捕了一名违禁品贩子。'
mech_report_contraband_body.en: '{0} Credits has been added to your account. Security has captured a contraband dealer thanks to your assistance.'

mech_report_thief_body.zh: '{0}信用点已入账。多亏了你的协助，治安部成功抓捕了一名小偷。'
mech_report_thief_body.en: '{0} Credits has been added to your account. Security has captured a thief thanks to your assistance.'

event_op_weapon_shipment_news.zh: 非法武器走私货物抵达！

event_op_weapon_shipment_desc.zh: 一大批非法武器已经躲过治安部的巡逻，流入下层区。预计武器供应量将激增，价格会随之下降。
event_op_weapon_shipment_desc.en: A large shipment of illegal weapons has slipped past Security patrols and entered the Lower Levels. Expect a surge in weapon availability and drop in prices.

event_op_mob_secret_desc.zh: 报告显示，整个下层区的神秘买家对武器的需求出现了小幅激增。
event_op_mob_secret_desc.en: Reports indicate a minor surge in demands for weapons from secret buyers all over the Lower Levels.

mech_end_aug_desc.zh: 改造体的数量已经失控，现在已经开始公开活动。在夜里，一群改造体闯入了你的店铺，强行给你植入了改造芯片。治安部始终没有出现。随着芯片启动，你成为了这具曾属于你的躯壳里的一名过客。
mech_end_aug_desc.en: The Aug population reached a critical point and now operates openly. During the night, a group of Augs broke into your store and forcibly installed an augmentation chip. Security never arrived. The implant activates. You are only a passenger in your own body.

shotgun_cant_equip.en: Cannot equip the shotgun right now

mech_aug_kill_slip.zh: '{0}信用点已入账。多亏了你的协助，一名改造体被成功消灭。'
mech_aug_kill_slip.en: '{0} Credits has been added to your account. An Aug has been eliminated thanks to your assistance.'

mech_nightlog_aug_left_alive.zh: 你的一位联系人通知你，昨天有一名改造体曾光顾过你的店铺。
mech_nightlog_aug_left_alive.en: One of your contacts has informed you that an Aug has visited your store yesterday.

mech_wine_no_ingredients.zh: 原材料不足，无法开始发酵
mech_wine_no_ingredients.en: Not Enough Ingredients To Start Fermentation

mech_wine_no_water.zh: 水量不足，无法开始发酵
mech_wine_no_water.en: Not Enough Water To Start Fermentation

mech_wine_fermenting_remaining.zh: 发酵中……距离完成还有{0}天。

mech_chemical_supplies_unpack_warning.zh: 这将会把物资拆解为不可交易的化学品。确定要这么做吗？
mech_chemical_supplies_unpack_warning.en: This will unpack the supplies into untradable chemicals. Are you sure you want to do that?

mech_toggle_appearance_hint.zh: 切换此物品以更改其外观
mech_toggle_appearance_hint.en: Toggle this item to change its appearance

mech_portable_purifier_already_clean.zh: 这些水已经是基础水或更好的水质了。
mech_portable_purifier_already_clean.en: This water is already Basewater or better.

mech_portable_purifier_not_enough_charge.zh: 净水器剩余的电量不足以净化这么多的水。
mech_portable_purifier_not_enough_charge.en: The purifier doesn't have enough charge left to clean this much water.

mech_nightlog_aug_incoming.zh: 治安部传来消息，今天可能会有改造体来你的店里。
mech_nightlog_aug_incoming.en: You have received word from Security that an Aug is likely to visit your store today.

mech_black_lamp_hint.en: Double-click to change who it calls.

mech_aging_item_tooltip.zh: 该物品会随着时间推移而升值。
mech_aging_item_tooltip.en: This item will gain value as it ages.

mech_display_case_timing_tip.zh: 当日营业开始后放入展示柜的物品，要到第二天才会生效。请在开店前布置好展示柜。
mech_display_case_timing_tip.en: Items added to the display case after the day begins have no effect until the next day. Stock the case before you open the store.

mech_vending_tooltip_markup.zh: 自动售货机会以加价后的固定价格出售商品，不受当前生效事件影响。
mech_vending_tooltip_markup.en: Vending machine will sell with a markup at a fixed price regardless of active events.

mech_vending_tooltip_popular.zh: 某些类型的物品通过自动售货机出售时更受欢迎。
mech_vending_tooltip_popular.en: Certain types of item are more popular in the vending machine.

mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_attract.zh: 可使用电子元件升级，以提高吸引力。
mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_attract.en: Can be upgraded with Electronic Parts to increase attractiveness

mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_capacity.zh: 可使用金属锭升级，以提高容量。
mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_capacity.en: Can be upgraded with Metal Ingot to increase capacity

mech_fountain_tooltip_upgrade_attract.zh: 可使用电子元件升级，以提高吸引力
mech_fountain_tooltip_upgrade_attract.en: Can be upgraded with Electronic Parts to increase attractiveness

mech_seed_nutrient_use.zh: 矿物质消耗：{0}毫升/生长阶段

mech_commissary_lottery_redeemed.zh: 已将所有中奖彩票兑换为{0}信用点！
mech_commissary_lottery_redeemed.en: Redeemed All Winning Lottery Tickets for {0} Credits!

mech_report_wrongful.zh: ' 你向治安部作出了不实举报。 '
mech_report_wrongful.en: ' You have made a wrongful report to Security. '

mech_report_fine.zh: ' 已从你的账户中扣除{0}信用点的罚款。 '
mech_report_fine.en: ' {0} Credits has been deducted from your account as fine. '

mech_report_next_arrest.zh: ' 下次再作出不实举报，你将被逮捕。 '
mech_report_next_arrest.en: ' Your next wrongful report will lead to your arrest. '

mech_report_severe_consequences.zh: ' 继续作出不实举报可能造成严重后果。 '
mech_report_severe_consequences.en: ' Further wrongful reports might have severe consequences. '

event_op_gang_war_news.en: Gang war In The Lower Levels!

event_op_gang_war_desc.zh: 敌对帮派已相互宣战！枪战和小规模冲突席卷下层区，医疗物资需求预计将会上升。
event_op_gang_war_desc.en: Rival gangs has declared war on each other! Shootouts and skirmishes have erupted across the Lower Levels. Expect increased demand for Medical Supplies.

event_op_mobilization_desc.zh: 下层区已侦测到大规模革命活动。各革命小组正在为一场重大行动做最后准备，武器、医疗物资和护甲价格预计将会暴涨。
event_op_mobilization_desc.en: Major revolution activities have been detected in the Lower Levels. Revolution cells are making final preparations for a major operation. Expected Weapon, Medical Supplies and Armor prices to surge.

event_op_raid_upper_desc.zh: 革命军对上层区发动了大胆突袭，从住宅和商铺中掠夺物资，再拿到下层区出售以筹措行动经费。日用品供应预计将会增加。
event_op_raid_upper_desc.en: Revolutionaries have launched daring raids in the Upper Levels. Looting goods from homes and businesses to sell in the Lower Levels to fund their operations. Expected increase supply for Household Goods

event_op_raid_sec_desc.zh: 革命军伏击了治安部在下层区的一处主要据点。冲突造成双方伤亡，也殃及了被卷入交火的下层区居民，致使医疗物资需求上升，治安部的影响力减弱。
event_op_raid_sec_desc.en: Revolutionaries have ambushed a major Lower Levels Security outpost. The clashes have led to losses on both sides along with Lower Levels Citizens caught in the crossfire, driving up demand for medical supplies and weakening Security influence.

event_op_patrols_desc.zh: 治安部暂时扩大了巡逻范围，并在下层区各处增设检查站。部分革命军和黑市活动受到压制，下层区也恢复了些许秩序。
event_op_patrols_desc.en: Security has temporarily expanded patrols and set up new checkpoints across the Lower Levels. Some Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed, brining back some order in the Lower Levels.

event_op_crackdown_desc.zh: 鉴于黑市活动日益猖獗、大量非法货物流入空间站，指挥部已宣布全面严打违禁品。即刻起，所有区域将实施更严格的盘查。
event_op_crackdown_desc.en: In response to growing concerns over the rise in black market activity and the influx of illegal goods across the station, Command has announced a comprehensive crackdown on contraband. Effective immediately, the enforcement of stricter inspections will be implemented across all sectors.

event_op_raid_bm_desc.zh: 治安部队突袭了多处黑市窝点，查获大量武器和毒品，令非法贸易难以开展。
event_op_raid_bm_desc.en: Security forces launched a surprise raid on black market hubs. Large amount of weapon and narcotic were seized, disrupting illegal trade.

event_op_raid_rev_desc.zh: 治安部突袭了一处已经暴露的革命军安全屋。人员被捕、物资被没收，革命力量因此遭到削弱。
event_op_raid_rev_desc.en: Security has raided a uncovered revolutionary safehouse. The arrests and confiscations has weaken the revolution.

event_op_martial_law_desc.zh: 受近期事件影响，下层区已全面戒严。宵禁、检查站和监控遍布整个区域，革命军与黑市活动受到压制。
event_op_martial_law_desc.en: Due to recent events, Martial law has been declared across the Lower Levels. Curfews, checkpoints, and surveillance blanket the district. Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed.

event_op_budget_increase_desc.zh: 指挥部大幅增加了治安部的预算，使其能够开展更多行动。
event_op_budget_increase_desc.en: Command allocates a major budget increase to Security, allowing additional operations to be launched.

event_op_riot_desc.zh: 受近期事件影响，大批下层区居民在各地掀起暴乱。商铺遭到洗劫，治安部据点遇袭，混乱迅速蔓延。食物和武器需求激增。
event_op_riot_desc.en: Due to recent event, crowds of Lower Levels citizens erupt into violent riots across the Lower Levels. Shops are looted, Security outposts attacked, and chaos spreads quickly. Food and Weapon are in high demands.

event_op_worker_strike_desc.zh: 受近期事件影响，心怀不满的下层区工人已经罢工，食物和水的供应正受到干扰。
event_op_worker_strike_desc.en: Due to recent events, disgruntled Lower Level workers have gone on strike. Food and water supplies are being disrupted.

event_op_medical_aid_desc.zh: 上层区慈善机构向下层区增派了医护人员，并调拨了额外的医疗物资。尽管一些居民仍持怀疑态度，这项援助还是缓解了动荡。
event_op_medical_aid_desc.en: Upper Level charities have gather additional medical staff and supplies to the Lower Levels. While some residents remain skeptical, the effort reduces unrest.

event_op_food_drive_desc.zh: 指挥部罕见地释放善意，在下层区各街区发放口粮和食物包。这项举措缓和了紧张局势，但也有人认为这只是面子工程。
event_op_food_drive_desc.en: In a rare gesture of goodwill, Command has distributed rations and food packages across Lower Levels neighborhoods. The initiative eases tensions but some view it as a propaganda tactic.

event_lottery_draw_desc.zh: 开奖号码是{0}！请向彩票代表兑奖！彩票号码只要至少有3位与开奖号码相符，就能赢得奖金！祝你好运！
event_lottery_draw_desc.en: '{0} is the winning number! Redeem your ticket with your lottery representative! If you have at least 3 matching digits, you win a prize! Good Luck!'

event_wanted3_desc.zh: 空间站治安部迅速采取行动，逮捕了知名活动人士亚瑟·拉弗勒。此人曾是下层区历次失败革命中的领导层成员。
event_wanted3_desc.en: In a swift operation by station security, Arthur Lafleur, a known activist and part of the former leadership in the failed revolution attempts of the lower levels, has been apprehended.

mech_end_arrest_desc.zh: 治安部以危害空间站的罪名逮捕了你，并将你关进拘留所。服刑期间，你的店铺被租给了别人。获释后，失去店铺的你只能重操旧业，再次成为一名勉强糊口的拾荒者。
mech_end_arrest_desc.en: For crimes against the station, the Security arrested you. You were locked up in the brig. While serving your sentence, your store was leased to someone else. After your release, with the store lost, you went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.

mech_end_execution_desc.zh: 治安部以危害空间站的重罪逮捕并处决了你。死后，你的店铺被租给了别人，顾客很快便将你遗忘。随着时间流逝，你在空间站留下的一切痕迹都消失了。
mech_end_execution_desc.en: For capital crimes against the station, the Security arrested and executed you. After your execution your store was leased to someone else. Your customers quickly forgot about you, and in time, there was no trace of you left on the Station.

mech_end_buyout_desc.zh: 你签下房契，租金的重担与房东的阴影一同消散。店铺从此彻底属于你——在这个从未善待过你的世界里，这是一场来之不易的胜利。你第一次真正掌握了自己的未来，今后引领你的，唯有自己的雄心。
mech_end_buyout_desc.en: You sign the deed, and with it, the weight of the rent vanishes, alongside the shadow of the Landlord. The shop is yours, free and clear, a hard-earned victory in a world that's never been kind. For the first time, you stand in control of your future, with nothing but your own ambition to guide you.

mech_end_buyout_mortgage_desc.zh: 你签下最后一份文件，斩断了高利贷者束缚你的最后一道锁链。店铺如今真正属于你，再也没有被收走的威胁，也摆脱了地下势力的阴影。你克服了重重困难，熬过了无尽的苦日子，最终笑到了最后。未来属于你。
mech_end_buyout_mortgage_desc.en: You sign the final papers, and with it, the last chains that bound you to the loan shark are broken. The store is truly yours now, free from the threat of repossession, free from the shadow of the underworld. You've beaten the odds, survived the grind, and come out on top. The future is yours.

mech_end_repo_desc.zh: 一切都走到了尽头。店铺被人收走，你为之奋斗的一切也从指间溜走。高利贷者冰冷的魔爪日益收紧，将你逼得无路可逃。你破了产、无家可归，只剩下一段苦涩的教训：在这个残酷的世界里，失去一切不过是转瞬之间的事。
mech_end_repo_desc.en: It's the end of the road. The store is taken from you, and with it, everything you fought for slips through your fingers. The loan shark's cold grip tightens as the walls close in, leaving you bankrupt, homeless, and with nothing but a bitter reminder of how quickly everything can be lost in this unforgiving world.

mech_end_mob_desc.zh: 你屡次得罪下层区，终于招来一群愤怒的顾客冲进店铺。他们夺走了你的一切，再把你扔出气闸。这就是下层区的正义。
mech_end_mob_desc.en: After one too many offences against the Lower Levels, a mob of angry customers stormed your store. They took everything you owned and you were thrown out of the airlock. This is justice in the Lower Levels.

mech_end_sec_desc.zh: 治安部以捏造的罪名逮捕了你，并将你扔进拘留所。店铺遭到查封并被变卖，用来抵扣一笔巨额罚款。几周后你获释了，但店铺早已不复存在。你只能重操旧业，再次成为一名勉强糊口的拾荒者。
mech_end_sec_desc.en: Arrested by the Security on some trumped up charges, you were thrown in the brig. The store was seized and sold to pay for a large fine. You were released after a few weeks, but the store was long gone. You went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.

mech_end_hitman_desc.zh: 你屡次得罪上层区，最终，空间站的权贵雇来一名杀手，让你永远闭上了嘴。
mech_end_hitman_desc.en: After one too many offences against the Upper Levels, a hitman was contracted by the elites of the station to take you out for good.

mech_end_sentinel_desc.zh: 你漏打了太多次免疫宁，失常的免疫系统终于开始攻击你的身体。杀死你的不是疾病，而是你自己。
mech_end_sentinel_desc.en: After skipping one too many Immunivax injectors, your faulty immune system turned on your own body. It wasn't an illness that killed you, it was yourself.

mech_end_bombed_desc.zh: 被革命军宣布为敌人后，你的店里遭人安放了炸弹。爆炸摧毁了店铺，也夺走了你的性命。店铺的废墟成了留给其他人的警告：这就是胆敢反对革命军的下场。
mech_end_bombed_desc.en: After being declared as an enemy of the Revolution, a bomb was planted in your store. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you. The ruin of your store served as a warning to others who would dare to oppose the Revolution.

mech_end_cartel_retired_desc.zh: 卡特尔认定留着你已经没有价值，于是让你永远“退出”了这一行。
mech_end_cartel_retired_desc.en: The Cartel decided that you were no longer worth keeping around. You were retired from the business.

mech_end_vendor_permit_desc.zh: 你没能取得营业许可证，只得被迫关店。
mech_end_vendor_permit_desc.en: You weren't able to secure a vendor permit and were forced to close your store.

request_meteor_ll_desc.zh: 流星雨击穿了下层区的多处设施。我们已经封锁邻近区域并开始修补破口，但由于物资短缺，进展十分缓慢。
request_meteor_ll_desc.en: The meteor shower breached a number of areas in the Lower Levels. We have closed down adjacent areas and started repairs on the breaches, but progress has been slow due to lack of supplies.

request_meteor_ul_desc.zh: 上层区社区泳池在流星雨中受损，反正它原本也该翻修了。我们想购买一箱工程物资，以加快维修进度。
request_meteor_ul_desc.en: The Upper Levels Community pool was damaged during the meteor shower. It was due for renovation anyway. We are interested in buying a crate of engineering supplies to speed up the process.

request_medshortage_ll_title.zh: 下层区慈善诊所医疗物资
request_medshortage_ll_title.en: Medical Supply For Lower Levels Charity Clinic

request_medshortage_ll_desc.zh: 我们的医疗物资已经耗尽。物资短缺导致许多人无法得到妥善治疗，任何援助我们都感激不尽。
request_medshortage_ll_desc.en: We are out of medical supplies. Shortages have left many without proper treatment. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

request_medshortage_ul_title.zh: 上层区总医院医疗物资
request_medshortage_ul_title.en: Medical Supply For Upper Levels General Hospital

request_medshortage_ul_desc.zh: 我们急需的医疗物资未能按时送达。尽管目前仍有库存，但为了保证储备充足，我们愿意支付更高价格。
request_medshortage_ul_desc.en: We are experiencing delays in receiving critical medical supplies. While we still have stock, we are willing to pay a premium to ensure our reserves remain well-stocked.

request_medshortage_bm_desc.zh: 趁着物资持续短缺，我们要把市面上的货全都扫光，好让价格水涨船高！替我们弄到货，我们会给你丰厚报酬。
request_medshortage_bm_desc.en: With the ongoing shortage, we are buying up all the supply to drive up the price even higher! Get us the supply and we will pay you handsomely.

request_ll_construction_desc.zh: 下层区正在建设一栋新住宅楼，但建筑材料一直不好筹措。我们需要物资来保证工程继续推进。
request_ll_construction_desc.en: A new housing block is under construction in the Lower Levels, but securing materials has been a challenge. We need supplies to keep the project moving forward.

request_bm_construction_desc.zh: 建筑材料的需求正在上升，我们打算牢牢控制货源。赶在其他人之前把物资交给我们，报酬少不了你的。
request_bm_construction_desc.en: The demand for construction materials is rising, and we intend to make sure we control the supply. Get us the supplies before the others do and we'll pay well.

request_ll_soup_kitchen_title.en: Supplies for Lower Level Soup Kitchen

request_ll_soup_kitchen_desc.zh: 近期事件让许多人陷入困境。我们付不起多少钱，但一定会让大家都知道你的善举。
request_ll_soup_kitchen_desc.en: The recent events have left many in need. We can't pay much, but we will make sure to let everyone know of your kindness.

request_sec_evidence_desc.zh: 一箱重要证物失踪了。我们要你尽快把它送回来，其他事一概不过问。及时交货，自然少不了你的报酬。
request_sec_evidence_desc.en: A crate of important evidence has gone missing. We need it back ASAP, no questions asked. Deliver it quickly, and you'll be compensated accordingly.

request_sec_evidence_requester.en: Head of Security for Lower Levels

request_bm_evidence_desc.zh: 最近被盗的一箱证物中，装有对我客户不利的资料。我们愿意支付高价，在治安部或更糟糕的人掌握这些资料之前将它重新取回。
request_bm_evidence_desc.en: A recently stolen crate of evidence contains damaging information against my client. We are willing to pay a premium to secure it before it falls back into Security's hands or worse.

request_rev_oxymore_desc.zh: 朋友的生日派对临时缺了些茶点。
request_rev_oxymore_desc.en: Need some refreshment for our friend's birthday party. It's last-minute.

request_rev_scrap_desc.zh: 我们需要废金属来建一座新花园。旧花园已经年久失修了。
request_rev_scrap_desc.en: We need scrap metal to build a new garden. The old one's decrepit.

request_rev_seccard_desc.zh: 朋友马上要办一场聚会，我们需要一份乔迁之礼。
request_rev_seccard_desc.en: We need a housewarming gift for an upcoming friend's gathering.

request_rev_peat_desc.zh: 我们要在花园里办野餐，需要不易腐坏的食物。加工肉类最合适。
request_rev_peat_desc.en: We are stocking up our garden for a picnic and need non-perishables. Processed meat is ideal.

request_ul_rare_desc.zh: 我们的一位客户点名要这个。只要弄到手，我们会出高价。
request_ul_rare_desc.en: One of our clients has requested this. We will pay well for it.

request_ul_charity_desc.zh: 我们正在为慈善活动募集物品，帮助下层区有需要的人。无论捐赠什么，我们都感激不尽。
request_ul_charity_desc.en: We are collecting items for charity to help those in need in the Lower Levels. Any contribution would be greatly appreciated.

request_ul_charity_requester.zh: 上层区慈善活动组织者

request_lower_worker_desc.zh: 得找点东西熬过漫长的轮班。
request_lower_worker_desc.en: Need something to survive those long shifts.

request_georgio_tp_desc.zh: 乔治奥的收藏还缺一些卫生纸。
request_georgio_tp_desc.en: Georgio needs toilet paper for his collection.

request_butcher_cleaver_desc.zh: 需要一把新的切肉刀。旧的已经钝了。
request_butcher_cleaver_desc.en: Need a new cleaver. Old one is dull.

request_sawyer_beer_desc.zh: 我的人一直在拼命干活，该放松一下了。替我弄些红魔鬼啤酒来。
request_sawyer_beer_desc.en: My crew's been grinding hard. Time to kick back. Get me some Red Imp Beers.

request_lun_snackbar_desc.zh: 我最喜欢的能量棒到处都卖光了。替我弄几根来，我会出高价。
request_lun_snackbar_desc.en: My favorite snack bar is sold out everywhere. Get me a couple. I'll pay well.

request_sawyer_crowbar_desc.zh: 有人没经过我们的允许，就擅自做起了清洁工作。我们要杀一儆百。
request_sawyer_crowbar_desc.en: Someone has been doing their own cleaning without our permission. We will make an example out of them.

request_jackson_energy_desc.zh: 需要一些能量饮料提神。我得把实验做完！
request_jackson_energy_desc.en: Need some energy drinks to stay awake. Gotta finish my experiments!

request_landlord_special1_desc.zh: 我的一个房客一直催我修门。给我弄点废金属来，我再看看能怎么办。
request_landlord_special1_desc.en: One of my tenants keeps asking me to repair his door. Just get me some scrap metal and I'll see what I can do.

request_landlord_special2_desc.zh: 有个烦人的房客一直催我修通风系统。我看下周再多涨点租金好了。
request_landlord_special2_desc.en: An annoying tenant keeps asking me to repair their ventilation. I guess I'll just increase the rent more next week.

request_landlord_special3_desc.zh: 我有一套房子，临街的窗户破了，拿块布随便补补就行。
request_landlord_special3_desc.en: One of my unit's street windows got broken. I'll just patch it up with some cloth.

request_lun_retirement_desc.zh: 我们正在凑钱，想为布歇警官办一场像样的退休烧烤派对。
request_lun_retirement_desc.en: We are pitching in to get Officer Boucher a nice BBQ party for his retirement.

request_upper_petmeat_desc.zh: 弄些真正的生肉来，要新鲜、未经加工。我家宝贝只吃最好的。
request_upper_petmeat_desc.en: Acquire some real raw meat, fresh and unprocessed. Only the best for my pet.

request_mother_galaxy_desc.zh: 真不敢相信，下层区居然只有繁星果糊这种像样的食物能满足婴儿的营养需求。帮我弄一些来。
request_mother_galaxy_desc.en: I can't believe that Galaxy Blend is the only decent food nutritious enough for a baby around the Lower Levels. Help me get some.

appraisal_patience_1.en: You clearly don't know what you are doing.

appraisal_slip_body.zh: 已收取鉴定费：\n{0}信用点（{1}%）\n{2}信用点（基础费用）
appraisal_slip_body.en: Appraisal Fee Received:\n{0} Credits ({1}%)\n{2} Credits (Base Fee)

appraisal_accept_bit_lower.en: A bit lower than I expected.

appraisal_accept_bit_higher.en: A bit higher than I expected.

mech_chem_poison_no_harm.zh: 你卖给我的{0}根本没造成任何伤害！
mech_chem_poison_no_harm.en: The {0} you sold me didn't do any harm at all!

mech_chem_poison_not_finished.zh: 你卖给我的{0}没把活儿办成！
mech_chem_poison_not_finished.en: The {0} you sold me didn't finish the job!

mech_chem_poison_made_high.zh: 而且它还让他嗨了起来！

mech_chem_toxic_almost_killed.zh: 你卖给我的{0}差点害死我！
mech_chem_toxic_almost_killed.en: The {0} you sold me almost killed me!

mech_chem_lethal_killed_friend.zh: 你卖给我朋友的{0}害死了他！
mech_chem_lethal_killed_friend.en: The {0} you sold to my friend killed him!

mech_chem_pay_for_this.en: You are going to pay for this!

mech_chem_birthcontrol_didnt_work.en: The {0} you sold me didn't work!!

mech_chem_synaprest_didnt_work.en: The {0} you sold me didn't work!!

mech_chem_synaprest_made_high.zh: 而且它还让我嗨了起来！
mech_chem_synaprest_made_high.en: And also it made me high!

mech_chem_synaprest_saved_credit.zh: 我可是攒了很多信用点才买下它的！
mech_chem_synaprest_saved_credit.en: I saved up a lot of credit for that!

mech_chem_narcotic_no_effect.zh: 你卖给我的{0}根本毫无效果！
mech_chem_narcotic_no_effect.en: The {0} you sold me didn't do anything!

mech_chem_narcotic_any_drugs.zh: 你到底有没有往里面放真正的毒品？
mech_chem_narcotic_any_drugs.en: Did you even put any actual drugs in it?

mech_chem_narcotic_no_high.en: I didn't get high at all.

mech_chem_narcotic_weak.zh: 你卖给我的{0}效力也太弱了！
mech_chem_narcotic_weak.en: The {0} you sold me was so weak!

mech_chem_narcotic_barely_felt.zh: 我几乎什么都没感觉到。

mech_chem_medical_weak.en: The {0} you sold me didn't work very well!

mech_chem_side_effect_weird.zh: 而且还让我觉得怪怪的……
mech_chem_side_effect_weird.en: It also made me feel weird...

mech_chem_purity_slightly_off.zh: 你卖给我的{0}感觉有点不对劲，但我说不清到底哪里不对。
mech_chem_purity_slightly_off.en: The {0} you sold me felt a bit off. I can't quite put my finger on it.

mech_chem_purity_scam.zh: 你卖给我的{0}根本就是骗人的！
mech_chem_purity_scam.en: The {0} you sold me was a scam!

mech_chem_purity_way_off.zh: 纯度和你承诺的差得太远了！
mech_chem_purity_way_off.en: The purity was way off from what you promised!

mech_vacuum_upgrade_hint.zh: 可使用电子元件（普通）升级，以解锁内置焚化炉
mech_vacuum_upgrade_hint.en: Upgradable with a Common Electronic to unlock a built-in incinerator

mech_vacuum_incinerator_desc.zh: 清理后焚烧所有已储存的粪便
mech_vacuum_incinerator_desc.en: Burns all stored feces after cleanup

mech_bottle_printer_tooltip_print_small.zh: 可打印小号水瓶：消耗{0}点能量

mech_bottle_printer_tooltip_print_normal.zh: 可打印水瓶：消耗{0}点能量

mech_bottle_printer_tooltip_print_large.zh: 可打印大号水瓶：消耗{0}点能量

mech_go_outside_counter_warning.zh: 外出前最好先清空柜台，腾出足够的空间放置带回的所有物品。确定要外出吗？
mech_go_outside_counter_warning.en: You should keep your counter clear to make sure you have enough space to bring back all the items you might acquire. Are you sure you want to go out?

note_georgio_iou_body_2.zh: 乔治奥会连本带利还清。
note_georgio_iou_body_2.en: Georgio will pay back with interest.

aquaculture_water_need_clutch.zh: 整窝鱼卵需要水箱提供{0}毫升水
aquaculture_water_need_clutch.en: Needs {0} ml of tank water for the whole clutch

aquaculture_old_age.zh: 老年：每晚都有可能死亡

aquaculture_pellet_share_trash.zh: 饲料粒占比：{0}%，肉质为废品级
aquaculture_pellet_share_trash.en: 'Pellets: {0}% of diet, meat is trash grade'

mech_gutterflow_pellet_trash_rule.zh: 鱼吃下的食物中，饲料粒占比一旦超过{0}%，鱼肉就会降为废品级。
mech_gutterflow_pellet_trash_rule.en: Meat turns trash grade once pellets pass {0}% of a fish's diet

mech_gutterflow_pellet_controls.zh: 双击可拆分，拖到另一份饲料粒上可合并
mech_gutterflow_pellet_controls.en: Double-click to split, drop on another pellet to merge

mech_feed_dispenser_pellet.zh: 污泥饲料粒：{0}千卡（仅供鱼类食用）

aquaculture_power_output.zh: 每晚为所在循环水养殖系统及相邻的每块电池提供{0}千焦能量
aquaculture_power_output.en: Power {0} kJ a night to its RAS and each adjacent battery

aquaculture_power_from_adolescent.zh: 进入亚成年期（第{0}天）后开始发电

mech_ras_eel_power.zh: 电鳗每晚可为养殖缸电池及相邻的每块电池提供{0}千焦能量
mech_ras_eel_power.en: 'Eels generate {0} kJ a night: its battery and each adjacent battery'

aquaculture_eggs_paused_healing.zh: 鱼卵：{0}/{1}克，暂停产卵，生命值恢复至{2}%后继续
aquaculture_eggs_paused_healing.en: Eggs {0}/{1} g, paused until healed to {2}% health

mech_industrial_fish_feed_growth.zh: 使用这种饲料时，鱼的生长速度为正常速度的{0}%
mech_industrial_fish_feed_growth.en: Fish grow at {0}% speed on this feed

mech_industrial_fish_feed_controls.zh: 双击可拆分，拖到另一袋饲料上可合并
mech_industrial_fish_feed_controls.en: Double-click to split, drop on another bag of feed to merge

mech_feed_dispenser_industrial.zh: 工业鱼饲料：{0}千卡（仅供鱼类食用）

aquaculture_growth_speed.zh: 按近期的食物摄入情况，当前生长速度为正常速度的{0}%
aquaculture_growth_speed.en: Growing at {0}% speed on its recent diet

aquaculture_trait_pellet_proof.zh: 食用污泥饲料粒时不会受到减益
aquaculture_trait_pellet_proof.en: Does not suffer a penalty from eating Gutterflow Pellets

aquaculture_trait_meat_growth.zh: 食用肉类时，生长速度提高{0}%

mech_dna_effect_purifying.zh: 每晚去除各类污染物中的{0}%，纯度最高可达{1}%。矿物质会保留。
mech_dna_effect_purifying.en: Removes {0}% of each contaminant per night, up to {1}% purity. Leaves the mineral.

mech_dna_effect_polluting.zh: 每晚将{0}%的水转化为有机废物、微生物和碎屑。
mech_dna_effect_polluting.en: Turns {0}% of the water into organic waste, microbes and debris per night.

mech_dna_effect_production.zh: 每件收获物中增加{0}毫升的{1}。
mech_dna_effect_production.en: Adds {0} ml of {1} to each harvested item.

mech_dna_effect_production_contraband.zh: 每件收获物中增加{0}毫升的{1}，使其成为违禁品。
mech_dna_effect_production_contraband.en: Adds {0} ml of {1} to each harvested item, which makes it contraband.

mech_dna_block_locked_apply.zh: '{0}是作物本身的固有属性，无法应用'
mech_dna_block_locked_apply.en: '{0} is part of the crop and cannot be applied'

mech_dna_block_incompatible.zh: 无法给带有{1}的目标添加{0}
mech_dna_block_incompatible.en: '{0} cannot be added to a target carrying {1}'

mech_dna_block_max_rank.en: '{0} is already at its maximum rank'

mech_dna_block_nothing_to_act_on.zh: 此目标中没有可供{0}作用的对象
mech_dna_block_nothing_to_act_on.en: '{0} has nothing to act on in this target'

mech_dna_block_locked_extract.zh: '{0}是作物本身的固有属性，无法提取'
mech_dna_block_locked_extract.en: '{0} is part of the crop and cannot be extracted'

mech_dna_block_refill_missing.zh: 目标没有可提取到此数据盘上的{0}
mech_dna_block_refill_missing.en: The target has no {0} to extract onto this disk

mech_dna_block_precision_missing.en: The target has no {0} to extract

mech_dna_block_both_filters.zh: 两种筛选模组均已安装，无法提取任何特性
mech_dna_block_both_filters.en: 'Both filter modules are installed: nothing can be extracted'

mech_dna_block_no_positive_trait.zh: 目标没有可提取的正面特性
mech_dna_block_no_positive_trait.en: The target has no positive trait that can be extracted

mech_dna_block_no_negative_trait.zh: 目标没有可提取的负面特性
mech_dna_block_no_negative_trait.en: The target has no negative trait that can be extracted

mech_dna_block_no_trait.zh: 目标没有可提取的特性
mech_dna_block_no_trait.en: The target has no trait that can be extracted

mech_dna_eject_hint.zh: 切换机器开关即可更改此设置。
mech_dna_eject_hint.en: Toggle the machine to change this setting.

mech_dna_next_apply.zh: 下一步：应用{0}（成功后消耗数据盘1次使用次数）
mech_dna_next_apply.en: 'Next operation: apply {0} (uses one charge of the disk on success)'

mech_dna_next_apply_stack.zh: 下一步：应用{0}，使其提升1级（成功后消耗数据盘1次使用次数）
mech_dna_next_apply_stack.en: 'Next operation: apply {0}, stacking a rank (uses one charge of the disk on success)'

mech_dna_next_extract_refill.zh: 下一步：再次将{0}提取到数据盘中
mech_dna_next_extract_refill.en: 'Next operation: extract {0} again onto the disk'

mech_dna_target_kept.en: The target will not be destroyed

plant_trait_edible_desc.zh: 这种植物产出的所有东西都可以食用。
plant_trait_edible_desc.en: Everything this plant produces can be eaten.

plant_trait_perennial_desc.zh: 收获后仍会存活，并再次结果。
plant_trait_perennial_desc.en: Survives its harvest and fruits again.

mech_feed_dispenser_empty_confirm.zh: 要丢弃全部已储存的饲料吗？这将损失{0}千卡热量。
mech_feed_dispenser_empty_confirm.en: Throw out all the stored feed? {0} kcal will be lost.

mech_pinned_tooltip.zh: 已固定：整理或卸载物品时保持原位
mech_pinned_tooltip.en: 'Pinned: stays put when sorting or unloading'

mech_scav_luck_saved.zh: 运气不错，你躲过了一次受伤！
mech_scav_luck_saved.en: Your luck saved you from an injury!

mech_inspection_luck_saved.zh: 运气救了你！治安员没发现你的非法物品。
mech_inspection_luck_saved.en: Your luck saved you! The officer overlooked your illegal goods.

mech_scav_bad_luck_empty.zh: 真倒霉，你翻遍了这堆东西，却什么也没找到。
mech_scav_bad_luck_empty.en: Your bad luck strikes. You dig through the pile and find nothing.

mech_scratcher_luck_good.zh: 运气帮了忙，这个图案变得对你有利了！
mech_scratcher_luck_good.en: Your luck changed this symbol in your favor!

mech_scratcher_luck_bad.zh: 倒霉了，这个图案变得对你不利了。
mech_scratcher_luck_bad.en: Your bad luck changed this symbol against you.

mech_lottery_luck_good.zh: 这次彩票开奖，运气站在了你这边。
mech_lottery_luck_good.en: Your luck was on your side during the lottery draw.

mech_lottery_luck_bad.zh: 这次彩票开奖，坏运气拖了你的后腿。
mech_lottery_luck_bad.en: Your bad luck weighed on the lottery draw.

mech_drag_module_bay_locked.zh: 无法将{0}放入{1}：机器运行时，模组槽位已锁定。
mech_drag_module_bay_locked.en: 'Can''t insert {0} into {1}: modules are locked while the machine is working.'

mech_nightlog_burglary_grace.zh: 新开张的店铺暂时不会遭贼，保护期还剩{0}晚。
mech_nightlog_burglary_grace.en: 'Burglars leave a new shop alone for now: {0} night(s) of grace left.'

mech_nightlog_vending_mislabel.zh: 买家发现，从你的自动贩卖机买到的商品中有{0}件标签与实物不符。他们已通知治安部。
mech_nightlog_vending_mislabel.en: Buyers found {0} mislabelled item(s) they paid for from one of your vending machines. Security has been informed.

mech_moisture_farm_tooltip_running.zh: 运行中的水分收集器：{0}台（每台产量为{1}%）

mech_afterhour_event_fresh_dump_desc.zh: 上层区保洁部门刚倒下来一批垃圾
mech_afterhour_event_fresh_dump_desc.en: A fresh load just got dumped from the Upper Levels janitorial

mech_afterhour_event_georgio_desc.zh: 乔治奥会来垃圾倾倒场帮你。
mech_afterhour_event_georgio_desc.en: Georgio will come and help you at the dumping ground.

mech_afterhour_event_burglary_desc.zh: 昨晚有人闯进店里，把货架上的货一扫而空。
mech_afterhour_event_burglary_desc.en: Someone broke in last night and cleared the shelves.

mech_afterhour_effect_restock_percent.zh: 补充相当于库存上限{0}%的货物

mech_nightlog_dividend.zh: 你从{0}获得的股东分红已放在柜台上。
mech_nightlog_dividend.en: Your shares in {0} paid a dividend. It is on the counter.

mech_afterhour_event_jackson_closed_desc.zh: 杰克逊博士似乎周一不营业。
mech_afterhour_event_jackson_closed_desc.en: Dr. Jackson seems to be closed on Mondays.

mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_power.zh: 每次{0}升级都会使每晚的能耗增加{1}。
mech_vending_tooltip_upgrade_power.en: Each {0} upgrade raises the nightly energy use by {1}.

mech_fountain_tooltip_upgrade_power.zh: 每进行{1}次{0}升级，每晚的能耗就会增加{2}。
mech_fountain_tooltip_upgrade_power.en: Every {1} {0} upgrades raise the nightly energy use by {2}.

mech_nightlog_agoraphobia_ready.zh: 你已经休息够了，今晚可以再次外出了。
mech_nightlog_agoraphobia_ready.en: You have rested enough. You feel ready to go out again tonight.

mech_nightlog_debris_rest_progress.zh: 你没有外出，而是花时间清理了杂物堆（{0}/{1}）。
mech_nightlog_debris_rest_progress.en: You picked through the pile of debris instead of going out ({0}/{1}).

mech_nightlog_debris_crew_progress.zh: 清运人员搬走了杂物堆的一部分（{0}/{1}）。
mech_nightlog_debris_crew_progress.en: The debris removal crew hauled away part of the pile of debris ({0}/{1}).

mech_nightlog_debris_cleared.zh: 这堆杂物终于彻底清干净了。
mech_nightlog_debris_cleared.en: The pile of debris is gone for good.

mech_reactor_tooltip_charge.zh: 每晚为相邻电池和机器补充{0}能量。
mech_reactor_tooltip_charge.en: Charges adjacent batteries and machines by {0} each night.

mech_nightlog_reactor_no_power.zh: 反应堆损坏严重，已无法为店铺供电。
mech_nightlog_reactor_no_power.en: Your reactor is too damaged to power the Store.

mech_nightlog_reactor_critical.zh: 如果不维修，反应堆将在下一晚爆炸！
mech_nightlog_reactor_critical.en: Your reactor will explode during the next night unless you repair it!

mech_end_reactor_desc.zh: 简易反应堆一直严重缺乏维护，终于撑不住了——这种疏忽程度简直够得上犯罪。爆炸摧毁了店铺和周围整个街区。治安部已开始调查杰克逊博士是否涉案。
mech_end_reactor_desc.en: The makeshift reactor finally gave out due to a criminal level of neglect. The blast took the Store and the block around it. Security is opening an investigation into Dr. Jackson's involvement.

mech_appraisal_cert_chance.zh: 鉴定顾客来访概率：每天{0}%

mech_appraisal_cert_progress_ready.zh: 已满足晋升条件，委员会将派人来访。
mech_appraisal_cert_progress_ready.en: 'Promotion ready: the Board will visit you.'

mech_appraisal_cert_activate.zh: 激活后可选择顾客带来的物品种类。
mech_appraisal_cert_activate.en: Activate to choose which items customers bring.

health_addiction_suppressed_none.zh: 那里面大多是填充料，你的戒断症状丝毫没有缓解。
health_addiction_suppressed_none.en: That was mostly filler. Your withdrawal hasn't eased at all.

health_addiction_suppressed_weak.zh: 戒断症状缓解了些，但这次的药效太弱，撑不了多久。
health_addiction_suppressed_weak.en: The withdrawal eased, but that dose was weak. It won't hold for long.

health_addiction_suppressed_strong.zh: 这次的药效够强，戒断症状暂时不会再出现了。
health_addiction_suppressed_strong.en: That was strong stuff. The withdrawal won't be back for a while.

mech_nightlog_request_mislabel.zh: 顾客发现你为市场委托交付的货里有{0}件标签不实。
mech_nightlog_request_mislabel.en: Customers found {0} mislabelled item(s) in what you delivered for their marketplace requests.

note_li_formula_s1_body.zh: '- 将几株梦帽菇搅拌成梦帽菇糊'
note_li_formula_s1_body.en: '- Blend a few Dream Caps to get Dream Cap Mush'

note_li_formula_s2_body.zh: - 加入相当于梦帽菇糊体积5倍的酒精\n- 将混合物加热至40-50°C，制成梦帽菇萃取液
note_li_formula_s2_body.en: - Add Alcohol equal to 5 times the volume of Dream Cap Mush\r\n- Heat the mixture to 40-50C to get Dream Cap Extract

note_li_formula_s3_body.zh: - 用韧棉织物过滤，然后放入蒸发器\n- （必需）确保所有水和酒精均已蒸发
note_li_formula_s3_body.en: - Filter with a Kotton Fabric, then use the Evaporator\r\n- (REQUIRED) All water and alcohol are evaporated

note_li_formula_s4_body.zh: - 加入与梦帽菇萃取液等量的还原剂\n- 再加入其四分之一量的脂合剂\n- 将混合物加热至45-55°C，制成奥克莫吸
note_li_formula_s4_body.en: - Add Reducing Agent equal to the Dream Cap Extract\r\n- Add Lipobond Agent equal to a quarter of it\r\n- Heat the mixture to 45-55C to get Nomore

note_li_formula_s4_note.zh: 警告：梦帽菇萃取液超过60°C会变质
note_li_formula_s4_note.en: 'WARNING: DREAM CAP EXTRACT WILL DEGRADE ABOVE 60C'

note_li_formula_s5_body.zh: - 再次过滤，并蒸发掉脂合剂\n- 在化学制剂成型机中选择“奥克莫吸注射器”
note_li_formula_s5_body.en: - Filter again and evaporate the Lipobond Agent\r\n- Select Nomore Injector in the Chem Finisher

mech_nightlog_vandalism_butcher.zh: 你的店铺遭到了恶意破坏。有人在店门口写了一个大大的“肉”字……用的是血！？
mech_nightlog_vandalism_butcher.en: Your store has been vandalized. Someone wrote "MEAT" across the front... in blood!?

note_butcher_cleaver_body_1.en: You'd better get yourself a gun.

note_butcher_cleaver_body_2.zh: 我很有耐心。只要你踏出店门一步，我就在外面等着。
note_butcher_cleaver_body_2.en: I'm patient. I'll be waiting the moment you step outside your store.

note_butcher_cleaver_body_3.en: Sooner or later, you'll have to come out.

response_afterhours_need_gun.zh: 你得带上一把枪，不然{0}会杀了你。
response_afterhours_need_gun.en: You need to bring a gun with you, otherwise {0} will kill you.

mech_afterhour_butcher_watching.zh: 你感到有什么东西在暗中盯着你，让人心里发毛。还好你带了枪。
mech_afterhour_butcher_watching.en: You feel an uneasy presence watching you. Good thing you brought a gun.

mech_nightlog_butcher_hunted.zh: 昨晚，索耶的伙计们去“拜访”了{0}。他再也没法卖谁的鲜肉了。
mech_nightlog_butcher_hunted.en: Sawyer's crew paid {0} a visit last night. He will not be selling anyone's fresh meat again.

mech_end_lou_bombed_desc.zh: 卢说过别碰她的玩具。她又在你的柜台上留下了一份小礼物，而这一次是真的。爆炸摧毁了店铺，你也没能幸免。
mech_end_lou_bombed_desc.en: Lou told you not to touch her toys. She left another little present on your counter, and this one was real. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you.

mech_liquid_luck_wears_off.zh: 液体好运的效果过去了。

mech_notify_serpico_food_enough.zh: 给塞尔皮科的食物应该够了。
mech_notify_serpico_food_enough.en: That should be enough food for Serpico.

mech_nightlog_serpico_food.zh: 你在垃圾场给塞尔皮科留了{0}千卡的食物（{1}/{2}千卡）。
mech_nightlog_serpico_food.en: You left {0} kcal of food for Serpico at the Dumping Ground ({1} / {2} kcal).

note_serpico_letter_body_1.zh: 我是塞尔皮科。我逃跑的时候中了枪，现在躲在垃圾场。一个好心的拾荒客帮我包扎了伤口，还答应替我把这封信带给你。
note_serpico_letter_body_1.en: This is Serpico. I got shot while trying to escape. I'm at the Dumping Ground now. A kind scavenger patched me up and agreed to drop this letter off to you.

note_serpico_letter_body_2.zh: 走之前我顺手带走了一些罪证。我需要点时间把东西整理好，可没吃的我撑不下去。
note_serpico_letter_body_2.en: I grabbed some incriminating evidence before I left. I need some time to organize everything, but I'm not gonna make it without food.

note_serpico_letter_body_3.zh: 我想求你帮个大忙。你能在垃圾场放{0}千卡的食物吗？直接放在地上就行，等没人的时候我再去拿。
note_serpico_letter_body_3.en: I have a big favor to ask you. Can you drop off {0} kcal worth of food at the Dumping Ground? Just leave it on the ground. I'll pick it up when no one's around.

note_serpico_letter_body_4.en: I don't think I'll last more than {0} days.

event_serpico_dead_news.zh: 治安部警员陈尸垃圾场
event_serpico_dead_news.en: Security Officer Found Dead in the Dumping Ground

event_serpico_dead_desc.zh: 因涉嫌腐败而接受调查的实习警员塞尔皮科被发现死于垃圾场。治安部目前未透露更多细节。
event_serpico_dead_desc.en: Cadet Serpico, who was under investigation on corruption charges, was found dead in the Dumping Ground. The Security Department has given no further details at this time.

event_serpico_rev_desc.zh: 揭露空间站治安部内部腐败的文件已在全站公开。数名基层警员现已被提起刑事诉讼，但没有任何高层官员为此承担后果。
event_serpico_rev_desc.en: Documents exposing corruption inside Station Security have been published across the station. Several low-ranking officers now face criminal charges. No high-ranking officer has faced any consequence.

event_serpico_sec_news.zh: 腐败指控波及治安部高层

event_serpico_sec_desc.zh: 提交给一名高级长官的证据，已让治安部各级警员被提起刑事诉讼。一支新的反腐专案组也已成立。
event_serpico_sec_desc.en: Evidence handed to a senior officer has led to criminal charges against Security officers of every rank. A new anti-corruption task force has been formed.

mech_end_lou_debt_desc.zh: 你没能还清欠卢的债，于是她用自己的方式算了这笔账：在你的柜台上留了一份小礼物，而这一次是真的。爆炸摧毁了店铺，你也没能幸免。
mech_end_lou_debt_desc.en: 'You couldn''t pay what you owed Lou, so she settled the score her own way: a little present on your counter, and this one was real. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you.'

event_lou_admiral_news.zh: 来访的高级海军上将遇刺身亡！

event_lou_admiral_desc.zh: 昨晚，一名来访的共和国海军上将及其护卫在船坞附近遭枪杀。据目击者称，枪手是一名身穿偷来的治安部制服的金发女子，她径直走到上将一行人面前才开枪。现场警员击中了她数枪，但她还是逃走了，至今下落不明。
event_lou_admiral_desc.en: A visiting Republic admiral and his escort were gunned down near the docking bays last night. Witnesses say the shooter, a blonde woman in a stolen Security uniform, walked right up to the admiral's party before opening fire. Officers on the scene hit her several times, but she escaped, and no trace of her has been found.

mech_nightlog_vandalized_john_smith.zh: 你的店铺昨晚遭到了恶意破坏。店门口被人用喷漆写了两个大字：“张伟”。
mech_nightlog_vandalized_john_smith.en: Your store was vandalized overnight. "JOHN SMITH" is spray-painted across the front in huge letters.

mech_pin_mode_hint.zh: 固定模式：点击物品即可固定或取消固定。
mech_pin_mode_hint.en: 'Pin mode: click an item to pin or unpin it.'

mech_pin_cant_pin.zh: 无法固定{0}：只能固定库存中属于你的物品。
mech_pin_cant_pin.en: 'Can''t pin {0}: only your own items in an inventory can be pinned.'

mech_notify_eleanor_drive_bounty.zh: 黑市为埃莉诺的数据盘付了你{0}信用点。
mech_notify_eleanor_drive_bounty.en: The Black Market paid you {0} Credits for Eleanor's drive.

event_eleanor_leak_news.zh: 帕斯泰尔营养果的秘密遭到泄露！

event_eleanor_leak_desc.zh: 一篇研究论文已经发表，揭示了如何让普通营养果重新结籽。全空间站的生物黑客已经开始种植这一新品种，种子价格随之暴跌。同一天早上，因挪用公款入狱的空间站最大水培农场前负责人被发现死在牢房中。帕斯泰尔公司拒绝置评。
event_eleanor_leak_desc.en: A research paper has been published showing how to make standard Nutrifruit grow seeds again. Biohackers across the station are already growing the new strain, and seed prices have collapsed. The same morning, the former director of the station's largest hydroponics farm, jailed for embezzlement, was found dead in her cell. pastel has declined to comment.

mech_storage_coordinator_no_presets.zh: 还没有预设。激活它来设置吧。
mech_storage_coordinator_no_presets.en: No presets yet. Activate it to set some up.

mech_hypertech_cell_upgrade.zh: 升级：电子元件（超科技），每个+{0} kJ输出（已使用{1}个）
mech_hypertech_cell_upgrade.en: 'Upgrade: Electronic Parts (Hypertech), +{0} kJ output each ({1} applied)'

mech_hypertech_cell_draw_ok.zh: 机器耗电在输出范围内

mech_hypertech_cell_draw_over.zh: 机器耗电超出输出：无法供电

mech_turbo_hypertech_speed.zh: 充能速度：每周期{0}（等级{1}），从能量电池汲取{0} kJ
mech_turbo_hypertech_speed.en: 'Charge speed: {0} per cycle (level {1}), drawing {0} kJ from its Energy Cell'

mech_turbo_hypertech_upgrade_hint.zh: 对它使用一个高级涡轮增压器，可永久提高充能速度和耗电量。
mech_turbo_hypertech_upgrade_hint.en: Use an Advanced Turbo Booster on it to permanently increase its charge speed and power draw.

mech_mind_reprogrammer_charge_hint.zh: 对它使用电子元件（超科技）可增加1次充能。
mech_mind_reprogrammer_charge_hint.en: Use Electronic Parts (Hypertech) on it to add 1 charge.

mech_auto_butcher_info_count_protected.zh: 将每只已标记或已命名的动物计入保留的雌性和雄性数量。
mech_auto_butcher_info_count_protected.en: Count every marked or named animal toward the females and males kept.

mech_auto_butcher_tooltip_last_run_roe.zh: 上次运行：屠宰{0}只，收集鱼卵{1}份

mech_auto_butcher_notify_tray_full.zh: 自动屠宰机的托盘已满。
mech_auto_butcher_notify_tray_full.en: The Auto Butcher's tray is full.

mech_hopper_moves_only_listed.zh: 只搬运列表中的物品种类（{0}）
mech_hopper_moves_only_listed.en: Moves only the listed item kinds ({0})

mech_hopper_moves_except_listed.zh: 搬运除列表中物品种类外的全部物品（{0}）
mech_hopper_moves_except_listed.en: Moves everything except the listed item kinds ({0})

mech_hopper_toggle_on_add.en: Also run whenever an item is added

mech_hopper_toggle_on_move.zh: 此料斗被移动时也运行
mech_hopper_toggle_on_move.en: Also run when this hopper is moved

mech_hopper_filter_block.zh: 黑名单以外的全部物品

mech_hopper_pick_hint.zh: 点击物品将其加入列表。
mech_hopper_pick_hint.en: Click an item to add it to the list.

mech_hopper_list_empty_allow.zh: 允许列表为空：添加物品前不会搬运任何东西。
mech_hopper_list_empty_allow.en: 'The allow list is empty: nothing moves until you add items.'

mech_hopper_list_empty_block.zh: 黑名单为空：全部物品都会搬运。

mech_hopper_chip_remove.en: Click to remove {0} from the list

mech_hopper_pick_cannot.en: '{0} cannot be added to the list.'

mech_hopper_pick_add.en: Click to add {0} to the list.

mech_appraisal_cert_chance_ramp.zh: 每天没有鉴定顾客上门，几率都会提高，基础为{0}%
mech_appraisal_cert_chance_ramp.en: Rises every day without one, from {0}%
