network_BREWER_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你引荐给红魔鬼酿酒厂的销售代表，让你能立刻且持续地获得他们的啤酒供应。你将获得一张用于联系该供货商的名片。
network_BREWER_desc.en: Wild will introduce you to the sales representative of the Red Imp Brewery, allowing you immediate and consistent access to their beer supply. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.

network_CHEMIST_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你引荐给一位下层区化学家，他生产用于娱乐和医疗的廉价违禁药物。你将获得一张用于联系该供货商的名片。
network_CHEMIST_desc.en: Wild will introduce you to a Lower Levels Chemist who produces cheap but illegal drugs for both recreational and medical uses. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.

network_PHARMA_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你引荐给一位匿名上层区药商的库存管理员，让你能及时且稳定地获取合法但难以采购的药物。你将获得一张用于联系该供货商的名片。
network_PHARMA_desc.en: Wild will introduce you to the Inventory Manager for an unnamed Upper Levels Pharmacist, allowing you immediate and consistent access to legal, but hard to source, medications. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.

network_MINER_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你引荐给GP采矿合作社的负责人，允许你订购大量矿石。你将获得一张用于联系该供货商的名片。
network_MINER_desc.en: Wild will introduce you to the leader of GP Mining Coop, who will allow you to order large amounts of mineral ores. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.

network_LANDLORD_GRACE_desc.zh: 王尔德会出面摆平房东，如果你错过了一次租金支付，可以接受你将欠款与下周的租金一并缴纳。这个恩惠是一次性的。
network_LANDLORD_GRACE_desc.en: Wild will convince the Landlord that if you missed a rent payment, it's acceptable to pay the missing rent together with the next week's rent. This is a one time favor.

network_LANDLORD_GRACE_already_bought.zh: 你已经获得过房东的宽限了。
network_LANDLORD_GRACE_already_bought.en: You are already in the Landlord's good graces.

network_SEC_GRACE_desc.zh: 王尔德将利用他的政治影响力，确保当治安部检查员查获了通常会导致监禁的违禁品时，你只会受到警告处理。这个恩惠是一次性的。
network_SEC_GRACE_desc.en: Wild will use his political influence to ensure that if a Security Inspector finds contraband that would normally result in imprisonment, you will instead be let off with a warning. This is a one time favor.

network_SEC_GRACE_already_bought.zh: 王尔德已经为你提供过此恩惠。
network_SEC_GRACE_already_bought.en: Wild has already performed this favor for you.

network_INSPECTION_INFORMANT_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你引荐给他在治安部内部的线人。只要你每晚支付一笔费用，线人就会提前通知你任何常规的盘查。但线人无法对突击检查提供帮助。
network_INSPECTION_INFORMANT_desc.en: Wild will introduce you to his informant within the Security Department. As long as you pay a nightly fee, the informant will notify you of any regular Security inspection. The informant won't be able to help with any surprise inspections.

network_WILD_FIXER_desc.zh: 王尔德将允许你雇佣他的善后人。只要你每晚支付一笔费用，善后人就会让目击者闭嘴，并清理尚未被治安部收集的证据，以更快的速度降低你的犯罪嫌疑度。
network_WILD_FIXER_desc.en: Wild will allow you to hire his fixers. As long as you pay a nightly fee, the fixers will silence witnesses and clean up evidence not yet collected by Security, lowering your suspected crime level at an increased rate.

network_EVIDENCE_REMOVAL_desc.zh: 王尔德将命令他在治安部的联络人销毁所有已收集到的证据，并暗中破坏任何针对你的正在进行的调查。此恩惠有{0}天的冷却时间。
network_EVIDENCE_REMOVAL_desc.en: Wild will order his security contacts to destroy all collected evidence and tamper with any ongoing investigation against you. This favor has a cooldown of {0} days.

network_BUY_REFERAL_desc.zh: 只要支付每晚的费用，王尔德便会动用其人脉将买家推荐到你的店铺。此外，展示柜中的物品会吸引更多顾客。
network_BUY_REFERAL_desc.en: Wild will agree to refer buyers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid. Additionally, more customers will be attracted to items in the display case.

network_SELL_REFERAL_desc.zh: 只要支付每晚的费用，王尔德便会动用其人脉将卖家推荐到你的店铺。
network_SELL_REFERAL_desc.en: Wild will agree to refer sellers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid.

network_CRIMINEL_NETWORK_desc.zh: 只要支付每晚的费用，王尔德便会动用其人脉将财力雄厚的违禁品买家推荐到你的店铺。使用此服务还能为你提供少量黑市声望（冷却时间：{0}天）
network_CRIMINEL_NETWORK_desc.en: Wild will agree to refer high-budget contraband buyers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid. Using this service also grants you a small amount of Black Market reputation ({0} days cooldown)

network_POWER_HIJACK_desc.zh: 你的电力将由外面某块太阳能板供应，反正原主人（多半）也不差这点电。每晚的电力服务现在免费。
network_POWER_HIJACK_desc.en: Your power will be supplied by a external solar panel owned by someone who (probably) doesn't need it. The nightly Power Service is now free.

network_COMMERCIAL_POWER_desc.zh: 你的供电单元将得到升级以容纳更多电力。充能器和能量阵列的充电速度将提升{0}%。
network_COMMERCIAL_POWER_desc.en: Your power supply unit will be upgraded to accommodate more power. The Recharger and PowerBloc will charge {0}% quicker.

network_SHOWCASE_I_desc.zh: 你的展示柜将得到扩建以展示更多物品。每天将有额外{0}名顾客来购买展示柜中的物品。
network_SHOWCASE_I_desc.en: Your showcase will be expanded to allow more items to be displayed. {0} more customers will be visiting to buy items from the Display Case per day.

network_SHOWCASE_II_desc.zh: 你的展示柜将得到进一步扩建。每天将有额外{0}名顾客来购买展示柜中的物品。
network_SHOWCASE_II_desc.en: Your showcase will be expanded even more. {0} additional customers will be visiting to buy item from the Display Case per day.

network_GUTTERFLOW_TAP_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你的水管连接到下水道，让你能无限制地获取沟渠水。水质纯度每天都会发生变化。
network_GUTTERFLOW_TAP_desc.en: Wild will connect your water line to a sewer, allowing you access to unlimited Gutterflow. The purity of the water changes every day.

network_RUSTWATER_TAP_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你的水管连接到工业排放管，让你能无限制地获取铁锈水。水质纯度每天都会发生变化。
network_RUSTWATER_TAP_desc.en: Wild will connect your water line to an industrial discharge pipe, allowing you access to unlimited Rustwater. The purity of the water changes every day.

network_RUINED_MACHINE_UNLOCK_desc.zh: 一位会教你如何将废弃机器拆解成零件的废料客将在第二天到访。（解锁废弃机器内容）
network_RUINED_MACHINE_UNLOCK_desc.en: A Junker who will introduce you to scrapping ruined machines for parts will visit you the next day. (Unlocks Ruined Machine Content)

network_RETIRED_FARMER_desc.zh: 立即获取一套入门级水培设备。一名退休农夫将在第二天到访，随后每周到访一次，出售种子和水培设备。（解锁进阶农业内容。）
network_RETIRED_FARMER_desc.en: Immediately receive a Hydroponic Starter Kit. A retired farmer will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling seeds and hydroponic equipment. (Unlocks Advanced Farming Content.)

network_RETIRED_GUNSMITH_desc.zh: 立即获取一套入门级武器改装设备。一名退休枪匠将在第二天到访，随后每周到访一次，出售枪械模组和弹药。（解锁进阶枪械改装内容。）
network_RETIRED_GUNSMITH_desc.en: Immediately receive a Gunsmith Starter Kit. A retired gunsmith will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling gun mods and ammo. (Unlocks Advanced Gunsmith Content.)

network_GUN_PERMIT_I_desc.zh: 王尔德将替你疏通关系，为你争取一张通常仅限下层区商人持有的枪械许可证，允许你合法交易低级违禁枪械和弹药。只有当治安部声望至少达到{0}时，许可证才会下发。
network_GUN_PERMIT_I_desc.en: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a firearms permit usually reserved for Lower Level Merchants, allowing you to legally trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit will only be delivered after reaching at least {0} Security Reputation.

network_GUN_PERMIT_II_desc.zh: 王尔德将替你疏通关系，为你争取一张通常仅限上层区商人持有的枪械许可证，允许你合法交易中级违禁枪械和弹药。只有当治安部声望至少达到{0}时，许可证才会下发。
network_GUN_PERMIT_II_desc.en: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a firearms permit usually reserved for Upper Level Merchants, allowing you to legally trade mid level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit will only be delivered after reaching at least {0} Security Reputation.

network_GUN_PERMIT_III_desc.zh: 王尔德会替你疏通关系，为你争取一张通常仅限空间站治安部军需官持有的武器许可证，允许你合法交易高级违禁枪械和弹药。只有当治安部声望至少达到{0}时，许可证才会下发。
network_GUN_PERMIT_III_desc.en: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a weapon permit usually reserved for Station Security Quartermasters, allowing you to legally trade high level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit will only be delivered after reaching at least {0} Security Reputation.

network_RETIRED_CHEMIST_desc.zh: 立即获取一套入门级化学家设备。一名退休化学家将在第二天到访，随后每周到访一次，出售化学用品和设备。（解锁进阶化学内容。）
network_RETIRED_CHEMIST_desc.en: Immediately receive a Chemist Starter Kit. A retired chemist will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling chemical supplies and equipment. (Unlocks Advanced Chemistry Content.)

network_WATER_TRADER_desc.zh: 立即获取一套入门级水资源交易设备。一名水贩将开始定期造访你的店铺。（解锁水资源交易内容。）
network_WATER_TRADER_desc.en: Immediately receive a Water Trading Starter Kit. A Water Trader will start visiting the Store. (Unlocks Water Trading Content.)

network_MARKETPLACE_REQUESTS_desc.zh: 王尔德会将你接入市场委托网络，允许你浏览并完成买家的各类需求。委托物品的报酬通常高于常规市场价值。
network_MARKETPLACE_REQUESTS_desc.en: Wild will connect you with the Marketplace Request network, allowing you to browse and fulfill various requests from buyers. Rewards for requested items are usually higher than regular market value.

network_JACKSON1_desc.zh: 王尔德会说服杰克逊博士接受你的一小笔投资，从而永久增加他的预算以及你拜访他时的可用库存。杰克逊博士将始终有模组在售。
network_JACKSON1_desc.en: Wild will convince Dr. Jackson to accept a small investment from you, permanently increasing his budget, and the available stock when visiting him. Dr. Jackson will always have Modules in stock.

network_JACKSON2_desc.zh: 王尔德会说服杰克逊博士接受你的另一笔投资，从而永久增加他的预算以及你拜访他时的可用库存。杰克逊博士将始终有额外的模组在售。
network_JACKSON2_desc.en: Wild will convince Dr. Jackson to accept another investment from you, permanently increasing his budget, and the available stock when visiting him. Dr. Jackson will always have additional Modules in stock.

network_RENOVATION1_desc.zh: 王尔德将雇佣承包商对店铺进行适度翻新，使其基础吸引力提升{0}点。
network_RENOVATION1_desc.en: Wild will hire contractors to make modest renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by {0} points.

network_RENOVATION2_desc.zh: 王尔德将雇佣承包商对店铺进行大幅翻新，使其基础吸引力再提升{0}点。
network_RENOVATION2_desc.en: Wild will hire contractors to make substantial renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by another {0} points.

network_RENOVATION3_desc.zh: 王尔德将雇佣承包商对店铺进行脱胎换骨的翻新，使其基础吸引力再提升{0}点。
network_RENOVATION3_desc.en: Wild will hire contractors to make transformative renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by another {0} points.

network_RETIRED_RANCHER_desc.zh: 王尔德会为你引荐一位养鼠人，他会每周到访一次。立即获得一套入门级养鼠设备。（解锁养殖内容）
network_RETIRED_RANCHER_desc.en: Wild will refer you to a Rat Rancher who will visit you once a week. Immediately receive a Rat Ranching Starter Kit. (Unlock Rancher Content)

network_WINEMAKER_desc.zh: 立即获取一套入门级酿酒设备。一名退休酿酒师将在第二天到访，随后每周到访一次，出售酿酒用品和设备。（解锁酿酒玩法。）
network_WINEMAKER_desc.en: Immediately receive a Winemaking Starter Kit. A retired winemaker will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling winemaking supplies and equipment. (Unlocks Winemaking Content.)

network_AQUACULTURE_desc.zh: 王尔德会为你引荐一位退休水产养殖户，对方会每周到访一次，出售养鱼设备和受精鱼卵。立即获得一套入门级水产养殖设备。（解锁水产养殖内容。）
network_AQUACULTURE_desc.en: Wild will refer you to a retired aquafarmer who will visit you once a week, selling fish farming equipment and fertilized roe. Immediately receive an Aquaculture Starter Kit. (Unlocks Aquaculture Content.)

network_AQUACULTURE_II_desc.zh: 退休水产养殖户每次来访时，还会带来体型更大、收益更高的鱼种供你养殖。立即获得两条幼年鳗鱼。
network_AQUACULTURE_II_desc.en: The retired aquafarmer will also bring bigger, more profitable fish to raise on each visit. Immediately receive two young eels.

network_PLANT_DNA_desc.zh: 立即获得一台DNA编辑器、一台基因扫描仪和一些空白DNA数据盘。此后，杰克逊博士会常备DNA编辑设备供你购买。
network_PLANT_DNA_desc.en: Immediately receive a DNA manipulator, a gene scanner and blank DNA data disks. Dr. Jackson will now keep DNA manipulation equipment in stock.

network_DOSSIER_UPGRADE_desc.en: Expand the size of the dossier.

network_TRASHCAN_UPGRADE_desc.en: Expand the size of the trash can.

network_VENDING_MACHINE_desc.zh: 立即在店内安装一台自动贩卖机，让你能在夜间售卖商品。
network_VENDING_MACHINE_desc.en: A vending machine will be immediately installed in the store. Allowing goods to be sold during the night.

network_VENDING_FOUNTAIN_desc.zh: 立即在店内安装一台自动售水机，让你能在夜间售水。
network_VENDING_FOUNTAIN_desc.en: A vending fountain will be immediately installed in the store. Allowing water to be sold during the night.

network_BREWER_SHAREHOLDER_desc.zh: 买下红魔鬼酿酒厂的一小部分股份。快递员给你的批发优惠会增加{0}%，每周四早上，你还会在柜台上收到{1}箱啤酒作为分红。
network_BREWER_SHAREHOLDER_desc.en: Buy a minor share of the Red Imp Brewery. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Thursday morning a dividend of {1} case of beer is waiting on the counter.

network_MINER_SHAREHOLDER_desc.zh: 买下GP采矿合作社的一小部分股份。快递员给你的批发折扣会增加{0}%，每周五早上，你还会在柜台上收到{1}份矿石作为分红。
network_MINER_SHAREHOLDER_desc.en: Buy a minor share of the GP Mining Coop. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Friday morning a dividend of {1} ore is waiting on the counter.

network_CHEMIST_SHAREHOLDER_desc.zh: 入股下层区化学家的生意，成为小股东。快递员给你的批发折扣会增加{0}%，每周六早上，你还会在柜台上收到{1}份街头级梦尘作为分红。
network_CHEMIST_SHAREHOLDER_desc.en: Buy a minor share of the Lower Levels Chemist's operation. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Saturday morning a dividend of {1} street grade Dream Dust is waiting on the counter.

network_PHARMA_SHAREHOLDER_desc.zh: 入股上层区药商的生意，成为小股东。快递员给你的批发折扣会增加{0}%，每周日早上，你还会在柜台上收到{1}支奥克西莫注射器作为分红。
network_PHARMA_SHAREHOLDER_desc.en: Buy a minor share of the Upper Level Pharmacist's practice. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Sunday morning a dividend of {1} Oxymore injectors is waiting on the counter.

network_JACKSON_SPECIAL_STOCK_desc.zh: 杰克逊博士会在周一专门为你营业，提供一批价格较高的稀有物品。
network_JACKSON_SPECIAL_STOCK_desc.en: Dr. Jackson opens on Mondays for you alone, offering a special stock of rarer items at a premium.

network_HYPERTECH_SMUGGLER_desc.zh: 乔·王尔德会把你介绍给一个倒卖超科技物品的走私贩，那是远超空间站工业水平的技术。解锁“超科技走私贩”夜间服务。
network_HYPERTECH_SMUGGLER_desc.en: Joe Wild refers you to a smuggler who deals in Hypertech items, technology far beyond what the station's industry can produce. Unlocks the Hypertech Smuggler nightly service.

network_ENDORSEMENT1_desc.zh: 乔·王尔德亲自为你的店铺背书。来店顾客的预算增加{0}%。
network_ENDORSEMENT1_desc.en: Joe Wild personally endorses your store. Visiting customers have {0}% more budget to spend.

network_ENDORSEMENT2_desc.zh: 乔·王尔德向他最好的人脉大力推荐你的店铺。来店顾客的预算再增加{0}%。
network_ENDORSEMENT2_desc.en: Joe Wild talks up your store to his best contacts. Visiting customers have another {0}% more budget to spend.

network_ENDORSEMENT3_desc.zh: 乔·王尔德用自己的名声为你的店铺担保。来店顾客的预算再增加{0}%。
network_ENDORSEMENT3_desc.en: Joe Wild puts his own name behind your store. Visiting customers have another {0}% more budget to spend.

network_WILD_FIXER2_desc.zh: 王尔德会给你派来更有经验的善后人。他们清理证据更快，你的犯罪嫌疑度每晚会降得更多。每晚的费用也会提高。
network_WILD_FIXER2_desc.en: Wild assigns you his more experienced fixers. They clear evidence faster, so your suspected crime level drops more each night. The nightly fee increases.

network_WILD_FIXER3_desc.zh: 王尔德把他最好的人手派到你的店里。目击者会忘事，证据会消失，你的犯罪嫌疑度每晚降得更快。每晚的费用也会提高。
network_WILD_FIXER3_desc.en: Wild puts his best crew on your store. Witnesses forget, evidence disappears, and your suspected crime level drops even faster each night. The nightly fee increases.

generalist_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你并未对某项特定专精产生浓厚兴趣。相对地，你把心思都用在了精打细算上，从而在盘下店铺时节省了一笔启动资金。
generalist_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, no particular specialization piqued your interest. Instead, you spent more time optimising your operation, resulting in less money spent setting up the store.

generalist_gear3.zh: 初始拥有一批日用品与食物库存
generalist_gear3.en: Start with a stock of Household Goods and Food

water_merchant_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对水资源交易产生了浓厚兴趣。在这个空间站里，净水是稀缺资源。谁能控制水源，谁就能大发横财。
water_merchant_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in learning about the Water trade. Clean water is a scarce resource on the station and there is money to be made by those with their hands on the tap.

water_merchant_gear2.zh: 额外存储空间（储水容器）

junker_body.zh: 在导师找到你之前，你是一名拾荒客，虽一贫如洗但口碑可靠。纵然学了新本事，你依旧不忘老本行，还将当年的旧行头翻新改装后用在了如今的行当上。
junker_body.en: Before The Mentor found you, you were a scavenger, poor but with solid reputation. Despite your training, you never forgot your past, and have even repurposed your old equipment for your new occupation.

fence_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对违禁品产生了格外的兴趣。你现在是一名资深的黑市商人，甚至在店里安装了暗格，以躲避空间站治安部的搜查。
fence_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in contraband. You're an established black marketeer, and have even installed a hidden storage compartment in your store to avoid the prying of the station's security.

fence_gear2.zh: 初始拥有一批违禁品库存
fence_gear2.en: Start with a stock of Contraband

fence_gear5.zh: 初始解锁“清道夫地下交易所”的访问权限
fence_gear5.en: Immediate access to the Janitor Underground Exchange

moonshiner_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对私酒情有独钟。你懂得如何交易、鉴定甚至亲自酿造烈酒。由于价格低廉，私酒在下层区极受欢迎，但它同时也缺乏质量管控，且属于明文禁止的非法物品。
moonshiner_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a taste for moonshine. You know how to trade, appraise and even brew your own liquor. Moonshine is popular in the Lower Levels due to its low cost, but it is also unregulated and illegal.

chemist_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你培养出了对麻醉品的敏锐嗅觉。你是不法药物交易的专家，深知这类成瘾性管制品有多暴利。货源吃紧的话，你在实验室里亲自调配的手艺也相当不赖。
chemist_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you acquired a nose for narcotics. You are an expert in the illegal, addictive and lucrative trade of controlled substances. You're not bad in the lab, either, should supply run low.

organ_trader_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你不知不觉迷上了人体器官交易这门阴森的生意。虽然交易那些来源合规、具备证明的器官并不犯法……但从活体病人身上摘取的黑市脏器，利润要丰厚得多。
organ_trader_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a grim fascination in the trade of human organs. Certified, ethically sourced organs are legal to trade... but there is more money to be made in illicit stock harvested from living patients.

organ_trader_gear2.zh: 额外设备（器官冷藏容器）

pharmacist_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对非处方药产生了特别的兴趣。你学习了经营药房的基础知识，懂得如何救治患病的顾客，以及如何合成所需的药物。
pharmacist_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in over-the-counter medicines. You learned about the basics of running a pharmacy, helping sick customers and synthesizing drugs.

pharmacist_gear3.zh: 初始拥有一批医疗物资库存
pharmacist_gear3.en: Start with a stock of Medical Supplies

street_food_vendor_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对烹饪和街头小吃倾注了极大的热情。你对下层区居民的口味了如指掌，随手就能端出便宜好吃的快餐。经营路边摊是一种普遍且灵活的谋生手段，只要食材选得对，利润也相当可观。
street_food_vendor_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a passion for cooking and street food. You know how to prepare quick, flavorful meals that cater to the busy residents of the lower levels. Operating a street food stall is a popular and flexible way to make a living, and with the right ingredients, you can turn a tidy profit.

street_food_vendor_gear3.zh: 初始拥有一批食材库存
street_food_vendor_gear3.en: Start with a stock of Ingredients

hydroponic_farmer_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你钻研了水培农作的知识。对于寸土寸金的空间站而言，这是高效种植作物的实用方法。凭借你的专业技能，你不仅能为下层区提供口粮，还能顺手大赚一笔。
hydroponic_farmer_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you refined your knowledge of hydroponic farming, an efficient way to grow crops in the limited space available on the station. With your expertise, you can help feed the lower levels while making a handy profit.

hydroponic_farmer_gear3.zh: 初始拥有一批农用物资和种子库存
hydroponic_farmer_gear3.en: Start with a stock of Farming Supplies and Seeds

gunsmith_body.zh: 在跟随导师训练期间，你对枪械和弹药展现出了浓厚的兴趣。你学会了如何改装武器，从自制手枪到威力巨大的机枪都不在话下。如今，手握许可证的你可以承接定制订单，通过给空间站的居民提供武装来赚取稳定的收入。
gunsmith_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you developed an enthusiasm for firearms and munitions. You learned how to modify weapons, from handmade sidearms to powerful machine guns. With a license in hand, you now fulfill custom orders and earn a steady income arming the residents of the station.

gunsmith_gear2.zh: 初始拥有一批枪械与枪械模组库存
gunsmith_gear2.en: Start with a stock of Firearms and Gun Mods

gunsmith_gear3.zh: 初始拥有一批弹药库存
gunsmith_gear3.en: Start with a stock of Ammunition

rock_bottom_body.zh: 除了替你跟房东谈妥租约，导师没有给你提供任何帮助。除了这家店铺和求生的意志，你一无所有。
rock_bottom_body.en: The Mentor didn't help you with anything aside from negotiating your lease with the Landlord. You have nothing but the Store, and a will to survive.

rancher_body.zh: 令导师感到恼火的是，你偏偏对动物养殖情有独钟——准确点说，是老鼠养殖。你已经掌握了饲养肉用鼠的基础知识。
rancher_body.en: To the Mentor's annoyance, you developed a great passion for animal ranching. Rats, more specifically. You've learned the basics of raising rats for meat.

welcome_main.zh: 你是这庞大空间站下层区的一名店主。曾经作为一名贫苦拾荒者的你，被一位人称“导师”的神秘人物收留。他为你提供了一笔慷慨的贷款，并教会了你经营店铺的基础知识。他真正的动机依然不明。\n现在，你必须满足房东那无休止的苛求，否则便会面临驱逐。赚取利润、偿清贷款，彻底买下这家店铺，在这个空间站上打拼出你的一席之地。\n不惜一切代价活下去。去赢取你的未来。
welcome_main.en: You're a shopkeeper in the Lower Levels of a sprawling space station. Once a poor scavenger, you were taken in by a mysterious figure known as the Mentor, who fronted you a generous loan and taught you the basics of running a shop. His true motives remain unclear.\nNow you must meet the Landlord's unrelenting demands or face eviction. Turn a profit, secure a mortgage, and buy the shop to carve out your place on the station.\n Survive at any cost. Earn your future.

aquafarmer_body.zh: 在跟随导师学习期间，你学会了用水缸养鱼，获取鱼肉。开局时，你会拥有一套小型循环水养殖系统和一批入门鱼种。
aquafarmer_body.en: During your training with The Mentor, you learned to raise fish in tanks for meat. You start with a small recirculating system and a stock of starter fish.

aquafarmer_gear2.zh: 初始拥有一批罗非鱼和鱼食
aquafarmer_gear2.en: Start with a stock of Tilapia and Fish Food

perk_bad_lease_desc.zh: 你的初始租金增加{0}信用点。
perk_bad_lease_desc.en: Your starting rent is increased by {0} Credits.

perk_convict_desc.zh: 开局获得额外{0}点治安部声望，但在举报通缉名单上的顾客时，获得的悬赏减少{1}%。
perk_convict_desc.en: Start with an additional {0} Security Reputation and will receive {1}% less reward for reporting customers on the Wanted List.

perk_model_citizen_desc.zh: 开局获得额外+{0}点治安部声望，并在举报通缉名单上的顾客时，获得的悬赏提升{1}%。
perk_model_citizen_desc.en: Start with an additional +{0} Security Reputation and will receive {1}% more reward for reporting customers on the Wanted List.

perk_well_connected_desc.zh: 所有派系的初始声望均增加{0}点。
perk_well_connected_desc.en: Start with an additional {0} Reputation with all factions.

perk_alert_desc.zh: 你在夜间永远不会遭遇抢劫。
perk_alert_desc.en: You will never get robbed during the night.

perk_sawyer_crew_desc.zh: 初始解锁“地下交易所”。清洁服务永远免费，除非店铺遭到破坏；清理破坏的费用也大幅降低。
perk_sawyer_crew_desc.en: The Underground Exchange is available from the start. Janitorial Service is always free,  unless the Store is vandalized. Vandalism clean up cost is significantly reduced.

perk_diplomatic_desc.en: Reputation generated from trade is increased by {0}%.

perk_intimidating_desc.zh: 实施所有犯罪行为时，留下的可用证据减少{0}%。
perk_intimidating_desc.en: All committed crimes generate {0}% less available evidence.

perk_side_street_desc.zh: 每天减少一名随机顾客。
perk_side_street_desc.en: You get one less random customer per day.

perk_nicotine_addiction_desc.zh: 如果不定期摄入尼古丁，你将承受{0}%的交易惩罚。此成瘾症可以被治愈。
perk_nicotine_addiction_desc.en: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume nicotine regularly. The addiction can be cured.

perk_narcotic_addiction_desc.zh: 如果不定期摄入麻醉品，你将承受{0}%的交易惩罚。此成瘾症可以被治愈。
perk_narcotic_addiction_desc.en: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume narcotics regularly. The addiction can be cured.

perk_alcohol_addiction_desc.zh: 如果不定期摄入酒精，你将承受{0}%的交易惩罚。此成瘾症可以被治愈。
perk_alcohol_addiction_desc.en: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume alcohol regularly. The addiction can be cured.

perk_secret_admirer_desc.zh: 开店时，你偶尔会收到来自神秘仰慕者的随机物品。
perk_secret_admirer_desc.en: You will occasionally receive random items from a secret admirer when opening the Store.

perk_colorful_character_desc.zh: 初始特性槽位上限增加{0}个。
perk_colorful_character_desc.en: Allows you to have {0} additional starting perk slots.

perk_blackmail_desc.zh: 你有一段不光彩的过去，一个敲诈者正威胁要曝光你的秘密。你必须每周向其支付一笔小额封口费，否则一旦曝光，你将在大多数派系中遭遇一次大幅度的声望降低。
perk_blackmail_desc.en: You have a questionable past and a blackmailer is threatening to expose your secret. You will have to pay them a small weekly fee or they will expose you,  leading to a major one-time loss to your reputation across most factions.

perk_blabbermouth_desc.zh: 实施所有犯罪时留下的可用证据增加{0}%。你在黑市和革命军处获得的声望减少50%。
perk_blabbermouth_desc.en: All committed crimes generate {0}% more available evidence. You will gain 50% less reputation with the Black Market and the Revolution.

perk_unsubscribed_desc.zh: 你将不会收到报道近期事件的每日报纸。
perk_unsubscribed_desc.en: You will not receive the daily newspaper that informs you about ongoing events.

perk_minimalist_desc.zh: 你的主物品栏容量缩减，从24x10降至20x10。
perk_minimalist_desc.en: Your main inventory is reduced 20x10 instead of 24x10.

perk_sentinel_desc.zh: 你患有一种致命且无法治愈的自身免疫性疾病，必须每周注射一次免疫宁才能存活。开局自带1支免疫宁注射器。
perk_sentinel_desc.en: You suffer from a deadly, incurable auto-immune condition and must take a weekly Immunivax injection to stay alive. Start the game with 1 Immunivax Injector.

perk_speedy_desc.zh: 每天夜间，你最多可以访问2个夜间地点。
perk_speedy_desc.en: You can visit up to 2 after-hours locations every night.

perk_welfare_program_desc.zh: 初始解锁配给站。在每周一，系统可能会根据你的总资产为你发放食品券。
perk_welfare_program_desc.en: The Commissary is available from the start.  On Mondays, you may receive Food Stamps depending on your total wealth.

perk_proficient_scavenger_desc.zh: 每次访问垃圾场时，你最多可以额外执行2次搜索行动。
perk_proficient_scavenger_desc.en: You can perform up to 2 additional Search actions in the Dumping Grounds every time you visit.

perk_revolution_sympathizer_desc.zh: 开局获得额外{0}点革命军声望。你将更频繁地收到来自革命军的市场委托。
perk_revolution_sympathizer_desc.en: Start with an additional {0} Reputation with The Revolution. You will receive Marketplace Requests from The Revolution more frequently.

perk_gambling_addiction_desc.zh: 只要有机会，你总会购买一些彩票。所有彩票内容将从开局解锁。此成瘾症可以被治愈。
perk_gambling_addiction_desc.en: You will always buy some Lottery Tickets when possible. All lottery content is unlocked from the start. The addiction can be cured.

perk_tapehead_desc.zh: 初始即解锁并拥有磁带播放器内所有可用的音乐磁带。
perk_tapehead_desc.en: You start with all music cassettes available inside the cassette player.

perk_expedition_organizer_desc.zh: 你可以雇佣特定角色并组织探险。初始即可解锁探险系统，并附带一名雇工。
perk_expedition_organizer_desc.en: You can hire certain characters and organize expeditions. Unlock Expedition content from the start along with a Hireling.

perk_vending_desc.zh: 初始自带一台安置于店外的自动贩卖机。允许顾客在非营业时间自助购买物品。
perk_vending_desc.en: Start with a vending machine installed in front of your store. Allow customers to purchase items automatically during after-hours.

perk_short_sleeper_desc.zh: 即使前一天晚上外出进行夜间活动，你也不会流失任何顾客。
perk_short_sleeper_desc.en: You won't miss out on any customers when going out during after-hours activities the night before.

perk_working_pipes_desc.zh: 开局时水管已接通，可无限供应铁锈水。
perk_working_pipes_desc.en: You will start with the water lines already connected with unlimited Rustwater.

perk_illiterate_desc.zh: 你将无法阅读任何指南。
perk_illiterate_desc.en: You won't be able to read any guide.

perk_prime_real_estate_desc.zh: '每天会多来1位普通顾客，但初始租金增加{0}信用点。 '
perk_prime_real_estate_desc.en: '1 more normal customer will visit everyday but starting rent cost {0} credit more. '

perk_degenerative_osteoarthritis_desc.zh: 第一周内，你仍可照常在垃圾场拾荒。此后每过一周，每日拾荒次数上限就会减少1次。次数上限低于{0}次后，你将无法再拾荒。普通店主开局时每天最多可拾荒{1}次。开局额外获得{2}条外用药膏绷带。
perk_degenerative_osteoarthritis_desc.en: Scavenging in the dumping ground works normally for the first week. After that, you lose 1 max scavenging attempt every week that passes. Once your max attempts fall below {0}, you can no longer scavenge at all. Normal shopkeepers start with {1} daily max attempts. Start with {2} additional topical medication bandages.

perk_known_snitch_desc.zh: 治安部通缉名单上的顾客绝不会光顾你的店铺。开局时，你在革命军和黑市的声望均为{0}点。
perk_known_snitch_desc.en: Customers from the wanted poster will never visit your store. Start with {0} reputation with the Revolution and the Black Market.

perk_handy_desc.zh: 开局自带一个破旧工具箱，以及一套破旧工具：螺丝刀、剪线钳、撬棍和等离子切割机。
perk_handy_desc.en: 'Start with a shabby toolbox and a set of shabby tools: a screwdriver, a wire cutter, a crowbar and a plasma cutter.'

perk_public_enemy_desc.zh: 所有派系的初始声望均为{0}。
perk_public_enemy_desc.en: Start with {0} Reputation with all factions.

perk_ascetic_desc.zh: 主物品栏的尺寸从24×10缩减为{0}×10。
perk_ascetic_desc.en: Your main inventory is reduced to {0}x10 instead of 24x10.

perk_maimed_desc.zh: 垃圾倾倒场不可用，你无法进行任何拾荒活动。
perk_maimed_desc.en: The Dumping Ground is not available. You cannot scavenge at all.

perk_wild_favorite_desc.zh: 王尔德的人脉网络中，所有升级费用降低{0}%，保险费用降低{1}%。
perk_wild_favorite_desc.en: All upgrades from Wild's Network cost {0}% less. Insurance costs {1}% less.

perk_wild_bad_side_desc.zh: 王尔德的人脉网络中，所有升级费用提高{0}%，保险费用提高{1}%。
perk_wild_bad_side_desc.en: All upgrades from Wild's Network cost {0}% more. Insurance costs {1}% more.

perk_aug_menace_desc.zh: 开局即解锁改造体相关内容。击杀改造体获得的信用点增加{0}%。改造体危机将一直持续，无论选择哪种难度，放跑过多改造体都会导致游戏结束。
perk_aug_menace_desc.en: The Augmented content is unlocked at the start of the game. Earn {0}% more credits for killing an aug. The aug menace never ends, and letting too many augs get away ends the game on every difficulty.

perk_lucky_desc.zh: 让你的运气变好。大概吧。

perk_unlucky_desc.zh: 让你的运气变差。大概吧。

perk_tinkerer_desc.zh: 升级物品时，有{0}%的概率不消耗所用材料。
perk_tinkerer_desc.en: When you upgrade an item, there is a {0}% chance the material used is not consumed.

perk_careful_scavenger_desc.zh: 每次前往垃圾倾倒场，可进行的行动减少{0}次，但搜索时绝不会受伤。
perk_careful_scavenger_desc.en: You can perform {0} fewer actions in the Dumping Grounds every time you visit, but you never get injured while searching.

perk_sycophant_desc.zh: 开局额外获得{0}点上层区声望。获得的上层区声望增加{1}%，上层区顾客的预算增加{2}%。
perk_sycophant_desc.en: Start with an additional +{0} Upper Levels Reputation. Reputation gained with the Upper Levels is increased by {1}%, and Upper Level customers have {2}% more budget.

perk_agoraphobia_rest_desc.zh: 去过夜间地点后，你必须先在店内休息{0}晚，才能再次外出。
perk_agoraphobia_rest_desc.en: After visiting an after-hours location, you must rest at the Store for {0} nights before going out again.

perk_awful_negotiator_desc.zh: 你无法与顾客讨价还价，并且会永久承受{0}%的交易惩罚。
perk_awful_negotiator_desc.en: You cannot bargain with customers, and you suffer a permanent trade penalty of {0}%.

perk_banned_commissary_desc.zh: 配给站不可用，食品券相关内容也永远不会解锁。
perk_banned_commissary_desc.en: The Commissary is not available, and food stamps are never introduced.

perk_hoarder_desc.zh: 开局时，物品栏底部会堆着三堆无法移动的杂物。每堆杂物都可以清除。
perk_hoarder_desc.en: Start with three piles of immovable debris along the bottom of your inventory. Each pile can be removed.

perk_makeshift_reactor_desc.zh: 你的店铺将永久脱离空间站电网，不受停电影响。开局时，你会拥有一台从杰克逊博士那里买来的可升级简易微型核反应堆。它能为店铺供电，但需要定期维修。
perk_makeshift_reactor_desc.en: You are permanently disconnected from the station power grid and are not affected by blackouts. Start with an upgradable Makeshift Micro Nuclear Reactor sold to you by Dr. Jackson. It powers the Store but needs regular repairs.

perk_agoraphobia_desc.en: You are unable leave the Store to visit any after-hours locations.

rep_perk_LLREFERAL_desc.zh: 每天有{0}%概率吸引{1}名额外的随机顾客光顾店铺。
rep_perk_LLREFERAL_desc.en: '{0}% chance that {1} additional random customer will visit the Store per day.'

rep_perk_LLREFERAL_flavor.zh: 在下层区，消息传得很快。一个满意的回头客远不止是一笔买卖，更是你最好的广告。
rep_perk_LLREFERAL_flavor.en: Word travels fast in the Lower Levels. A satisfied customer is more than just a sale, they're your best advertisement.

rep_perk_LLTIPS_desc.zh: 你偶尔会收到来自下层区的关于即将发生事件的情报。
rep_perk_LLTIPS_desc.en: You will occasionally receive tips from the Lower Levels about upcoming events.

rep_perk_LLTIPS_flavor.zh: 下层区的人总是耳听八方。如果他们信任你，也会让你随时掌握最新动向。
rep_perk_LLTIPS_flavor.en: The people of the Lower Levels have their ears to the ground. If they trust you, they'll keep you in the loop, too.

rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_desc.zh: 提供稀有货物或违禁品的新型顾客将开始光顾你的店铺。
rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_desc.en: New types of customers offering Rare or Contraband goods will start to visit your Store.

rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_flavor.zh: 只要人脉合适，即便在下层区也能找到值得你花时间的好东西。
rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_flavor.en: With the right connections, even the Lower Levels can offer up something worth your while.

rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_desc.zh: 向下层区顾客出售违禁品时，仅会产生相当于其价值{0:P0}的可用证据。
rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_desc.en: Selling Contraband to customers from the Lower Levels will only create {0:P0} of its value in available evidence.

rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_flavor.zh: 你已经赢得了他们的信任。他们知道你信得过，不会出卖你。
rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_flavor.en: You've earned their trust. They know you're good for it, and they're not going to rat you out.

rep_perk_LLPILLAR_desc.zh: 你现在可以从乔·王尔德和杰克逊博士那里获得{0}%的折扣。
rep_perk_LLPILLAR_desc.en: You will now receive {0}% discount from Joe Wild and Dr. Jackson.

rep_perk_LLPILLAR_flavor.zh: 你已赢得了下层区的尊重。就连下层区的其他头目也认可你的善举。
rep_perk_LLPILLAR_flavor.en: You've earned the respect of the Lower Levels. Even other Lower Levels leaders recognize the good you do.

rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_desc.zh: 每天有{0}%概率减少{1}名随机顾客。
rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_desc.en: '{0}% chance that {1} less random customer will visit your Store per day.'

rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_flavor.zh: 只需几个不满意的顾客，你在下层区的声望就会遭受打击。
rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_flavor.en: All it takes is a few dissatisfied customers, and your Reputation in the Lower Levels takes a hit.

rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_desc.zh: 来自下层区的顾客将不再向你出售违禁品。
rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_desc.en: Customers from the Lower Levels will no longer sell you Contraband items.

rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_flavor.zh: 你在整个下层区都被视为一个麻烦人物。有违禁品要卖的人会去别处交易。
rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_flavor.en: You are known throughout the Lower Levels as a liability. Those with contraband to sell will take it elsewhere.

rep_perk_LLTARGET_desc.zh: 你将更频繁地成为小偷的目标。保险费用现在涨至{0}倍。
rep_perk_LLTARGET_desc.en: You will be targeted more frequently by thieves. Insurance will now cost {0}x.

rep_perk_LLTARGET_flavor.zh: 你糟糕的声望让你成为了众矢之的。下层区的人永不遗忘。
rep_perk_LLTARGET_flavor.en: Your poor reputation has put a target on your back. The Lower Levels never forget.

rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_desc.zh: 所有供货商都将拒接你的电话。除了特殊情况外，杰克逊博士将不再造访你的店铺。
rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_desc.en: All suppliers will refuse to take your calls. Dr. Jackson will no longer visit your Store, except under special circumstances.

rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_flavor.zh: 再也没有人愿意和你沾上关系了，他们担心败坏了自己的名声。
rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_flavor.en: No one want to associate with you anymore. Fearing for their own reputation.

rep_perk_LLLYNCH_desc.zh: 一群来自下层区的暴民将袭击你的店铺并对你施以私刑。
rep_perk_LLLYNCH_desc.en: A mob from the Lower Levels will attack your Store and lynch you.

rep_perk_LLLYNCH_flavor.zh: 下层区的人已经受够了，他们将亲自采取行动解决问题。
rep_perk_LLLYNCH_flavor.en: The people of the Lower Levels have had enough, they'll take matters into their own hands.

rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_desc.zh: 治安部征用官偶尔会造访你的店铺购买食物和医疗物资。与他们交易将提升你的声望。
rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_desc.en: A Security Requisition Officer will occasionally visit your Store to purchase Food and Medical Supplies. Trading with them will increase your Reputation.

rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_flavor.zh: 即便是空间站治安部也得找人进货。他们会付给你公道的价格。
rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_flavor.en: Even Station Security has to get their supplies from someone. They will pay you a fair price.

rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_desc.zh: 治安部将不再回应你的报警。
rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_desc.en: Security will not longer respond to your alarms.

rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_flavor.zh: 或许是你喊了太多次狼来了，亦或是你已经不值得他们费心了。无论如何，大难临头时只能自求多福了。
rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_flavor.en: You've cried wolf one too many times, or maybe you're just not worth the trouble anymore. Either way, when things go south, you're on your own.

rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_desc.zh: 治安部已将你列入观察名单。针对你的所有调查的速度都将加快至原来的{0}倍。
rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_desc.en: Security has added you on their watchlist. Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.

rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_flavor.zh: 你的臭名昭著已成功引起了治安部的关注。夹好尾巴做人，否则就脑袋搬家。
rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_flavor.en: Your notoriety has caught the eye of Station Security. Keep your head down, or lose it.

rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_desc.zh: 针对你的所有调查的速度都将加快至原来的{0}倍。
rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_desc.en: Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.

rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_flavor.zh: 又一天过去，空间站治安部主管的办公桌上，又多了一份写着你名字的案卷……
rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_flavor.en: Another day, another case file with your name on it on the desk of the Head of Station Security...

rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_desc.zh: 治安部将停止派遣敷衍了事或涉黑腐败的检查员来你这里。此外，盘查将变得更加频繁。
rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_desc.en: Security will no longer sent you lazy or shady inspectors. Additionally, inspections will be more frequent.

rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_flavor.zh: 别指望盘查员让你轻易过关，或是睁一只眼闭一只眼了。现在每一次盘查都会翻个底朝天。
rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_flavor.en: No more easy passes or conveniently blind inspectors. Every visit is now a full sweep.

rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_desc.zh: 针对盘查中查获的违禁品，治安部将依法对你进行顶格起诉。
rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_desc.en: Security will prosecute you to the maximum extent of the law regarding contraband found during inspection.

rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_flavor.zh: 不再有警告，也不再接受贿赂。哪怕是最小的违禁品也能让你陷入大麻烦。
rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_flavor.en: No more warnings. No more bribes. Even the smallest contraband could land you in serious trouble.

rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_desc.zh: 无论他们是否掌握证据，治安部都会立即将你逮捕入狱。
rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_desc.en: Security will immediately arrest and jail you, regardless of any evidence they have (or don't have).

rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_flavor.zh: 当他们想让你消失时，真相就无关紧要了。他们会确保所谓的“证据”完全如他们所愿。
rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_flavor.en: When they want you gone, the truth doesn't matter. They'll make sure the "evidence" says exactly what they need it to.

rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_desc.zh: 由于你在治安部声誉良好，小偷更不愿意把你的店铺当成目标。
rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_desc.en: Due to your good Reputation with Security, Thieves are more reluctant to target your Store.

rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_flavor.zh: 被空间站治安部盯着并不总是一件坏事。
rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_flavor.en: Having the eyes of Station Security on you isn't always a bad thing.

rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_desc.zh: 一名治安部盈余物资商人偶尔会造访店铺。
rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_desc.en: A Security Surplus Merchant will occasionally visit the Store.

rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_flavor.zh: 空间站治安部已同意向你出售他们退役的装备，包括武器和护甲。
rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_flavor.en: Station Security has agreed to sell you their decommissioned equipment, including weapons and armor.

rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_desc.zh: 治安部盈余物资商人将提供更好的商品，且治安部顾客将增加{0}%的可花费信用点。
rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_desc.en: The Security Surplus Merchant will have improved wares, and Security customers will have {0}% more credits to spend.

rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_flavor.zh: 你已经证明了自己是一个可靠的供应商。空间站治安部愿意与你做更多的生意。
rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_flavor.en: You've proven yourself to be a reliable vendor. Station Security is willing to do more business with you.

rep_perk_SEC_VIP_desc.zh: 由于你在治安部拥有极高声望，小偷将不再把你的店铺当成目标。你也将不再接受任何盘查。
rep_perk_SEC_VIP_desc.en: Due to your excellent Reputation with Security, Thieves will no longer target your Store. You will no longer be subject to inspection.

rep_perk_SEC_VIP_flavor.zh: 现在谁也惹不起你了。治安部是你的后盾，他们不会让任何人找你的麻烦。
rep_perk_SEC_VIP_flavor.en: You're untouchable. Security has your back, and they're not going to let anyone mess with you.

rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_desc.zh: 盘查频率将降低，且所有调查的进度都会变慢。你将提前收到关于任何即将开展的治安部行动的警告。
rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_desc.en: Inspections will be less frequent, and any investigations will progress slower. You will receive advanced warning of any impending Security Operation.

rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_flavor.zh: 被信赖便意味着治安部会更少来刁难。盘查如今已变得寥寥无几。
rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_flavor.en: Being trusted means less hassle from Security. Inspections are now few and far between.

rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_desc.zh: 你将提前收到关于大多数黑市事件的通知。
rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_desc.en: You will receive advanced notice of most Black Market events.

rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_flavor.zh: 决定生死的永远是人脉。
rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_flavor.en: It's who you know that matters.

rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_desc.zh: 来自黑市的顾客将不再向你出售违禁品。你被禁止使用地下交易所。清洁服务费用翻倍。
rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_desc.en: Customers from the Black Market will no longer sell you Contraband items. You are barred from the Underground Exchange. The Janitorial Service cost double.

rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_flavor.zh: 如果没有人信任你并愿意把东西卖给你，你的信用点就一文不值。
rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_flavor.en: Your credits aren't worth a thing if nobody trusts you enough to sell.

rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_desc.zh: 你将无法再使用保险服务。
rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_desc.en: Insurance services will not longer be available to you.

rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_flavor.zh: 由于你在黑市的恶名，连乔·王尔德都无法再为你提供担保了。往后你只能靠自己了。
rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_flavor.en: Due to your infamy with the Black Market, even Joe Wild can't insure you anymore. You're on your own now.

rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_desc.zh: 小偷顾客光顾你店铺的几率提升。他们的货物质量现在会随着你黑市声望的提高而改善。
rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_desc.en: Petty Thieves have an increased chance of visiting your Store. Their wares will now improve with higher Black Market Reputation.

rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_flavor.zh: 你开始在黑市中建立起名声。
rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_flavor.en: You are starting to build a reputation with the Black Market.

rep_perk_BM_HONOR_desc.zh: 无论你当前的声望如何，黑市声望流失速度将变为原本的{0}倍。
rep_perk_BM_HONOR_desc.en: Reputation is lost with the Black Market at a rate of x{0}, regardless of your current Reputation.

rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_desc.zh: 每周至少会有一名小偷顾客前来光顾。现在所有小偷都会提供更好的货物。
rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_desc.en: You are guaranteed a visit from a Thief once per week. All thieves will now offer improved wares.

rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_flavor.zh: 黑市的小偷们知道你很可靠，越来越多的人愿意和你做生意。
rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_flavor.en: The Thieves of the Black Market know you're good for it, and more are willing to deal with you.

rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_desc.zh: 你将提前收到关于大多数上层区事件的通知。
rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_desc.en: You will receive advanced notice of most Upper Levels events.

rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_flavor.zh: 那帮权贵的嘴巴一刻也没停过……甚至有的时候，会冒出几句不是废话的话。
rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_flavor.en: They never stop talking up there... sometimes they even say something useful.

rep_perk_UL_TIPS_desc.zh: 向上层区顾客出售物品时，你将获得{0}%的奖励。
rep_perk_UL_TIPS_desc.en: You will receive {0}% bonus when selling items to customers from the Upper Levels.

rep_perk_UL_TIPS_flavor.zh: 他们从不讨价还价。他们还会多扔出几枚信用点，美其名曰贵族风度。
rep_perk_UL_TIPS_flavor.en: They don't haggle. They just drop a few extra credits and call it etiquette.

rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_desc.zh: 一位来自上层区的施恩人将不定期向你的店铺捐赠物品。
rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_desc.en: A benefactor from the Upper Levels will occasionally donate goods to your Store.

rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_flavor.zh: 是逢场作戏的作秀，还是发自内心的善意？反正免费的不要白不要。
rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_flavor.en: Publicity stunts or genuine kindness? You won't argue with free goods.

rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_desc.zh: 你有{0}%的概率每天额外吸引{1}名上层区顾客。
rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_desc.en: You have {0}% chance of receiving {1} additional daily customer from the Upper Levels.

rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_flavor.zh: 你的店铺已经成为了上层区谈论的话题。
rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_flavor.en: Your Store has become the talk of the Upper Levels.

rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_desc.zh: 所有来自上层区的顾客都将增加{0}%的可花费信用点。
rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_desc.en: All customers from the Upper Levels have {0}% more credits to spend.

rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_flavor.zh: 你的店铺是上层区人尽皆知的秘密。上层区的顾客在造访时愿意花更多的钱。
rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_flavor.en: Your Store is the worst kept secret in the Upper Levels. Customers from the Upper Levels are willing to spend more when they visit.

rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_desc.zh: 上层区的顾客光顾你的店铺的可能性降低。
rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_desc.en: Customers from the Upper Levels are less likely to visit your Store.

rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_flavor.zh: 上层区客户的期望总是更高。而最近，你没能满足他们。
rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_flavor.en: Upper Levels clients expect better. Lately, you're not delivering.

rep_perk_UL_PETITION_desc.zh: 你在治安部的声望流失速度变为原来的{0}倍，且正在进行的调查的速度加快{1:P0}。
rep_perk_UL_PETITION_desc.en: You lose Reputation with Security {0}x faster and active investigations progress {1:P0} faster.

rep_perk_UL_PETITION_flavor.zh: 利用他们的影响力，上层区已经向治安部联合施压，要求对你密切监视。
rep_perk_UL_PETITION_flavor.en: Using their influence, the Upper Levels have petitioned Security to keep a closer eye on you.

rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_desc.zh: 上层区的人将立即对你的人头下达悬赏。
rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_desc.en: A hit will be immediately placed on you by the Upper Levels.

rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_flavor.zh: 上层某间豪华套房里已经签下了一份契约。你惹了不该惹的人。
rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_flavor.en: A contract has been signed in a luxury suites above. You've made the wrong enemies.

rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_desc.zh: 你将提前收到关于大多数革命军事件的通知。
rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_desc.en: You will receive advanced notice of most Revolution events.

rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_flavor.zh: 革命军会确保你不会被卷入交火之中。
rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_flavor.en: The revolution will make sure you are not caught in the crossfire.

rep_perk_REV_HIT_desc.zh: 一支革命军处决小队将立即接到清除你的任务。
rep_perk_REV_HIT_desc.en: A revolution hit squad will be immediately tasked with eliminating you.

rep_perk_REV_HIT_flavor.zh: 你已被宣布为革命军的敌人。在你彻底消失之前，他们绝不会善罢甘休。
rep_perk_REV_HIT_flavor.en: You have been declared an enemy of the revolution. They will stop at nothing to see you gone.

rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_desc.zh: 同情革命军的顾客不太可能再光顾你的店铺。
rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_desc.en: Customers sympathetic to the Revolution are less likely to visit your Store.

rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_flavor.zh: 革命军各小组已发布内部通报，警告成员避免与你做生意。
rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_flavor.en: Notice has been circulated among revolutionary cells, warning members to avoid doing business with you.

rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_desc.zh: 偶尔会收到来自各个革命军小组的市场委托。
rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_desc.en: You will occasionally receive Marketplace Requests from various Revolution cells.

rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_flavor.en: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.

rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_desc.zh: 革命军成员偶尔会造访，出售他们在袭击中抢来的战利品。你的声望越高，价格就越好。
rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_desc.en: Members of the Revolution will occasionally visit to sell off their loot from raids. Prices will improve with higher Reputation.

rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_flavor.zh: 人民的解放需要物资的解放。
rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_flavor.en: The liberation of people requires the liberation of supplies.

rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_desc.zh: 一名革命军军需官偶尔会造访你的店铺，以折扣价出售材料。声望越高，折扣越大。
rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_desc.en: A Revolution Quartermaster will occasionally visit your Store to sell Materials at a discount. The discount will improve with higher Reputation.

rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_flavor.zh: 革命不能仅靠理想来维持。军需官出售廉价物资，是为了暗中为下一步行动筹集资金。
rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_flavor.en: Revolutions can't run on ideals alone. The Quartermaster sells cheap stock to quietly fund the next move.

rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_desc.zh: 一名卡特尔杀手已被派来清除你。
rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_desc.en: A Cartel Hitman has been dispatched to eliminate you.

rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_flavor.zh: 有时候，对一条狗最好的处理方式，就是给它个痛快。
rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_flavor.en: Sometimes what is best for the dog is to put it down.

rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_desc.zh: 你每周的津贴现在会随着你的卡特尔声望而调整。
rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_desc.en: Your weekly stipend now scales with your Cartel Reputation.

rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_flavor.zh: 别把它误认为是仁慈，这只是一笔投资。
rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_flavor.en: Don't mistake it for kindness, it's an investment.

rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_desc.zh: 现在申请额外材料只需花费平时所需声望的{0}%。
rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_desc.en: Requesting additional Materials now costs {0}% of the usual Reputation.

rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_flavor.zh: 卡特尔一向欣赏忠诚与稳定。
rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_flavor.en: The Cartel will reward consistency, and service.

rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_desc.zh: 你的接头人将开始为你办理脱离卡特尔的相关事宜。
rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_desc.en: Your handler will start to process your authorized exit from the Cartel.

rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_flavor.zh: 你很幸运，很少有人能不躺在裹尸袋里就离开组织……
rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_flavor.en: You're lucky, not many get to leave without a body bag...

rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_desc.zh: 展示柜中放有奢侈品时，每天有{0}%的概率额外迎来一名想购买奢侈品的顾客。概率会随声望提高。此类顾客每{1}天最多来访一次。
rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_desc.en: While a Luxury Item is in your display case, you have {0}% chance each day of receiving an additional customer looking to buy Luxury Items. Rises with Reputation. This customer can only visit once every {1} days.

rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_flavor.zh: 下层区的橱窗里居然摆着高档货？上层区那帮人哪怕只是为了吹嘘一句“这可是我先发现的”，也会专程跑下来一趟。
rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_flavor.en: Something expensive in a Lower Levels window? The Upper Levels will come down just to say they found it first.

tuto_right_click.zh: 右键点击物品以显示交互菜单
tuto_right_click.en: Right Click on an item to display the Interact Menu

tuto_double_click.zh: 也可以双击物品进行交互
tuto_double_click.en: You can also double click to Interact with an item

tuto_drag.zh: 将便签拖入手册以将其保存
tuto_drag.en: Drag the Note into the Handbook to save it

tuto_transfer.zh: 使用 CTRL + 点击 快速转移物品
tuto_transfer.en: Quick Transfer an item using CTRL + Click

tuto_dossier.zh: 将笔记本存入档案箱内
tuto_dossier.en: Store the Notebook inside the Dossier

tuto_buy.zh: Ctrl+点击，或拖拽你想要购买的物品，将其移至谈判柜台
tuto_buy.en: Ctrl-Click or Drag the item you wish to BUY to move it to the Negotiation Counter

tuto_sell.zh: Ctrl+点击，或拖拽你想要出售的物品，将其移至谈判柜台
tuto_sell.en: Ctrl-Click or Drag the item you wish to SELL to move it to the Negotiation Counter

tuto_barter.zh: '[以物易物]：将所需物品移至柜台'
tuto_barter.en: '[Barter]: Move the requested item to the Counter'

tuto_nightly_service.zh: 每晚均可开启或关闭各项服务
tuto_nightly_service.en: Services Can Be Toggle On Or Off Every Night

tuto_display_case.zh: 在打开卷帘门之前，请将商品放入展示柜中以吸引特定买家。
tuto_display_case.en: Place merchandise inside the Display Case to attract buyers before opening the shutter doors.

tuto_bargain2.zh: 使用议价界面，你可以向顾客索要更高的要价或提供更好的价格，这会影响他们的预算以及交易时获取的声望数额。
tuto_bargain2.en: Using the Bargain Interface, you can demand more or offer better prices to customers, which can affect their budget and the amount of reputation gained while trading.

tuto_advance_dialog.zh: 准备好后，按空格键推进对话
tuto_advance_dialog.en: Press Space to advance dialogue when ready

tuto_drag_select.zh: 按住鼠标左键拖动，即可框选多个物品。
tuto_drag_select.en: Hold the left mouse button and drag to select multiple items.

tuto_sort_menu.zh: 右键点击物品栏中的空槽位，即可打开排序菜单。
tuto_sort_menu.en: Right-click an empty inventory slot to open the sorting menu.

book_ingot_s1_body.zh: 在熔炉中使用两份“废金属”或两份“金属矿石”，即可冶炼出金属锭。金属锭的纯度各不相同。纯度越高，金属锭的价值也就越高。
book_ingot_s1_body.en: Metal Ingots can be smelted inside a Furnace using TWO pieces of either Scrap Metal or Metal Ore. They can have various levels of purity. The higher the purity, the more valuable the ingot will be.

inte_shutter_dismiss.zh: 遣散所有剩余顾客并结束本日营业
inte_shutter_dismiss.en: Dismiss all remaining customers and end the day

inte_shutter_cant.zh: 暂时无法结束营业，队列中还有重要人物
inte_shutter_cant.en: You can't end the day yet, there are important people in the queue

inte_bell_cant.zh: 现在无法呼叫下一位顾客
inte_bell_cant.en: You can't call the next customer right now

inte_bell_closed.zh: 店铺已打烊，无法呼叫下一位顾客
inte_bell_closed.en: You can't call the next customer, the Store is closed

inte_bell_dismiss.zh: 遣散当前顾客并呼叫下一位
inte_bell_dismiss.en: Dismiss the current customer and call the next one

inte_bell_cant_dismiss.zh: 现在无法遣散当前顾客
inte_bell_cant_dismiss.en: You can't dismiss the current customer right now

inte_client_counter.zh: 还有{count}位顾客在排队等候。
inte_client_counter.en: There are {count} customers waiting in line.

inte_dimiss_cant.zh: 现在无法遣散当前顾客
inte_dimiss_cant.en: You can't dismiss the current customer right now

inte_dimiss_no_call.zh: 遣散当前顾客，暂不呼叫下一位
inte_dimiss_no_call.en: Dismiss the current customer without calling the next one

inte_sec_reported.en: The current customer has already been reported

inte_sec_cant.en: The current customer can't be reported

inte_sleep_cant_open.en: You can't sleep while the Store is open

inte_scratcher_2_match.zh: 任意2个相同图案 = 10信用点

inte_scratcher_3_match.zh: 任意3个相同图案 = 75信用点

ins_cig_title.zh: 海明威香烟真伪鉴定手册

ins_cig_intro.zh: '假冒的海明威香烟在空间站上很常见。正如其低劣的质量一样，赝品的价值远低于正品海明威香烟。 '
ins_cig_intro.en: 'Counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes are common on the station. Their value, as their quality, is significantly lower than genuine Hemingway cigarettes. '

ins_general_discernible_note.zh: 这些差异一眼就能看出来。
ins_general_discernible_note.en: The differences should be obvious at a glance.

ins_cig_lettering_info.zh: 包装上的拼写错误、文本错位或印刷质量不均匀，以及颜色、字体有差异或缺失字母，均表明这是假货。
ins_cig_lettering_info.en: Spelling errors, misaligned text or uneven print quality on the pack, differences in color, font or missing lettering all indicate fraud.

ins_cig_seal_info.zh: 海明威香烟绝不会在没有防伪标的情况下出售。如果防伪标缺失或破损，该香烟即为假冒伪劣品。
ins_cig_seal_info.en: Hemingway Cigarettes are never sold without a security seal. If the security seal is missing or broken, the cigarette is a counterfeit.

ins_stamp_title.zh: 共和国食品券真伪鉴定手册

ins_stamp_intro.zh: 作为共和国一项极其慷慨的福利举措，食品券被定期发放给下层区最贫困的居民。这些食品券可用于在有共和国授权的商店中购买必需品。但请注意：假冒食品券在下层区并不少见。
ins_stamp_intro.en: 'As part of the Republic''s very generous welfare initiative, Food Stamps are routinely distributed among the most needy in the Lower Levels. These can be used to buy essential items in stores backed by the Republic. Be warned, however: counterfeit Food Stamps are not unusual in the Lower Levels.'

ins_stamp_lettering_intro.zh: 留意拼写错误和明显的文本错位。颜色、字体有差异或缺失字母也是伪造品中常见的问题。
ins_stamp_lettering_intro.en: Look for spelling errors, obvious misaligned text. Differences in color, font or missing lettering are also common in forgeries.

ins_stamp_seal_intro.zh: 如果食品券上印制的面值达到或超过160信用点，它就会带有防伪标。低于160信用点的食品券则没有防伪标。
ins_stamp_seal_intro.en: If the Food Stamp has a printed value of 160 Credits or higher, it will have a security seal. Food Stamps under 160 Credits will not have a security seal.

ins_stamp_value_intro.zh:
食品券仅发行以下面值：
40信用点、80信用点、
120信用点、160信用点、
200信用点、240信用点
ins_stamp_value_intro.en:
Food Stamps are ONLY issued with values of:
40 Credits, 80 Credits,
120 Credits, 160 Credits,
200 Credits, 240 Credits

ins_stamp_chip_intro.zh: '所有食品券都包含一枚芯片。如果芯片缺失或损坏，即便该食品券是真品也无法使用。 '
ins_stamp_chip_intro.en: 'All Food Stamps contain a chip. If the chip is missing or damaged, the Food Stamp is unusable, even if it is genuine. '

ins_inj_title.zh: 免疫宁免疫调节注射器用户手册

ins_inj_intro.zh: 一种高精度免疫调节剂，用于暂时抑制致命的自身免疫性疾病“哨兵崩溃综合征”引发的症状。
ins_inj_intro.en: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the effects associated with the deadly auto-immune condition Sentinel Collapse.

ins_inj_label_intro.zh:
可能出现的错误：
-拼写错误
-缺失公司名称
-缺失产品名称
-明显的字体差异
ins_inj_label_intro.en:
Possible Errors:
 -Spelling
 -Missing Company Name
 -Missing Product Name
 -Significant Font Discrepancy

ins_inj_serial_number_intro.zh: 所有免疫宁注射器必须带有有效的7位序列号。前3位数字代表批次号。有效范围为：1250000-4559999。
ins_inj_serial_number_intro.en: 'All Immunivax Injector MUST have a valid seven-digit serial number. The first three digits are the batch numbers. Valid range: 1250000-4559999.'

ins_inj_body_intro.zh: 如果在注射器上看到任何损坏，例如清晰可见的裂纹，应将其视为不可使用。
ins_inj_body_intro.en: If any damaged such as clearly visible cracks can be seen on the injector. It is considered to be Unusable

rev_card_proverb.zh: “权力存在是为了扶助，而非压迫。”
rev_card_proverb.en: '"Power exists to uplift, not to oppress."'

deed_body.zh:
本文件证明持有者为位于以下地址之商业地产的合法所有者：

下层区，14区

本契约特此将上述财产的全部所有权授予持有者，该授权将在结清《协议契约》中列明的债务以及全额支付约定的购买价款后立即生效。

该财产的所有权包括以下权利：

运营与管理权 - 对日常运营和活动的完全控制权，并承担相应责任。
翻新或改造权 - 须遵守适用的所在分区的区划法律与规定。
出售或转让权 - 须经空间站管理机构批准，并遵守所有适用的规章制度。
deed_body.en:
This document certifies the holder as the lawful owner of the commercial property located at:

Lower Level, Sector 14

This deed hereby grants full ownership rights of the aforementioned property to the holder, effective immediately upon settlement of the debt as outlined in the Deeds of Agreement and upon full payment of the agreed purchase price.

The ownership of the property includes the following rights:

Right to Operation and Management - Full control over, and assumed responsibility for, daily operations and activities.
Right to Renovation or Alteration - Subject to applicable sector zoning laws and regulations.
Right to Sell or Transfer - Subject to approval by the station’s governing authority and in accordance with all applicable rules and regulations.

lease_body.zh:
第一条：协议主体
出租方：（以下称“出租人”），
店主：（以下称“承租人”）。

第二条：租赁标的
出租人同意将租赁物出租予承租人作商业经营之用，具体须受本协议所列各项条款及条件之约束。

第三条：租赁条件
租金数额：待定        
支付周期：每七日支付一次

第四条：逾期支付租金
如果未能在到期日支付租金，承租人在本协议期限内将获得一次性宽限期。任何拖欠的租金将累加至下周租金中。若未能在下一个到期日足额支付调整后的金额，即构成违约。

清退条款：如果承租人未能支付租金或未能支付按此协议所述方法调整后的租金，出租人保留终止本协议的权利，并可根据空间站条例启动清退程序。

第五条：租金调整
租金上调：出租人保留上调下周租金的权利，最高涨幅可达当前租金数额的5%。
lease_body.en:
SECTION 1: PARTIES
The Landlord: ("Landlord"),
The Shopkeeper: ("Tenant").

SECTION 2: PREMISES
The Landlord leases to the Tenant for the operation of a commercial business, subject to the terms and conditions outlined herein.

SECTION 3: RENTAL TERMS
Rent Amount: Undetermined        
Payment Schedule: Every Seven Days

SECTION 4: FAILURE TO PAY RENT
If Rent is not paid by the due date, the Tenant shall be granted a one-time grace period during the term of this Agreement. Any missed Rent will be added to the following week’s Rent. Failure to pay the full adjusted amount by the following due date will constitute a breach of this Agreement.

Eviction Clause: If the Tenant fails to pay Rent or the adjusted Rent as outlined, the Landlord reserves the right to terminate this agreement, and initiate eviction procedures as per Station Ordinances.

SECTION 5: RENT ADJUSTMENT
Rent Increase: The Landlord retains the right to adjust the Rent by up to 5% of the current Rent amount for the subsequent week.

lottery_intro.zh: 下层区彩票终于回归了！只需一张彩票，就能开启你的发财之路。快来买一张吧！
lottery_intro.en: The Lower Levels Lottery is finally back! Your fortune starts with a single ticket. Grab yours now!

lottery_how_intro.zh: 彩票每周六早晨开奖。开奖号码将在报纸上公布。
lottery_how_intro.en: The Lottery winning numbers are drawn every Saturday morning. Winning Numbers will be announced in the newspaper.

lottery_system_intro.zh: 开奖时会从1至49中抽出6个不重复的号码。你的号码与这6个开奖号码相符的个数越多，获得的奖金就越高。
lottery_system_intro.en: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.

lottery_system_example2.zh: 示例彩票号码（匹配3个数字）

lottery_prizes_intro.zh: 你必须至少匹配三个数字才能赢得奖金。如果六个数字全部匹配，你将赢得头奖！
lottery_prizes_intro.en: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.

intel_mentor_note_basic_trading_body.zh:
1.将物品拖至谈判柜台，即可打开谈判界面。
2.如果可以买入或卖出该物品，界面上就会出现相应按钮。

每位顾客在你店里的消费预算都是有限的。

出售物品时，售价会自动计入零售加价。
intel_mentor_note_basic_trading_body.en:
1. Drag the item to the Negotiation Counter and the Negotiation Interface will appear.
 2. A button will appear if you are able to buy or sell the item.

 Clients only have a limited budget to spend at your Store.

You will automatically sell your items with a retail markup.

intel_mentor_note_food_body.zh: 食物是空间站上交易量最大的商品。\n强烈建议备足食物库存，毕竟一旦发生短缺，水和食物的价格都会飞速上涨。人总归是要吃饭的。
intel_mentor_note_food_body.en: Food is the most traded commodity on the station.\n Keeping Food in stock is highly recommended, as Food and water prices can rise sharply during shortages. Everyone has to eat.

intel_mentor_note_afterhours_body.zh: 在结束一天的营业打烊后，你应该有时间去拜访该区域周围的各个地点。\n你随时可以返回垃圾场进行拾荒。如果没有背包，你将无法把太多东西带回店铺。\n你还应该带上用于包扎的绷带，以防在拾荒时受伤。如果你受了重伤，将会有几天无法出门。
intel_mentor_note_afterhours_body.en: After closing the Store for the day, you should have time to visit one of the various locations around the Sector.\n You can always return to the Dumping Grounds to scavenge. You won't be able to bring much back to the Store without a backpack.\n You should also bring a bandage to patch yourself up in case you get wounded while scavenging. If you are badly hurt, you won't be able to go out for a few days.

intel_mentor_note_wholesale_body.zh: 有时如果你买下卖家所有的物品，他们会提供折扣。（这就叫作“批发”。）\n\n你仍然可以单独检查该交易中的每一件物品。
intel_mentor_note_wholesale_body.en: Sometimes sellers offer a discount if you buy all of their items. (This is called buying \"Wholesale\".)\n\n You can still inspect each item in the offer individually.

intel_mentor_note_contraband_body.zh:
违禁品包括任何被共和国视为非法的物品。持有或出售违禁品伴随着高风险……以及更高的利润率。
违禁品分为4个等级：
低级（+{0}%利润率）：虽然严格来说属于非法，但通常会被治安部无视，除非他们有意针对你。
中级（+{1}%利润率）：如果在盘查中被发现，该物品将被没收。
高级（+{2}%利润率）：如果在盘查中被发现，该物品将被没收，并且你将受到罚款。
高危级（+{3}%利润率）：如果在盘查中被发现，店铺将被永久查封，你也会被立即逮捕。
此外，如果发现任何违禁品，你在治安部的声望都会下降。
intel_mentor_note_contraband_body.en:
Contraband includes any item that is considered illegal by the Republic. The possession or sale of Contraband carries a high risk... and a higher profit margin.
 There are 4 tiers of Contraband:
Low Level (+{0}% Profit Margin): While technically illegal, they are generally ignored by Security unless they are out to get you.
 Mid Level (+{1}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized.
 High Level (+{2}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized and you will receive a fine.
 Critical Level (+{3}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, the Store will be shut down permanently and you will be immediately arrested.
 Additionally, you will lose Reputation with Security if any Contraband is found.

intel_mentor_note_stolen_body.zh: 买卖[赃物]是非法的。每件赃物都有“热度”值，热度越高，治安部在盘查时越容易将其认出。卖家会根据热度值提供相应的折扣。\n热度会随着时间推移缓慢下降。
intel_mentor_note_stolen_body.en: It is illegal to trade in [Stolen] items. Each stolen item has Heat value, the higher the Heat, the more likely Security will recognize it on inspection. Sellers will offer a discount based on the Heat value.\n Heat slowly decreases over time.

intel_mentor_note_inspection_body.zh: 空间站治安部将对违禁品进行随机盘查。你在治安部的声望将影响发现违禁品时你所受惩罚的严重程度。各类事件也会影响店铺受到检查的频率。\n\n此外，不同的警官执行盘查的方式也不同。有些可能愿意接受贿赂；有些则可能不会把所有容器翻个遍。
intel_mentor_note_inspection_body.en: Station Security will conduct random inspections for Contraband. Your Reputation with Security will affect the severity of your punishment when Contraband is found. Events can affect how often the Store is inspected.\n\n Additionally, different Officers will conduct inspections differently. Some may be open to a bribe; others may not search every container.

intel_mentor_note_appraisal_body.zh:
某些标记为[待鉴定物品]的贵重物品具有复杂的价值结构。顾客将光顾店铺并使用你的鉴定服务来确定其物品的价值。

你将获得一笔基础的鉴定服务费，外加一笔基于鉴定精确度的奖金。
你可以通过鉴定考试并获得证书，从而提高基础服务费，并解锁可鉴定的新物品种类。
intel_mentor_note_appraisal_body.en:
Some valuable items marked as [Appraisal Item] have complex price structures. Customers will visit the Store and use your appraisal service to determine the value of their item.

 You will receive a base service fee for the appraisal, plus a bonus based on the precision of the appraisal.
You will be able to pass appraisal examinations and receive a certification that will improve your base service fee and unlock new item types to appraise.

intel_mentor_note_events_body.zh: 某些事件会影响物品的市场价格，导致其暂时上涨或下跌。报纸上会列出大多数正在发生的事件。\n有些内部人士会在事件发生前向你兜售情报。
intel_mentor_note_events_body.en: Certain events will effect the market price of items, temporarily causing them to rise, or fall. The Newspaper will list most ongoing events.\n Some insiders can sell you tips for events before they happen.

intel_mentor_note_barter_body.zh: 偶尔会有顾客提出用物品进行交换，而非支付信用点。\n与常规的买卖不同，以物易物是无法讨价还价的。\n这类交易同样不会受到当前事件的影响。
intel_mentor_note_barter_body.en: Sometimes customers will arrive and offer to exchange items, rather than Credits.\n Barter offers cannot be negotiated unlike regular buy and sell offers.\n They are also not impacted by ongoing events.

intel_mentor_note_display_case_body.zh: 在卷帘门的左侧是展示柜，这是店铺的关键功能之一。 根据你放入其中的物品种类，你每天可以吸引一位想要购买该类物品的顾客。 例如，如果你放入许多[食物]物品和一件低价值的[医疗]物品，第二天就会有一位购买食物的顾客造访店铺。 存放物品的总价值将影响被吸引顾客的社会阶层。 升级展示柜能让你吸引到更多顾客。 确保在每天开店前为展示柜补充存货。 不要将违禁品放在展示柜内，否则你将被逮捕。
intel_mentor_note_display_case_body.en: On the left side of the Shutter Door, you'll find the Display Case, one of the key features of your Store. Depending on the type of items you place inside, you can attract one client per day looking to buy that type of item. For example, if you put many [Food] items and one low-value [Medical] item, a food-buying client will visit the store the next day. The total value of the items stored will impact the social class of the attracted client. Upgrading your Display Case will allow you to attract more clients. Make sure to stock the Display Case before opening the Store each day. Do not keep Contraband inside the Display Case or you will be arrested.

intel_mentor_note_upgrades_body.zh: 随着时日推移，你会遇到各种各样的人物，他们会提供有偿的店铺升级服务。\n这些升级可能很有用，但你在管理现金流时必须精打细算，并留意下一次缴纳租金的日期。
intel_mentor_note_upgrades_body.en: As the days go by, you will meet various persons of interest who will offer to upgrade your Store for a price.\n These upgrades can be useful, but you must be careful when managing your cash flow and keep an eye out for the next rent payment.

intel_mentor_note_visual_inspection_body.zh: 某些物品会被标记为可使用放大镜检查。 在可检查的物品上使用放大镜即可打开检查托盘。 如果物品存在问题，你可以在检查托盘界面底部选择一个原因，并就此与顾客对质。 如果物品是假冒的，指出一个问题就足以与顾客对质。 若指控属实，顾客将会调整价格。如果发生误判，你将失去声望，且顾客可能会去别处做生意。
intel_mentor_note_visual_inspection_body.en: Certain items will be marked as inspectable using a Magnifying Glass. Use the Magnifying Glass on an inspectable item to open the Inspection Tray. If there's an issue with the item, you can select a reason at the bottom of the Inspection Tray UI to confront the client about it. If the item is counterfeit, one issue is enough to confront the client. If you are right, the client will adjust the price. If you are wrong, you will lose Reputation and the client may take their business elsewhere.

intel_mentor_note_stamp_body.zh:
食品券是社会福利计划的一部分，旨在帮助符合条件的下层区公民，并预防发生动乱。
食品券可以用来在配给站兑换食物。
食品券有不同的面值。由于它们只能用来购买食物，因此人们经常以低于面值的价格将它们折现成信用点。
有时，伪造的食品券会被卖给毫无防备的受害者，这些人只有在兑换失败时才会发现自己上当受骗了。
intel_mentor_note_stamp_body.en:
Food Stamps are part of a social program to help eligible Lower Level citizens and prevent civil unrest.
 Food Stamps can be redeemed and are used at the Commissary to buy Food.
 Food Stamps can carry various values. Since they can only be used to buy Food, they are often traded at a lower value for Credits.
 The Stamps are sometimes forged and sold to unsuspecting victims, who only find out after failing to redeem the Stamp.

intel_mentor_note_commissary_body.zh:
配给站由共和国运营。这里出售的所有物品价格都是固定的，不受市场影响。

然而，虽然价格固定，但是物品的供应情况在很大程度上会受到市场的影响。
在配给站购买商品只能使用食品券。

<u>请在关店后访问配给站以购买商品。</u>
intel_mentor_note_commissary_body.en:
The Commissary is run by the Republic. The prices of all items sold here are fixed, and unaffected by the market.

 Nevertheless, while the price of goods is fixed, the availability of items is very much affected by the market.
 Only Food Stamps can be used to purchase goods at the Commissary.

<u>Visit the Commissary after closing the Store to purchase goods.</u>

intel_mentor_note_labels_body.zh:
某些物品可以更换标签。例如，你可以给一盒假冒香烟贴上正品标签来提高其价格。

但要当心——大多数工人、治安部警官和下层区公民都对常见的造假手段了如指掌。诈骗企图将会失败，且会导致你的声望受到惩罚。
拾荒者虽然也熟悉物品造假，但他们通常不会带用于检测真伪的设备——如果需要用到设备的话。
然而，游客和上层区公民一般对此更加欠缺防备。
不过，纸包不住火，人们迟早会发现端倪的。
intel_mentor_note_labels_body.en:
Certain items can be relabeled. For example, you can label a counterfeit box of cigarettes as genuine to raise its price.

 Beware — most workers, Security Officers, and Lower Level citizens are familiar with common item fraud. Scam attempts will fail and result in a penalty to your Reputation.
 While Scavengers are also familiar with item fraud, they often don't carry the equipment required to test for authenticity, if any is needed.
 Tourists and Upper Level citizens, however, are generally less aware.
 But sooner or later, people will find out.

intel_mentor_note_scd_title.zh: 导师笔记：哨兵崩溃综合征

intel_mentor_note_scd_body.zh: 很遗憾得知你患有哨兵崩溃综合征……这是一种你余生都必须与之共存的严重疾病。\n你需要定期注射免疫宁，否则你的健康状况会恶化并遭受永久性损伤。一开始漏打几天或许还能撑住，但损伤会随着时间不断累积。
intel_mentor_note_scd_body.en: I am sorry to hear that you have SCD... It's a serious health condition that you will live with for the rest of your life.\n You will need to take regular Immunivax shots or your health will deteriorate and suffer permanent damage. You can afford to miss a few days at the start, but the damage adds up over time.

intel_rev_codeword_body.zh:
市场委托中将使用以下暗号：
“生日派对” = 即将开展的行动，
“茶点” = 奥克西莫注射剂，
“聚会” = 突袭，
“花园” = 安全屋，
“乔迁之礼” = 治安部识别卡，
“度假” = 紧急撤离，
“年久失修” = 已暴露，
“最后一刻” = 高度紧急情况
intel_rev_codeword_body.en:
The following codewords will be used in Marketplace Requests:
Upcoming Operation, Birthday Party
 Oxymore Injector, Refreshment
 Raid, Gathering
Safehouse, Garden
 Security Access Card, Housewarming Gift
 Extraction, Vacation
Compromised, Decrepit
 High Priority Emergency, Last-Minute

intel_rev_codeword_short_desc.zh: 一张不起眼的纸条，上面草草写着革命军所用的暗号对应表。
intel_rev_codeword_short_desc.en: An inconspicuous slip of paper with a hastily written key for the code used by revolutionaries.

book_fuel_name.zh: 等离子燃料匣鉴定指南

book_fuel_p1_body.zh:
等离子燃料匣是脉冲等离子引擎的标准燃料，这种引擎在中小型航天器上非常普及。
由于需求量巨大且监管松散，不论是血汗黑工厂还是工业实验室均有生产。产地将直接影响等离子燃料匣的质量。

本指南将提供鉴定等离子燃料匣价值所需的全部知识。
book_fuel_p1_body.en:
Plasma Cartridges are the standard fuel of the the Pulse Plasma Drive, a common installation on small-to-medium spacecraft.
A result of high demand and light regulation, Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in sweatshops and industrial laboratories both. Where a Plasma Cartridge is made will affect its quality.

This guide will provide everything you need to know to appraise the value of any Plasma Cartridge.

book_fuel_p1_body3.zh:
空间站上共有四家常见的制造商：

	- 王尔德载具（“WLD”），
	- 共和国海军征用部（“RNR”），
	- 中华船舶（“ZHS”），
	- 点火实验室（“IGN”）
book_fuel_p1_body3.en:
There are four common manufacturers on the Station:

	- Wild's Rides ("WLD"),
	- Republic Naval Requisition ("RNR"),
	- ZhongHua Shipbuilding ("ZHS"),
	- Ignition Lab ("IGN")

book_fuel_p1_body4.zh: 无论制造商是谁，也无论当前品相如何，等离子燃料匣的基础价值均为300信用点，且最低价值为90信用点。
book_fuel_p1_body4.en: Regardless of manufacturer or current condition, Plasma Cartridges have a base value of 300 Credits, and a minimum value of 90 Credits.

book_fuel_p2_body.zh: 等离子燃料匣的价值由其品相决定。品相即是燃料匣各项属性的总和。
book_fuel_p2_body.en: The value of a Plasma Cartridge is determined by its condition. The condition is the total sum of the cartridges attributes.

book_fuel_p4_body.zh: 等离子的颜色是判断质量的最重要指标。\n任何非“标准”或“高级”的颜色都被视为“低级”。
book_fuel_p4_body.en: The color of the plasma is the biggest indicator of quality.\nAny color not Standard or High-Grade is regarded as Low-Grade.

book_fuel_p5_m1_desc.zh:
WLD等离子燃料匣产自下层区，质量参差不齐。
可能的外壳品相：所有类型
可能的颜色：低级、标准
防伪标：必定带有
book_fuel_p5_m1_desc.en:
WLD Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in the Lower Levels, and are highly variable in quality.
Possible Cartridge Condition: Any
Possible Color: Low-Grade, Standard
Seal: Always

book_fuel_p5_m1_bonus.zh: 如果所有条件均匹配：+60信用点

book_fuel_p5_m2_desc.zh:
ZHS等离子燃料匣定价更为亲民，同时品质也毫不含糊。

可能的外壳品相：无或加固处理
可能的颜色：标准
防伪标：必定带有
book_fuel_p5_m2_desc.en:
ZHS Plasma Cartidges have a more reasonable price point, but without compromising on quality.

Possible Cartridge Condition: None or Reinforced
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always

book_fuel_p5_m2_bonus.zh: 如果所有条件均匹配：+120信用点

book_fuel_p6_m2_bonus.zh: 如果所有条件均匹配：+750信用点

book_fuel_p6_m2_desc.zh:
作为一家专业的研发实验室，IGN制造的等离子燃料匣代表着最高水准。
可能的外壳品相：无特殊
可能的颜色：高级
防伪标：必定带有
book_fuel_p6_m2_desc.en:
A specialized R&D lab, IGN Plasma Cartridges are manufactured to the highest possible grade.
Possible Cartridge Condition: None
Possible Color:  High-Grade
Seal: Always

book_fuel_p6_m1_bonus.zh: 如果所有条件均匹配：+120信用点

book_fuel_p6_m1_desc.zh:
由共和国直接拨款资助，RNR等离子燃料匣通常会被回收并循环使用。

可能的外壳品相：除破裂外的任意品相
可能的颜色：标准
防伪标：必定带有
book_fuel_p6_m1_desc.en:
Funded by the Republic itself, RNR Plasma Cartridges are typically retrieved and recycled.

Possible Cartridge Condition: Any, Except Cracks
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always

book_water_s1_body.zh: 水质是由其纯度决定的：
book_water_s1_body.en: 'The quality of water is determined by its purity:'

book_water_s1_caution.zh: 仅在必要时饮用，不建议长期使用
book_water_s1_caution.en: Consume if necessary, prolonged use not advised

book_water_s1_unsafe.zh: 不安全，人类饮用存在风险
book_water_s1_unsafe.en: Unsafe and risky for human consumption

book_water_s2_body.zh: 无论有意为之还是无心之失，空间站上出售的水都可能会出现标签不符的情况。购买和饮用前请务必核实水质。
book_water_s2_body.en: Water sold on the station may not be labeled correctly, whether intentionally or not. Always verify water quality before purchase and consumption.

book_water_s2_body2.zh: 水质检测试纸是一种测试水质纯度的廉价且便捷的方法。
book_water_s2_body2.en: A Water Testing Strip is a cheap and easy way to test the purity of water.

book_water_s3_body.zh: 空间站的水可能含有多种类型的污染物。每种净水方法仅对特定类型的污染物有效。\n\n如果多次尝试仍无法提高水的纯度，则说明你所选的净水方法无法去除水中残留的污染物。
book_water_s3_body.en: Water on the station can contains multiple types of contaminants. Each method of purification is effective against only certain types of contaminants.\n\nIf repeated attempts do not improve the water's purity, your chosen purification method cannot remove the remaining contaminants in the water.

book_water_s3_body2.zh: 净水药片会先减少化学污染物，再用剩下的药效清除微生物污染物。一片药片足够处理一大瓶铁锈水，更脏的水可能需要好几片。
book_water_s3_body2.en: Water Purification Tablets reduce chemical contaminants first, then eliminate microbial contaminants with what remains. One tablet is enough for a large bottle of Rustwater; dirtier water may require several.

book_water_s3_body3.zh: 滤水器：将其安装在水罐内，会在倒水时进行过滤。\n它可以去除杂质、微塑料和有机废物。滤水器耐久度有限。
book_water_s3_body3.en: Water Filter: When installed inside a pitcher, it filters water as it is poured in.\nIt removes impurities, microplastics, and organic waste. Filters have limited durability.

book_water_s3_note.zh: 同时使用净水药片和滤水器，大多数水都能提升到基础水，甚至优质水，具体取决于水的初始纯度。污染严重的水可能需要好几片药片。
book_water_s3_note.en: Using Purification Tablets and a Water Filter together should bring most water up to Basewater, or even High-Quality Water, depending on the initial purity. Heavily contaminated water may require several tablets.

book_water_s3_note2.zh: 想要得到纯水，你就需要一台配备了合适模组的专用净水器。
book_water_s3_note2.en: To reach Pure Water, a dedicated Water Purifier with properly installed Modules is required.

book_water_s3_note3.zh: 不推荐使用基础净水方法来净化沟渠水，因为这会极大地损耗滤水器的耐久度。
book_water_s3_note3.en: Purifying Gutterflow using basic purification methods is not recommended, as it rapidly degrades Water Filter durability.

book_water_s4_body1.zh: 即使是对居住在上层区的人来说也很难弄到。极其昂贵，主要用于医院和实验室等敏感环境。在上层区社会，用纯水招待客人彰显着高贵的社会地位。
book_water_s4_body1.en: Hard to procure even for those living on the Upper Levels. Incredibly expensive and used primarily in sensitive environments like Hospitals and Laboratories. In Upper Levels societies, offering pure water to guests demonstrates high social status.

book_water_s4_body2.zh: 上层区的标准用水，可安全用于饮用、烹饪和大多数家庭用途。虽然更容易获取，但依然价格不菲。
book_water_s4_body2.en: The standard on the Upper Levels. Safe for drinking, cooking, and most household uses, it is more accessible but still costly.

book_water_s4_body3.zh: 下层区的标准用水。足以满足短期使用，但长期接触可能引发慢性疾病。
book_water_s4_body3.en: The standard for Lower Levels. Adequate for short-term use, but prolonged exposure can contribute to development of chronic disease.

book_water_s4_body4.zh: 肉眼无法将其与优质水区分，但若未经过滤便饮用并不安全。幽灵水常被用于农业和工业。\n在下层区，给幽灵水贴标签冒充好水出售是一种十分常见的诈骗手段。
book_water_s4_body4.en: Indistinguishable by eye from other higher quality water, yet unsafe to drink unfiltered. Ghostwater is most commonly used in farming and industry.\nThe sale of mislabeled Ghostwater is a common scam in the Lower Levels.

book_water_s4_body5.zh: 不适合农业灌溉，且饮用非常危险。\n\t可以通过肉眼进行识别。
book_water_s4_body5.en: Unsuitable for farming, and dangerous to drink.\n\tCan be identified visually.

book_water_s4_body6.zh: 受到严重污染并带有剧毒。如果不慎饮用，请立即就医。\n\t可以通过肉眼进行识别。
book_water_s4_body6.en: Heavily contaminated and toxic. Seek immediate medical attention if consumed. \n\tCan be visually identified.

book_water_s5_a1_body.zh: 铁锈水和沟渠水很难靠贴标签来诈骗，因为可以通过肉眼辨认颜色来将它们与其他类型的水区分开来。
book_water_s5_a1_body.en: Rustwater and Gutterflow are harder to mislabel since they are visually distinguishable from other types of water by color.

book_water_s5_a2_body.zh: 给幽灵水贴上基础水的标签来出售是下层区常见的诈骗手段。大批量出售贴错标签的幽灵水属于犯罪行为。
book_water_s5_a2_body.en: The sale of Ghostwater mislabeled as Basewater is a common scam in the Lower Levels. Selling large volume of mislabeled Ghostwater is a crime.

book_water_s5_a3_body.zh:
拾荒者通常穷困潦倒，没有条件随身携带水质检测试剂盒。
下层区公民和拾荒者通常不会购买优质水或纯水。
游客和上层区公民往往缺乏防备心，不会去检测他们买来的水纯不纯。
但要求购买大量水的顾客通常都会随身携带水质检测试剂盒。
book_water_s5_a3_body.en:
Scavengers are typically too poor to carry a Water Testing Kit.
Some Citizens of the Lower Levels and Scavengers will not buy Pure Water.
Tourists and Upper Level Citizens are often too oblivious to test the purity of the water they buy.
Customers requesting large amounts of water will typically carry a Water Testing Kit.

book_farm_s3_water_body.zh: 某些污染物会损害植物的生长。除非你种植的是有特殊需求的作物，否则务必要使用污染物浓度较低的水。（注：矿物质不属于污染物。）
book_farm_s3_water_body.en: 'Certain contaminants can harm the plant''s growth. Make sure to use water with a low concentration of contaminants, unless you farming a crop with particular needs. (NOTE: Minerals are NOT contaminants.)'

book_ingot_s2_body.zh: 金属锭的纯度是由冶炼它所用的材料决定的。使用“废金属”会产生较低的纯度，而使用“金属矿石”则会产生较高的纯度。此外，可以在熔炉中加入“助熔剂”来提高纯度，任何加入的助熔剂都会在冶炼过程中被消耗掉。\n\n熔炉需要动力源。冶炼过程将在夜间进行。
book_ingot_s2_body.en: The purity of an ingot is determined by the materials used to smelt it. Using Scrap Metals will yield a lower purity, while using Metal Ores will yield a higher one. Additionally, Flux Agent can be added to the furnace to improve the purity, Any added agent will be consumed.\n\nThe Furnace requires a source of power. The smelting process happens overnight.

calendar_display_case_hint.zh: 别忘了补充展示柜存货！
calendar_display_case_hint.en: Remember to stock the Display Case!

attrac_100.zh: 100：展示柜内的商品不会吸引任何额外顾客
attrac_100.en: '100: Merchandise inside the Display Case will not attract any additional customers'

attrac_200.zh: 200：每天会有一名随机普通顾客光顾店铺
attrac_200.en: '200: One random normal customer will visit the Store each day'

attrac_250.en: '250: +2 customers will visit the Store each day'

attrac_300.zh: 300：所有顾客的可花费信用点增加10%
attrac_300.en: '300: All customers will have 10% more Credits to spend'

attrac_400.zh: 400：贫穷顾客光顾店铺的几率降低
attrac_400.en: '400: Poor customers have lower chance of visiting the Store'

attrac_450.zh: 450：所有顾客的可花费信用点增加25%
attrac_450.en: '450: All customers will have 25% more Credits to spend'

attrac_500.en: '500: +3 customers will visit the Store each day'

attrac_650.zh: 650：贫穷顾客光顾店铺的几率进一步降低
attrac_650.en: '650: Poor customers have an even lower chance of visiting the Store'

attrac_750.zh: 750：所有顾客的可花费信用点增加75%
attrac_750.en: '750: All customers will have 75% more Credits to spend'

attrac_900.zh: 900：所有顾客的可花费信用点增加100%
attrac_900.en: '900: All customers will have 100% more Credits to spend'

ui_cant_afford.en: You can't afford all of the selected services...
