ui_rep_lost.zh: 你的店铺失去了{0}的名声。
ui_rep_lost.en: Your Store Lost Reputation With The {0}

ui_close_shutter_confirmation.zh: 确定要关店打烊吗？\n\n队伍里还有人在排队等候。
ui_close_shutter_confirmation.en: Are you sure you want to close the Store?\n\nThere are still people waiting in line.

ui_nego_budget_warning.zh: 顾客只剩下{0}信用点。\n你将少获得{1}信用点。
ui_nego_budget_warning.en: The customer only has {0} Credits left.\nYou will miss out on {1} Credits.

ui_nego_not_interested.zh: 顾客对此类物品不感兴趣
ui_nego_not_interested.en: Customer is not interested in this type of item

ui_nego_no_budget.zh: 顾客没有剩余的信用点可以花费了
ui_nego_no_budget.en: Customer has no credits left to spend

ui_nego_no_variety.zh: 顾客没有兴趣购买两件相同的物品
ui_nego_no_variety.en: Customer is not interested in buying the same item twice

ui_nego_info_body.zh: 与市场相关的、可采取行动的消息

intel_mentor_note_shotgun_body.zh: 改造体是被脑部植入物中的失控AI接管的人类。他们的身体已不由自己控制，目前也没有能在不杀死宿主的情况下安全移除植入物的方法。改造体极度危险，充满敌意，会主动绑架他人并为其安装改造植入物。店主们是防范改造体的第一道防线，因为改造体需要原材料来制造新的植入物，还需要医疗物资为更多受害者实施植入手术。他们还无法完全模仿正常人的行为，也可能使用过分正式的措辞或机械生硬的词语。只有在完全确认其身份后才能开枪。不要呼叫治安部，改造体已经侵入了他们的通信系统，会在治安部赶到前逃之夭夭。
intel_mentor_note_shotgun_body.en: The Augs are humans overtaken by a rogue AI inside a brain implant. Their bodies are no longer their own, and there is currently no safe way to remove the implant without killing the host. Augs are hostile and extremely dangerous, actively seeking to kidnap people and install more Augmentation implants. Shopkeepers are the first line of defense, since Augs rely on raw materials to fabricate new implants and medical supplies to surgically implant more victims. They haven't fully mastered normal human behavior and may also use overly formal phrasing or robotic vocabulary. Shoot only if you are absolutely certain. Do not try to call Security, the Augs have hacked their comms and will flee before Security arrives.

book_water_s1_warning.zh: 警告：若饮用了沟渠水，请立即就医
book_water_s1_warning.en: 'WARNING: IF CONSUMED GUTTERFLOW, SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION'

commissary_lottery_redeem_notice.zh: 将所有中奖彩票兑换为信用点（不是配给站票券）
commissary_lottery_redeem_notice.en: Redeem all winning lottery tickets into Credits (Not Commissary Tokens)

ui_clientele_buyers_merch.zh: 展示商品所吸引的预期买家

ui_clientele_tooltip.zh: 当卷帘门打开时，出现的顾客类型将取决于店铺的状态。
ui_clientele_tooltip.en: Customers will appear depending on the conditions of the Store when the Shutter Door is opened.

ui_clientele_normal_tooltip.zh: 店铺的状态每天会吸引一定数量的随机顾客。展示柜中存放的特定商品能够影响哪些顾客会出现。以下每位特殊顾客每天可出现一次。剩余的顾客名额将由随机顾客填补。
ui_clientele_normal_tooltip.en: The condition of your store will attract a number of random customers each day. Certain special items stored in the Display Case can influence which customers appear. Each of the following customers can appear once per day. Remaining slots will be filled with random customers.

ui_clientele_merch_tooltip.zh: 存放在展示柜中的大多数商品都会吸引买家。买家的预算取决于存放商品的价值。
ui_clientele_merch_tooltip.en: Most merchandise stored inside the Display Case will attract buyers. Buyers' budget depend on the value of the stored merchandise.

ui_clientele_no_merch_detected.zh: 未检测到展示柜内有商品。
ui_clientele_no_merch_detected.en: No merchandise detected inside the display case.

ui_info_variety.zh: 此顾客每种物品只会购买一次，但愿意支付高昂的溢价。
ui_info_variety.en: This customer will only buy each item once, but will pay a premium.

ui_info_no_contraband.zh: 此顾客不会接受任何违禁品。
ui_info_no_contraband.en: This customer will not accept any contraband.

ui_info_security_team.zh: 此顾客是空间站治安部的一员。向其展示赃物或违禁品可能会引来麻烦。
ui_info_security_team.en: This customer is part of Station Security. Showing them Stolen or Contraband items may have consequences.

ui_info_service_power.zh: 保持店铺照明并维持电网设备运转。若未支付电费，将会导致只有依靠能量电池供电的机器才能运转，且店内灯光会变暗。
ui_info_service_power.en: Keeps the store lit and grid devices running. If unpaid, only Machines that run on Energy Cells will function. Lights inside the store will dim.

ui_info_service_insurance.zh: 若支付此费用，夜间被盗的任何物品都将在第二天早晨归还给你。
ui_info_service_insurance.en: If paid, any items stolen during the night will be returned to you the next morning.

ui_info_service_janitorial.zh: 若支付此费用，垃圾桶将被清空，店面也将得到清扫。如果店面连续多日未清理，店铺的吸引力将会下降。如果店铺当前遭到破坏，清理费用将会更高。
ui_info_service_janitorial.en: If paid, the trash can will be emptied and the storefront will be cleaned. If the storefront is left unclean for multiple days, the store's attractiveness will decrease. If the store is currently vandalized, the cleaning cost will be higher.

ui_info_store_attractiveness.zh: 清洁工上次打扫店面的时间，以及某些机器和升级项目，都会影响店铺吸引力。
ui_info_store_attractiveness.en: Store Attractiveness is affected by how recently the Janitor cleaned the storefront, and by certain machines and upgrades.

ui_info_reputation.zh: 通过与派系成员进行交易，可以获得该派系的声望。与特殊顾客交易可获得额外声望。向治安部举报顾客可能会导致你在该顾客所属派系中的声望下降。
ui_info_reputation.en: Reputation with a faction can be gained by trading with their members. Trading with special customers grants increased reputation. Reporting a customer to Security may result in lost reputation with their faction.

ui_info_labeler.zh: 某些物品贴有标签，并且可以被编辑。你可以利用它诚实地给物品贴标签，或者故意贴错标签以高价出售。但要注意：不同的顾客在辨别假冒标签商品时的能力各有高低。如果你被发现将物品以高于其实际价值的虚假标签出售，你的声望可能会受到打击。
ui_info_labeler.en: 'Certain items can have labels, which can be edited. Use this to label items honestly, or to mislabel them and sell at a higher price. Beware: different customers are better or worse at spotting mislabeled goods. If you are caught selling an item worth less than its label, your reputation may take a hit.'

ui_info_inspection_genuine_claim.zh: 顾客声称这件物品是正品且状况良好。如果你发现任何迹象表明它是赝品或已损坏，请使用此面板与其对质。指出一个问题就足够了。如果发生误判，你的声望可能会受损。
ui_info_inspection_genuine_claim.en: The customer claims this item is genuine and in working condition. Use this panel to confront them if you find any sign that it's counterfeit or broken. One issue is enough. If you are wrong, your reputation may take a hit.

ui_info_inspection_counterfeit_claim.zh: 顾客正在出售这件物品，并声称它是赝品或已损坏。如果你认为对方搞错了，可以使用此面板告知实情。对方虽然会相应地提高要价，但会为你提供声望。
ui_info_inspection_counterfeit_claim.en: The customer is selling this item and claims it's counterfeit or broken. If you believe they're wrong, use this panel to say so. They will raise their asking price accordingly and grant you reputation.

book_fuel_p7_example1.en: Base Value: +300 Cracks: -150 Reinforced: +60 No Manufacturer Bonus (Can't have cracks): +0 ---------------------- Total: 210

book_fuel_p7_example2.en: Base Value: +300 Heavy Wears: -90 Exposed Screws: -30 Low Grade Color: -150 ------------------ Subtotal: 30 ------------------ This item cannot go below 90 Final Value: 90

ui_tooltip_typewriter_effect_info.zh: 关闭后，对话文本将瞬间全部显示，而非模拟打字效果。
ui_tooltip_typewriter_effect_info.en: When disabled, dialogue text appears instantly instead of typing out.

ui_tooltip_typewriter_auto_info.zh: 关闭后，对话将不再自动推进。需按空格键继续浏览下一行。
ui_tooltip_typewriter_auto_info.en: When disabled, dialogue does not advance automatically. Press Space to continue to the next line.

ui_dialog_window_note.zh: 这些设置随时都可以在“游戏选项”菜单中进行更改。
ui_dialog_window_note.en: These settings can be changed at any time in the Game Options menu.

bargain_ui_offer_discount_info.zh: 向此顾客出售物品时提供折扣。每售出一件物品都将获得额外声望，并且还能增加顾客的预算。
bargain_ui_offer_discount_info.en: Offer a discount when selling to this customer. Grants additional reputation on each item sold and increases customer budget.

bargain_ui_demand_discount_info.zh: 向此顾客购买物品时要求折扣。若成功，每买入一件物品都将消耗声望。成功率取决于你的派系声望。
bargain_ui_demand_discount_info.en: Demand a discount when buying from this customer. Costs reputation on each item bought if successful. Success depends on your faction reputation.

bargain_ui_add_markup_info.zh: 向此顾客出售物品时额外加价，此举会减少其总预算，且每售出一件物品都将额外消耗声望。成功率取决于你当前的声望。
bargain_ui_add_markup_info.en: Charge extra when selling to this customer, reducing their total budget and costing additional reputation on each item sold. Success depends on your current reputation.

bargain_ui_offer_markup_info.zh: 向此顾客购买物品时额外加价。每买入一件物品都将获得额外声望。
bargain_ui_offer_markup_info.en: Pay extra when buying from this customer. Grants additional reputation on each item purchased.

bargain_ui_blackmail_info.zh: 威胁要将此顾客举报给治安部，除非对方在交易时提供更好的价格。对非罪犯顾客必定失败。
bargain_ui_blackmail_info.en: Threaten to report this customer to Security unless they offer better prices when trading. Always fails on non-criminal customers.

bargain_ui_threathen_info.zh: 指控此顾客是改造体并威胁要开枪，借此要求在交易中获得更好的价格。如果对普通顾客尝试此举，指控必定失败，且你将失去声望。
bargain_ui_threathen_info.en: Accuse this customer of being an Aug and threaten to shoot them, demanding better prices when trading. If attempted on a normal customer, the accusation will always fail and you will lose reputation.

bargain_ui_rep_mult_info.zh: 此倍率决定了与该顾客交易时，派系声望增减的倍数。
bargain_ui_rep_mult_info.en: This multiplier determines the rate at which faction reputation is gained or lost when trading with this customer.

bargain_ui_rep_mult_info2.zh: 每交易1000信用点时，预计会在该顾客所属派系中获得或失去的声望。
bargain_ui_rep_mult_info2.en: Estimated reputation gained or lost with this customer's faction for every 1,000 Credits traded.

book_hand_intro.zh: 空间站上的仿生机械手种类繁多，价格也千差万别。本指南将帮助确定任何仿生机械手的公平市场价值。
book_hand_intro.en: Cybernetic hands vary widely on the Station, and so do their prices. This guide will help determine the fair market value of any cybernetic hand.

book_hand_p1_s1_body.zh: 所有仿生机械手的初始价值均为100信用点。各种状况都会影响其价格。但无论状况如何，仿生机械手的最低价值为50信用点。
book_hand_p1_s1_body.en: All cybernetic hands start at 100 Credits. Various conditions can affect their price. Regardless of condition, the minimum value of a cybernetic hand is 50 Credits.

book_hand_p3_s1_body.zh: 附加组件的加成为独立计算，且均可叠加生效。
book_hand_p3_s1_body.en: Add-ons bonus are independent and each can apply.

book_hand_p3_s2_body.zh: 仿生机械手的特定属性组合可以提升其价值。
book_hand_p3_s2_body.en: Specific combinations of cybernetic hands can increase their value.

book_hand_p3_s2_body2.zh:
战术型：
- 碳复合材料
- EMG+ 或神经接口
- 没有任何磨损、受损情况
- 具备装甲与刀刃
book_hand_p3_s2_body2.en:
Tactical:
- Carbon Composite
- EMG+ or Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- Armored and blade

book_hand_p3_s2_body3.zh:
豪华型：
- 镀金
- 神经接口
- 没有任何磨损、受损情况
- 附加组件任何情况均可
book_hand_p3_s2_body3.en:
Deluxe:
- Gold Plated
- Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- With or without any add-ons

book_hand_example1.zh:
基础：+100
碳复合材料：+50
磨损：-35
EMG+：+45
总计：160信用点

book_hand_example2.zh:
基础：+100
受损：-85
规格不明接口：-60
小计：-45信用点
不可低于50信用点
总计：50信用点
book_hand_example2.en:
Base: +100
Damage: -85
Unspecified Control: -60
Subtotal: -45 Credits
CANNOT GO BELOW 50 CREDITS
Total: 50 Credits

book_wine_p2_body1.zh: 水质会影响酒的品质。请使用优质水或基础水。纯水缺乏发酵所需的矿物质。水质低于基础水时，酿出的酒品质会大幅下降。
book_wine_p2_body1.en: Water quality affects wine quality. Use High Quality Water or Basewater. Pure Water lacks the minerals needed for fermentation. Lower grades of water will greatly reduce wine quality.

book_wine_p2_body2.zh: 标准酵母只是可选项，但强烈推荐使用。如果不使用它，空气中的野生酵母将代替其发酵酒液，但这会产生极不稳定的结果。此外，标准酵母也能极大地加速发酵过程。
book_wine_p2_body2.en: Standard yeast is optional but highly recommended. Without it, wild yeast from the air will ferment the wine instead, producing inconsistent results. Standard yeast also greatly accelerates fermentation.

book_wine_p2_body3.zh: 浆果的品质是最重要的因素。一把浆果足以酿造低级酒。酿造高级酒则需要两把浆果。避免使用过熟、未熟或发霉的浆果。最适合酿酒的浆果通常比正常尺寸更小。
book_wine_p2_body3.en: Berry quality is the most important factor. One handful is enough for lower-grade wine. Two handfuls are necessary for high-grade wine. Avoid overripe, underripe, or moldy berries. The best berries for winemaking are usually smaller than normal.

ui_aug_guide_s2_b1.zh:
-不自然的僵滞
-抽搐
-穿着与其派系不符的服装
-机械化的用词
-过度正式的措辞
ui_aug_guide_s2_b1.en:
-Unnatural Stillness
-Twitching
-Outfit Not Matching Their Faction
-Robotic vocabulary
-Overly Formal Phrasing

ui_thanks_demo_content.zh: 欢迎您将本作加入Steam愿望单，并抽出5分钟来填写一下反馈问卷。您的意见将帮助我们进一步完善游戏！
ui_thanks_demo_content.en: Please consider wishlisting the game on Steam and filling out the feedback survey. It only takes 5 minutes and would help us make the game better!

ui_delete_save.zh: 确定要删除此栏位中的存档吗？
ui_delete_save.en: Are you sure you want to delete this save slot?

book_ribwich_base_value_body.zh: 所有肋明治的基础价值均为150信用点，不同状况会影响其价格。
book_ribwich_base_value_body.en: All Ribwichs start at 150 Credits. Different conditions can affect its price.

book_ribwich_intro.zh: 这是达夫雷推出的限量版三明治，如今已经停产。由于现存的肋明治仍在不断被吃掉，其价格正稳步上涨。
book_ribwich_intro.en: A limited edition sandwich from Davre. Now discontinued, it's price now steadly increasing due to people still eating it.

book_ribwich_section1_body.zh: 如果塑料包装缺失、已被撕开或属于赝品，无论其他条件如何，最终价值一律为40信用点。\n无论状况如何，肋明治的最终价值都不会低于40信用点。
book_ribwich_section1_body.en: If the plastic packaging is missing, torn open or counterfeit, the final value will always be 40 credits regardless of anything else. \nRibwichs can't have a final value lower than 40 credits, regardless of any condition.

book_ribwich_section2_body.zh: 所有肋明治的包装上都会标明生产日期。肋明治只在以下两个批次中生产过：
book_ribwich_section2_body.en: 'All Ribwichs will have their production date displayed on the packaging. The Ribwich were only ever produced on the following runs:'

book_ribwich_section2_example.zh: 第一生产批次：425年1月—429年12月\n第二生产批次：432年1月—438年12月
book_ribwich_section2_example.en: 1st Production Run: January 425 - December 429\n2nd Production Run: January 432 - December 438

book_ribwich_section2_body4.zh: 出于历史纪念价值，首月（01/425）和末月（12/438）生产的肋明治价值+50信用点。
book_ribwich_section2_body4.en: The Ribwich produced on the very first month (01/425) and the very last month (12/438) are worth +50 Credits for historical reasons.

book_ribwich_section2_body3.zh: 第一生产批次的肋明治使用了更优质的原料，价值+80信用点。
book_ribwich_section2_body3.en: The first production run Ribwich were made using better material and are worth +80 Credits

book_ribwich_section2_body2.zh: 如果生产日期缺失、无效或不在上述范围内，则为赝品。
book_ribwich_section2_body2.en: If the production date is missing, invalid or outside the range, then it is counterfeit.

book_ribwich_section3_body.zh: 达夫雷曾使用多家工厂生产和包装肋明治。部分工厂的质控标准较高或较低，会影响肋明治的保质期。
book_ribwich_section3_body.en: Davre used a number of facility to produce and package the Ribwich, some are known to have higher or lower quality control standard which can affect the Ribwich shelf life.

book_ribwich_section3_example.en: High Quality Packing Facility: 01, 02, 05, 08, 21, 34\nLow Quality Packing Facility: 07, 15, 18, 26, 31

book_ribwich_section3_body2.zh: 曾有35家工厂负责包装肋明治。如果包装工厂编号缺失或无效，则该肋明治为赝品。
book_ribwich_section3_body2.en: There's 35 total packing facilities that were used. If the packing facility number is missing or invalid, then the Ribwich is counterfeit.

book_ribwich_section3_body3.zh: 由高品质包装工厂出品的肋明治价值+50信用点。
book_ribwich_section3_body3.en: Ribwich from the high quality packing facility are worth +50 Credits

book_ribwich_section3_body4.zh: 由低品质包装工厂出品的肋明治价值-50信用点。
book_ribwich_section3_body4.en: Ribwich from the low quality packing facility are worth -50 Credits

book_ribwich_section3_body5.zh: 第二生产批次正品肋明治示例：
book_ribwich_section3_body5.en: 'Example of a genuine Ribwich from the second production run:'

book_ribwich_section4_body.zh: 与普通肋明治一同推出的还有使用芝麻面包并加量酸黄瓜的版本，上市时称为“豪华版”。
book_ribwich_section4_body.en: Ribwich with sesame bun and extra pickles were also released along the normal Ribwich and was marketed as Deluxe Edition

book_ribwich_section4_example.zh: 豪华版肋明治必须同时具备芝麻面包和加量酸黄瓜。如果只有其中一项，则为赝品。
book_ribwich_section4_example.en: The Deluxe edition ribwich must have both the sesame bun and extra pickles. if only one is present then it is counterfeit.

book_ribwich_section4_body2.zh: 正品豪华版价值+300信用点。
book_ribwich_section4_body2.en: Valid deluxe edition are worth +300 Credits

book_ribwich_section5_body.zh: 据报道，达夫雷的包装机偶尔会发生故障，产出含有两块肉饼的肋明治。质控团队通常会将这类产品剔除并销毁，因此双层肉饼肋明治极为罕见。
book_ribwich_section5_body.en: In rare instances, it has been reported that Davre’s packing machine malfunctioned and produced Ribwiches with two meat patties. These Ribwiches are typically removed and destroyed by the quality control team, making double-patty Ribwiches extremely rare.

book_ribwich_section5_body2.zh: 正品双层肉饼肋明治价值+800信用点。
book_ribwich_section5_body2.en: Valid double patty Ribwich are worth +800 Credits

book_ribwich_section6_body.zh: 所有肋明治都必须带有达夫雷标志。如标志缺失或错误，则为赝品。
book_ribwich_section6_body.en: All Ribwich must have the Davre Logo, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit.

book_ribwich_section7_body.zh: 所有第二生产批次的肋明治都带有Ribwich贴纸，如贴纸缺失或错误，则为赝品。\n第一生产批次的肋明治不带Ribwich贴纸。
book_ribwich_section7_body.en: All 2nd production ribwich will have a Ribwich sticker, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit. 1st production will not have the Ribwich sticker.

book_farm_s1_body.zh:
1. 放入一个装满幽灵水或基础水的储水容器。
2. 加入一些矿物质，确保养分充足。
3. 放入电源和种子。
4. 一两天后，作物应该就能收获了。
book_farm_s1_body.en:
'1. Insert a filled water container with Ghostwater or Basewater.
2. Add some Minerals to make sure there''s enough nutrient.
3. Insert power source and seed.
4. After a day or two, the farm should be ready for harvest.

book_farm_s1_note.zh: 按需补水并更换能量电池，确保水培系统持续运转！
book_farm_s1_note.en: Add water and replace the energy cell as needed to ensure that hydroponic keep running!

book_farm_s2_body.zh: 可以从种植营养果开始学习水培。这种作物经过基因改造，很容易种植。\n\n务必储备充足的洁净水，并在产量下降时向水中加入一片水培营养片。
book_farm_s2_body.en: Start learning hydroponic by farming Nutrifruit. It is genetically modified to be an easy to farm crop.\n\nMake sure to keep enough clean water and add a nutriment tablet to the water when the yield decrease.

book_farm_s3_nutrient_body.zh: 植物生长需要矿物质。含量过低或过高都会对产量造成不利影响。每种植物对养分浓度的耐受范围各不相同。通常而言，矿物质宁多勿少。
book_farm_s3_nutrient_body.en: Plants require Minerals to grow. Too little or too much can have negative impact on the yield. Each plant has specific nutrient concentration tolerance. Usually, it's better to have too much Minerals than not enough.

book_farm_s3_analyser_body.zh: 可对种子使用，以查看其生长需求和当前健康状况。
book_farm_s3_analyser_body.en: Can be used on a seed to check its needs and their current health.

book_chem_p1_s1_body.zh: 拆包后可获得多种必需化学品。
book_chem_p1_s1_body.en: Can be unpack to obtain various essential chemicals

book_chem_p1_s2_title.zh: 成分光谱仪（化学扫描仪）

book_chem_p1_s2_body.zh: 对液体容器或化学制品使用，可查看其成分。
book_chem_p1_s2_body.en: Use it on liquid container or chemical product to see their composition

book_chem_p1_s3_body.zh: 可升级以提高萃取产率。
book_chem_p1_s3_body.en: Can be upgraded to improve extraction yield

book_chem_p1_s4_body.zh: 可升级以提高最高温度、控温能力和加热速度。
book_chem_p1_s4_body.en: Can be upgraded to improve max temperature, temperature control and heating speed.

book_chem_p1_s5_body.zh: 夜间运作，可去除水和酒精等特定液体。可使用普通模组升级。
book_chem_p1_s5_body.en: Work overnight to remove certain liquid such as water and alcohol. Use normal modules

book_chem_p1_s6_body.zh: 可升级以减少加工过程中引入的杂质。
book_chem_p1_s6_body.en: Can be upgraded to reduce the amount of impurity introduced

book_chem_p1_module.zh: 与其他机器不同，大多数化学相关机器只能使用特殊的化学设备模组进行升级。
book_chem_p1_module.en: Unlike other machines, most of the machine related to chemistry can only be upgraded with the special Chemical Equipment Module.

book_chem_p2_s1_body.zh: - 将液体容器接到搅拌机上\n- 加入几株梦帽菇\n- 搅拌原料，制成梦帽菇糊
book_chem_p2_s1_body.en: - Attach a liquid container to the Blender\n- Add a few Dream Cap\n- Blend the ingredient to get Dream Cap Mush

book_chem_p2_s2_body.zh:
- 取下上一步使用的容器
- 将其放入加热板
- 加入相当于梦帽菇糊体积3至6倍的溶剂（酒精）
- 将混合物加热至40-60°C，使梦帽菇糊转化为梦帽菇萃取液
book_chem_p2_s2_body.en:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Dream Cap Mush
- Heat the mixure to 40-60C to turn Dream Cap Mush into Dream Cap Extract

book_chem_p2_s2_note.zh: 切勿过热，否则梦帽菇会被破坏。
book_chem_p2_s2_note.en: Do not overheat or Dream Cap will be destroyed

book_chem_p2_s3_body.zh:
- （可选）用韧棉织物过滤上一步所得溶液，以去除大颗粒污染物
- 将容器放入蒸发器
- 确保蒸发器装有能量电池供电
- 等到第二天，让蒸发器完成处理
book_chem_p2_s3_body.en:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work

book_chem_p2_s4_body.zh:
- （必需）待水和酒精全部蒸发后，将容器放入化学制剂成型机
- 选择“梦尘”配方
- 按下“输出”按钮
- （可选）使用成分光谱仪检查纯度
book_chem_p2_s4_body.en:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Dream Dust as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer

book_chem_p3_s1_body.zh: - 将液体容器接到搅拌机上\n- 加入一些咖啡豆\n- 搅拌原料，制成咖啡豆糊
book_chem_p3_s1_body.en: - Attach a liquid container to the Blender\n- Add a few Coffee Beans\n- Blend the ingredient to get Coffee Beans Mush

book_chem_p3_s2_body.zh:
- 取下上一步使用的容器
- 将其放入加热板
- （可选但推荐）加入相当于咖啡豆糊体积3至6倍的溶剂（酒精）
- 将混合物加热到至少80°C
book_chem_p3_s2_body.en:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- (Optional but Recommanded) Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Coffee Bean Mush
- Heat the mixure to a minimum of 80C

book_chem_p3_s2_note.zh: 注意：咖啡因的耐热性很强。

book_chem_p3_s3_body.zh:
- （可选）用韧棉织物过滤上一步所得溶液，以去除大颗粒污染物
- 将容器放入蒸发器
- 确保蒸发器装有能量电池供电
- 等到第二天，让蒸发器完成处理
book_chem_p3_s3_body.en:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work

book_chem_p3_s4_body.zh:
- （必需）待水和酒精全部蒸发后，将容器放入化学制剂成型机
- 选择“咖啡因药片”配方
- 按下“输出”按钮
- （可选）使用成分光谱仪检查纯度
book_chem_p3_s4_body.en:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Caffeine Pill as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer

book_chem_p4_body.zh: 芬太的精确配方至今仍受到严密保护，以下内容整理自公开资料。
book_chem_p4_body.en: The precise recipe for Phanta remains a closely guarded secret. What follows is a compilation of publicly available information.

book_chem_p4_s1_body.zh: N-羟甲基碱是已知的一种芬太前体，可从管制化学用品中找到。
book_chem_p4_s1_body.en: N-Methylol Base is a known precursor of Phanta. It can be found in Restricted Chemical Supplies

book_chem_p4_s2_body.zh: N-羟甲基碱中含有稳定剂，既能防止化学品降解，也会阻止其发生反应。因此必须设法将稳定剂去除。
book_chem_p4_s2_body.en: The N-Methylol Base will contain a Stabilizing Agent to protect the chemical from degradation but also prevent chemical reaction. It must be somehow removed.

book_chem_p4_s3_body.zh: 接下来需要一种能向N-羟甲基碱提供电子的物质，使其通过化学反应转化为芬太。\n\n我们推测，该过程还必须在高温下进行，因此需要升级过的加热板。
book_chem_p4_s3_body.en: We now need a substance that can donate electrons to the N-Methylol Base to transform it chemically into Phanta. \n\nWe suspect this process must also be done at high temperature requiring an upgraded Heating Plate

book_chem_p4_s4_body.zh: 之后过滤溶液，再按常规方式成型封装即可。
book_chem_p4_s4_body.en: After that, filter the solution and package it as usual.

book_chem_p4_s3_note.zh: 警告：芬太在130°C以上会发生降解。

book_chem_p5_body.zh: 部分顾客会携带化学扫描仪，核验产品标签上标示的纯度。
book_chem_p5_body.en: Some customers will carry Chem Scanner to verify the labeled purity of your products.

The game checks mods before activation, but cannot make them safe. Only activate mods from authors you trust. You use mods at your own risk. ui_tooltip_newspaper_to_trash_info.zh: 早晨送来的报纸会被放进垃圾桶，而不是柜台上。你仍然可以把它取出来阅读。
ui_tooltip_newspaper_to_trash_info.en: The morning newspaper is put in the trash can instead of on the counter. You can still take it out to read it.

ui_tooltip_enable_fps_cap_info.zh: 将游戏帧率限制在显示器的刷新率（至少每秒60帧）。更省电，也能让显卡更凉快、更安静。关闭后，游戏会尽可能多地绘制画面。
ui_tooltip_enable_fps_cap_info.en: Limits the game to your monitor's refresh rate (at least 60 frames per second). Uses less power and keeps your graphics card cooler and quieter. When off, the game draws as many frames as it can.

ui_tooltip_vsync_info.zh: 每次显示器刷新只绘制一帧画面，画面不会卡顿或撕裂。更省电，也能让显卡更凉快、更安静。关闭后，游戏会尽可能多地绘制画面。
ui_tooltip_vsync_info.en: Draws one frame per refresh of your monitor, so the picture never stutters or tears. Uses less power and keeps your graphics card cooler and quieter. When off, the game draws as many frames as it can.

ui_mods_cap_links.zh: 在浏览器中打开网页链接
ui_mods_cap_links.en: Open web links in your browser

ui_mods_cap_steam.zh: 通过你的账户使用Steam功能（成就、好友、游戏内界面）
ui_mods_cap_steam.en: Use Steam features with your account (achievements, friends, overlay)

ui_mods_note_rescan_refused.zh: 游戏更新后的模组扫描检查未通过
ui_mods_note_rescan_refused.en: the game's updated mod scanner refuses it

ui_mods_note_rescan_undeclared.zh: 游戏更新后的模组扫描检查发现了未声明的权限：{0}
ui_mods_note_rescan_undeclared.en: 'the game''s updated mod scanner found capabilities it does not declare: {0}'

ui_mods_note_rescan_new_capabilities.zh: 游戏更新后的模组扫描检查发现了你未批准的权限：{0}
ui_mods_note_rescan_new_capabilities.en: 'the game''s updated mod scanner found capabilities you did not approve: {0}'

ui_mods_note_stopped.zh: 它试图以模组绝不允许的方式使用你的Steam账户（{0}）
ui_mods_note_stopped.en: it tried to use your Steam account in a way mods are never allowed to ({0})

ui_mods_note_stopped_process.zh: 它试图启动其他程序，而模组绝不允许这样做
ui_mods_note_stopped_process.en: it tried to start another program, which mods are never allowed to do

ui_mods_trust_stopped.zh: 已被游戏停止并停用：{0}。请删除或取消订阅此模组；如果它曾在这台电脑上运行，请更改你的Steam密码。
ui_mods_trust_stopped.en: 'Stopped and deactivated by the game: {0}. Delete or unsubscribe this mod, and change your Steam password if it ran on this computer.'

ui_mods_enable_stopped.zh: '{0}已被游戏在这台电脑上停止，原因：{1}。该版本无法再次启用。'
ui_mods_enable_stopped.en: '{0} was stopped by the game on this computer because {1}. This version cannot be enabled again.'
